The automatic ability to integrate his Layers...he was trying to wrap it around the Source of Dreams instead of being wrapped by it!

His visage shone with boundless luminescence as he communicated with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

Or simply, 27,853 All Source Enhancers.

chapters.title: Chapter 2091 INTEGRATION! II
paragraphs: There was still much to understand and learn as on this path, the specifics were still not laid out.
But Noah simply took the first step as his Will bathed the Source of Dreams.
He didn't try to take it upon himself or contain it, leaving all of this to the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as he simply utilized it to achieve the Integration!
The binding or a Source to him!
HUUM!
Waves of pristine authority were surging at this juncture as around Noah's body, liquid gold Absolute Dream Authority was converging to paint and surround his whole visage gold.
Eowyn who was currently connected to him felt unprecedented changes as her Haven had been fully restored already, but it didn't stop there as it experienced further Refinement and elevation!
The liquid gold Absolute Dream Authority permeated across everything as it was so dense that it went to bathe Noah's Aspects of Existence fully.

It bathed him from the Quintessential cells that made up his body all the way to his established Six Dimensional Layers, the viscous gold light washing over all of his current Dimensions in a unique manner as he truly experienced Integration!
Dreams.
The tool that used to be one of the most powerful among Dimensions.
The capability to turn one's illusive Dreams into a Reality.
It was a fitting Source for Noah to bind and integrate as he turned his own wishes and dreams into a shocking reality!
<Your Construct of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality bears the Source of Dreams as your Will Integrated with it through an established and unbreakable connection.>
<An Unprecedented Action! A Quintessential Action!>
<You are walking upon a path no others have taken. Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>

Boundlessly radiant prompts came down as at this juncture, the Absolute Dream Authority around Noah had built up onto a dense sea that covered him entirely, this sea beginning to churn and bubble at this moment until it shot upwards like an incandescent pillar of glorious light!
<The Source of Dreams has been Opened.>
<The Source of Dreams has been Bound by the Quintessential Kainos Emperor.>
A shining pillar of light.
It blocked out every single thing as within the Dream Dimension he stood on, Noah felt like an anchor that connected everything in this Dimension.
The Weight of its source was unimaginable but...he didn't have to bear it!
The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality did this for him!
SHIING!
The shining golden light became even more radiant at this juncture as Noah felt like his soul was becoming electrified.
<You have integrated your Will into Nature as you gaze upon the profundity of Dreams.>
<You can freely utilize Absolute Dream Authority to the extent that your Soul can bear.>
<The Augmentation from the Source of Dreams has been greatly elevated.>
<You have gained an unprecedented level of control over the Source of Dreams and those it is bound to.>
BOOOOM!
One prompt.
One prompt that caused everything to explode into a shocking golden radiance as even Noah's soul only saw blankness.
When he came to again, his vision had changed.
He found himself in a massive nexus of information as he was an endlessly pulsing mass of golden light.
This mass...it had many distinct golden lines connected to it as it pulsed in harmony with it, a relationship of give and take being formed as both sides benefited from a connection!
From an integration!
Noah's soul was shaken as he only truly affirmed what he saw when his Will saw one particular golden line.

It shone with familiar radiance as apart from being connected to this pulsing golden mass, he was feeling a familiarity with it as his body was currently connected to the existence that this Line of Integration represented!
He...could say with confidence that the line before him represented Eowyn's Integration with the Source of Dreams!
It meant that the many other Lines of Integration he could see...were all the existences that were Integrated with the Source of Dreams.
It was an unbelievable concept to fathom as his Will went forward to grasp onto Eowyn's Line of Integration.
SHIING!

A radiance shone as the image of none other than the woman he was connected to was displayed, along with information flowing in about their name, location, and the amount of time since they were connected to the Source!
After ascertaining this, Noah then focused on his connection with the pulsing golden mass and Eowyn's Line of Integration as he...focused more of the Source into it.

Brilliance overflowed as this line became ever brighter, the connection with his Main Body faint, but he was still able to receive feedback of feeling Eowyn's visage release even greater radiance as her power rose by a level!
Her augmentation to the Source of Dreams...could be affected and elevated by Noah as he had integrated this Source into him.
And Noah could affect the augmentations of all others that were bound to the Source of Dreams as at this juncture...
THUMP!
His heart began to beat with increased frequency.
THUMP!
An idea arose in his heart that burned with utter glory and incredulity as once it set in, it could not be wiped away!
His will actually felt great joy and wonder as if he could manage to pull off what he theoretically thought possible...ah!
As he looked at the many Lines of Integration, he called out with quintessential authority.
He used droves of the Absolute Dream Authority that he could now utilize as much of as the only limitation was what his soul could bear!
Then...
<Quintessential Pathogenicity>. <Neural Encroachment>.
Yes!
His will surged with power as it latched onto and flowed onto the many Lines of Integration binding multiple Nature Integration Realm existences with utmost silence and discretion!
He wanted to encroach upon the Wills of these beings who were integrated with the Source of Dreams that he now bound under his Will!
HOOONG!

Massive and titanic waves of Providence rose and flourished in a shocking show of wonder, the boons of the Imperial Undead Gu that were transformed by Noah's ZENITH Lineage of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor being utilized in an unbelievable manner as Noah made a bid to dominate all those Integrated with the Decretum of Dreams!

chapters.title: Chapter 2092 It Is Time! I
paragraphs: Utmost discretion!
This was what Noah needed to carry out what he wanted to do at this moment as he was paying the price of his actions purely with Absolute Dream Authority.
Since he could spend as much as his soul could handle, he wanted to very discreetly spread his Pathogenic Will onto the very souls of Nature Integration experts before they realized anything!
Of course, he knew that this would be an insurmountable ordeal as some of those he targeted were truly powerful existences.
Even though they were integrated with the Source of Dreams, they might still be able to catch on if another Will tried to encroach upon them- even if Noah was doing it as discreetly as he could!
So as his Pathogenic Will latched on to multiple Lines of Integration, he identified some that shone with brighter splendor than all others.
Out of all the Lines of Integration, 15 shone with utmost splendor as they represented existences that had integrated with many more Sources.
Noah could instinctively feel this as the truth!
And out of these 15, 9 Lines of Integration pulsed with shocking grandeur as Noah knew these were the strongest Nature Integration Realm existences who had bound themselves to the Source of Dreams.
Noah knew that Lilith was among these 9 as each of them shone with shocking levels of Intensity.
It was a shocking affirmation of power, but it also told Noah that out there in the 8 remaining Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum...there were 8 others at the same stage as Lilith!
And with even more accuracy, there were 8 others apart from Lilith nearing her power or having the same stage of power...who had also connected to the Source of Dreams.
There could be existences just as powerful or possibly more who simply did not integrate with the Source of Dreams!
Noah...had to carefully navigate all of this as his will had already begun descending down all of the Lines of Integration except for the 15 brightest ones and a few chosen exceptions like Eowyn.
This was because he didn't want to get caught so easily and so early!
He moved carefully as he discerned with Providence whether he would succeed or possibly alert the 15 most powerful existences if his Pathogenic will began to latch onto them.

He had many cards up his sleeves as just for now...he could afford to move with a level of care and caution when he obtained such a Reality breaking tool. He didn't need to get overconfident and slip up!
He focused on latching onto the dozens of Lines of Integration that represented Nature Integration Realm existences across the Dimensions and Desolate Mausoleum.
A distinction to keep in mind was that all Dimensional Rulers were Nature Integration experts, but not all Nature Integration Realm existences were Dimensional Rulers!
There were those in the Desolate Mausoleum, and there were even those within Dimensions that didn't take on the distinction of a Ruler!

But at this time, Noah cared not for who they were as apart from the strongest ones he didn't wish to alert, all others experienced a silent assault on their minds as a Quintessential Pathogenic Will surged forth.
At the same time, Noah continued to gaze upon the shocking boons all this provided him.

<Decretum of Dreams>:: ...Current Boosts granted to you after attaining Absolute Dream Authority and Integrating with the Source of Dreams- 5,000% Augmentation to True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values. Every time you fall into a slumber, there is a 100% chance to experience the Dream of the Oneiric that allows you to delve into the dreams and Realities of the possible immediate past and futures of selected targets. Even if an existence is exceedingly powerful and highly proficient in a Decreta or Natural Laws, so long as they are connected to the Source of Dreams, there is only a .01% chance of them perceiving your gaze. You can also freely utilize Absolute Dream Authority to the extent that your Soul can bear as through your connection to the Source of Dreams, all Damage containing Dream Essence of Absolute Dream Authority is nullified by 75%. A transformation of your Soul is currently occurring due to the Integration with the Source of Dreams as the result is yet to be quantified...>
Pristine wonders that Noah knew were not granted to others who had merely integrated with the Source of Dreams.

As someone who could view the Lines of Integration of others, he knew that their percentage augmentations were half of his as they didn't have free access to the utilization of Absolute Dream Authority, nor did they have 75% Nullification to anything related to the Decretum of Dreams!
It was an advancement that told Noah so long as he integrated the Source of Dreams into him...he did not have to be afraid of any Dimensional Rulers.
Their Values ranged in the Quadrillions, but he was steadily climbing up these values as well as he wasn't too far off from matching some of the truly strong Dimensional Rulers!
But to gauge his strength and truly understand which stage he was at...he would need to match himself against a genuine Nature Integration expert.
Not one that was near death and bound for him to kill.
Not against Abominations that he had a specific weapon against.
A genuine Nature Integration Realm expert!
And there was one place where he might just get his wish.

As his Will experienced the shocking connection to the Source of Dreams and he silently sent his Pathogenic Will to dominate over average Rulers, the reflection of events occurring from a far away Dimension played.

It was within the Quantum Dimension where vibrantly surging rings of light made a grandiose circular domain filled with rows of thrones- the most prominent beings from the 9 Dimensions filling up these thrones as due to the nature of the issue at hand, only Dimensional Rulers were here as their Suzerain Commanders or any others were not present!
It was why the side of Dream Dimensional Rulers was garnering the gazes of others as within their group, an existence that didn't have the aura of being integrated with Nature could be seen.
But those currently present chose not to say anything as the situation around the Dream Dimensional Rulers who had lost their home was too unique!
So nobody present said anything...but there were many more Rulers entering every few minutes.
And at this juncture, over a dozen auras of Rulers appeared all at once from afar as their auras vibrantly shone of Niflheim and Apollyon Dimensional Essence!

chapters.title: Chapter 2093 It Is Time! II
paragraphs: All Rulers had the right to participate in the Dimensional Conclave.
This included Dimensional Hellion Rulers as after her words in the blank void that used to be the Dream Dimension, many were under the impression that Lilith would not make her presence here!
Yet at this juncture, her devilish visage and charm appeared while backed behind with the auras of over a dozen Dimensional Rulers.
Among the Rulers with her, there was a wondrous diversity of Niflheim, Apollyon, and even Avalon Dimensional Rulers as she truly had her reach in many places!
Her arrival instantly caused the air to turn chilly as she was adorned in a crimson gold empress's robe that was inscribed with ecritures shining with Absolute Fundamental Authority.

Her head showed crimson black hair shimmering down brilliantly as the demonic horns were not currently present, her eyes shining with a violent light of calmness and power as she gazed at all those here.
The thrones of the Avalon Dimensional Rulers were still empty as her eyes breezed over this area and came to land on the thrones designated for the Dream Dimensional Rulers.
Here, her eyes shone with brightness as they locked onto a certain being!
The Rulers around her also followed her gaze as they locked onto the Dream Dimensional Rulers and the being in their midst.

One of the newly allied Undead Rulers in human form saw Lilith's gaze towards the Dream Dimensional Rulers and more specifically- the visage of Noah whose aura did not match the rest as soon after, his eyes flashed as he spoke.
He spoke as he simply wanted to show his loyalty to the being he had just allied with and took her motion of just looking as a sign!
<After failing to protect your Dimension, you even bring beings lesser than us here?>

The environment was simmering with authority and power with most beings talking amongst each other telepathically, but this unruly Niflheim Dimensional Ruler spoke out loudly and without decorum as many eyes turned towards this direction.
The eyes of this Ruler burned with flames of death as his words caused Noah's Dream Dimensional Chassis to turn and focus on him.

HOOONG!
A billowing and maddening aura began to leak from him as waves of power that were only around special existences began to rage around him!
It was the aura of a being that had closely integrated with Nature.
But this wasn't all!
The potency of the aura.

The potency was so dense that it seemed like it stemmed from an existence that had integrated with multiple Decreta and Laws- an existence whose Aura Potency exceeded even Rulers like the Niflheim Dimensional Ruler who had spoken so rudely seconds before!

The eyes of the Dream Dimensional Chassis shone with such unexpected grandeur and authority that the eyes of the Niflheim Dimensional Ruler felt a shocking pressure from it, the deathly flames within them being shaken just a little.
After all, the Haki of the Quintessential existence who had just bound an entire Source of Nature into himself was not to be trifled with!
<Hmph.>
BOOM!
A snort of authority rang out as the face of Lilith shone with displeasure.

Displeasure towards the Niflheim Dimensional Ruler who had spoken as she turned towards him and caused his elevated visage to dim, his head bowing down as he moved to the back of the group around Lilith with an ashen expression!

His intention to suck up had backfired as it had only exemplified the splendor of a certain being, a being that Lilith turned towards with her eyes utterly locking onto him and nobody else as she flew towards the thrones of the Dream Dimensional Rulers.
Rulers who became solemn at her actions their bodies blazed with power, but Lilith didn't make any moves apart from coming forward!
From afar, the hidden figures of the Quantum Dimension watched on with sharp eyes.
From the thrones of the Apollyon Dimension, the Supreme Pontiff Lucius watched on with interested eyes at what his sister was doing!
At the same time, the auras of more Rulers from the remaining Dimensions also began to arrive as even the Avalon Dimensional Rulers began to appear from afar.
During all this, Lilith's figure floated calmly as she arrived before the thrones of the Dream Dimension.
She gazed at Noah with such vibrant light and interest in her eyes that it was blinding, with the Dream Dimensional Rulers about to rise beside the thrones next to Noah as he...raised his hand.
HUUM!
And the Longest Dream, Dreamer of Providence...the Rulers of the Dream Dimension shockingly settled down and didn't make a move!
A simple action!
But it was an action that shocked many Nature Integration existences here as it seemed like this existence was being listened to by the Dream Dimensional Rulers!
Lilith had a dazzling smile and eyes full of power as floated ever close to the throne that Noah sat on.

The bodies of The Longest Dream and the Dreamer of Providence beside Noah pulsed with grand power as they stared forward, Noah himself calmly gazing into the eyes of Lilith as he tried to grasp this being!

This being that after coming face to face with him on the golden throne, she leaned in as her strands of hair fell over Noah's shoulders, her lips coming close to his ear as she whispered words only he could hear.
<You're the Dimensional Inimicus, aren't you?>
WAA!
Her voice was mesmerizing and directly only towards Noah as she didn't need to lean in and whisper in his ear like this- but the Dimensional Deceiver did as she wished as she had her own aims!
<I wonder what would happen...if I told everyone here that you are the enemy they're all seeking? An Irregular that is moving around doing as he wishes?>

chapters.title: Chapter 2094 It Is Time! III
paragraphs: Dangerous words were transmitted from Lilith to Noah while more and more Rulers arrived in this pristine location with vibrant spinning rings of light that released a light of majesty.
Multicolored milky stellar light pulsed from the many rings encircling the thrones representing the 9 Dimensions as the Rulers situated within or floating in space were emanating pristine authority.
Yet the gazes of many focused on the visage of Lilith at this juncture as among Dimensional Rulers, she was a unique one.
Those newly arriving also came across this scene as Guinevere arrived just in time to see Lilith whispering in Noah's ears
The scene caused her eyes to flash with brilliance as she turned to the Avalon Dimensional Chassis beside her coldly with brows raised!
Before she could even say anything, Noah sent a message to her alone as they floated towards their royal purple thrones.
<Don't worry. The Dimensional Deceiver is simply doing her thing...my promise with you still stands!>

When attaining the True ownership of the Sword of Avalon and the support of Guinevere while reaping the life of the Heliotrope Lion Emperor, the prerequisite was that Lilith and her forces would only be treated as enemies in the future!
Guinevere didn't want to see an Avalonian life lost because of an allegiance to a faction and then somehow in the future, they ally with that faction.
The actions of the Dimensional Deceiver could be misconstrued in many different ways, but very few actually had it correct in discerning that Lilith was actually making a threat currently!
At this moment, her astounding visage pulled away from Noah's side as she came to face him with her devilish smile.
She read his eyes that retained their utmost calm as if Noah did not at all take her threat seriously!
At this, her smile only became wider as she now sent a telepathic message without any flowery motions.

<No. That would be too boring. I don't want them to know...I don't want to aid them in any way whatsoever. Let them be blindsided by the Inimicus. Continue doing whatever it is you're doing as so far...the changing landscape you're contributing to has made many, many more things possible for me.>
Her words were chilling as they blazed with ingenuity, and she didn't leave it there as she continued!

<Whatever your involvement is in the disappearance of the Dream Dimension...it has made me more powerful than you can imagine. The disruption that caused Rulers to scramble and care about their own homes and even call this Dimensional Conclave allowed me to target and win over an entire Dimension without any interference. So truly...thank you and keep doing what you're doing. And if you're ever ready to sit down and have a chat...you know where I am.>
WAA!
With such words, her figure floated away to rejoin the many Dimensional Rulers that went towards the thrones designated for the Niflheim Dimension.

The figures of the two Traitorous Avalon Dimensional Rulers were under a close gaze by Morgana, Arthus, and other Avalon Rulers that came as at this junction, most Dimensional forces were here as all of them gazed at destiny and Providence for what would bloom during this Conclave.
The answer...was always not so easily discerned!

After leaving the area for the Dream Dimensional Rulers, Lilith nodded to the Rulers around her as they all went to sit in the thrones for the Niflheim Dimensional Rulers, her figure moving along to come to the area for Apollyon Dimensional Rulers as she didn't even gaze at the Supreme Pontiff, Lucius!
She didn't gaze at him or the Apollyon Dimensional Rulers around him as she grandly found a throne behind them and sat on it freely.

It was a unique scene to see as she could have chosen to sit at many places, but she sat alone surrounded by nobody else as her lone visage with an exceedingly beautiful face seemed extremely Desolate!
From the Fantasia Dimension, the woman Noah had seen before in the blank void of the old Dream Dimension appeared with 6 other Fantasia Dimensional Rulers.
The Seeker of Knowledge could also be seen on the side of Elysium with 5 other Elysium Rulers that shone with grand halos and wings of light!
HOOONG!
At this time, waves of multicolored light shone as on the thrones designated for Quantum Dimensional Rulers, 9 figures of varying sizes and forms appeared with grandeur.

Their Aura Potency was maddening to come across as they all released a light of power that wasn't achievable by normal Nature Integration Realm existences...and these weren't even the most powerful Rulers of the Quantum Dimension!

At their forefront was a man that showed a celestial charm. His skin shone with a multicolored stellar quantum glow as his eyes had triangular pupils that looked to contain layers of Grotto Havens. His hair danced with a calm multicolored glow as he emanated immense confidence and regality, the illusion of a solidified crown and the backbone of a throne barely visible behind and above him as vibrant ecritures swirled around his crown that read...
<INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR>
Insurmountable.
Impossible to overcome!
It was an existence that was a crucial figurehead of the Quantum Dimension, and he didn't stray at showing his Kainos Authority and title!

From afar, Lilith and others looked at this being with scrutiny and sharp expressions as he sat on the Throne as 8 other Rulers sat to his left and right, his body illuminating the surrounding rings of light as his voice echoed out on all sides.
<I welcome you all to the Conclave of Quintessence...though I do wish it was under better circumstances.>
WAA!
His voice was magnetized as his triangular pupils shone with glory and power.
His face was so regal that the very natural laws around him seemed to bubble and flourish!
<Before we begin...>
As his voice barely settled, another one just as vibrant rose up as the Dimensional Deceiver put her crimson tinted hand on her chin as she continued with a smile.

<...I wanted to affirm who would be leading the discussion of this Conclave. As the rulings of this Conclave will affect all Dimensions, it has to be a leading figure of these Dimensions to steer the discussion. I do not believe...that is you.>
WAA!
Her words were dangerous and laced with authority as the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR smiled back at her with a calm reply!
<Oh? And who else would be fit to be the voice of the Anchors?>
His voice was utterly calm as if he had expected all this, watching as Lilith smiled even brighter and replied to his question.

<Naturally...the one with the support of the majority within these Anchors. After so much time has passed, I believe it is time for there to be a change for such a being. The one that represents all Rulers and seeks what is best for the Anchors. The one that actually seeks for the survival and prosperity of all Dimensions...it would naturally be me.>
HUUUM!
Power and regality emanated from her words as the eyes of many beings shone in response.
The one who wanted to save all Dimensions!
The one who had the support of the vast majority of Rulers within Dimensions!
This...was Lilith?
She was a Dimensional Hellion Ruler.
She currently sat alone as even her own brother who also held the title of a Dimensional Hellion Ruler was surrounded by Apollyon Dimensional Rulers by his side!
Apart from the Rulers who followed her here from the Niflheim and Avalon Dimension, who would stand beside her?
HUUUM!
Providence began to surge.
The thrones of multiple designated Dimensions began to emanate shocking authority and light as at this juncture, Lilith used her fingers to tap on her throne!

chapters.title: Chapter 2095 It Is Time! IV
paragraphs: The one who had the support of the vast majority of Rulers within Dimensions!
Who would make a stand at this moment to show that they supported Lilith?
As if to answer this very question, Lilith tapped the throne she sat on as a ringing of authority echoed out.

At her beckoning, the auras closest to her actually rose as the visage of the Supreme Pontiff Lucius emanated grandeur, a smile etched upon his lips along with a devilish charm as his stellar crimson hair burned with demonic flames!

This Dimensional Hellion Ruler who should have been fighting for the hegemony of the Apollyon Dimension with his sister actually rose at her beckoning along with the Apollyon Dimensional Rulers beside him, all of them floating towards the throne Lilith sat on as they came to stand behind her.
The Supreme Pontiff himself came to stand beside Lilith's throne as he gave a nod of acknowledgment and gazed forward!
But this wasn't all.

The Rulers situated from the thrones of the Niflheim Dimension also stood up in a show of grandeur as they came towards Lilith's throne, their auras joining the Apollyon Dimensional Rulers as rows of Rulers begins to form behind Lilith in a grand show of power!
Yet in all this...
<So?>
The brows of the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR rose as he asked.
<So you have the support of your Home Dimension and the Niflheim Dimension...that is hardly the majority of Rulers from the Nine Dimensions.>
WAA!
The demonic eyes of Lilith flashed with even more grandeur as if she was waiting for this, her voice replying back with the same authority.
<Oh no, not Nine Dimensions. After the saddening loss of the Dream Dimension and its function as an Anchor, one just needs the majority of 8, and that...I do have.>
Before her words even ended, radiant blue auras as vast as endless Seas rose up from Fantasia!

The vibrant figure of the female Fantasia Dimensional Ruler Noah had seen in the void of the past Dream Dimension was at the forefront as she floated towards Lilith with Rulers in tow, her face full of smiles as she spoke with recognition at the demoness before her.
<Dimensional Queen.>
HUUM!
Dimensional Queen. Lilith had been called by this name before by this same being as those who were present at that time realized this was meant quite literally.
Fantasia, Niflheim, and Apollyon!

Lilith actually had reigns over three Dimensions as she even had lone Rulers from Avalon as part of her forces...and all eyes now gazed around at the remaining thrones to see if there would be any more surprises!
Prana, Mirror, Elysium, Avalon, and of course the thrones of the Dream and Quantum Dimensions were utterly still.
It was a tense moment as while rows of Nature Integration existences lined up behind her, Lilith crossed her legs pristine and spoke out.
<Let's say I have the support of just these three Dimensions. Who do you have backing you?>
Her words dripped of devilishness as beside the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR, a woman clad in a battle armor pulsing with waves of Absolute Fundamental Authority sneered as she replied in turn.
<You've already wasted a lot of our time...we have Quantum, Elysium, Mirror, Avalon, and Prana Dimensions behind us as the leading Dimension will not change based on some schemes!>
Authority raged as the eyes of many lit up. But Lilith smiled even wider as she didn't relent!
<Do you have it though? The support of Avalon, Prana, Elysium...and the Mirror Dimension?>
The pristine surroundings calmed.
The woman that had spoken shone with incandescent Aura Potency of Laws and Decreta as she waved her hands towards the respective Dimensions!
The ancient Rulers from the Prana Dimension sighed as they rose to show their support.
Pristine and beautiful Rulers from the Mirror Dimension rose and showed their support!
And....
That was all!
HOOONG!
Surging waves of Providence exploded at this moment as the Quantum Ruler who had just spoken had her eyes release flames of anger as she stared towards the Avalon and Elysium Dimensional Rulers!
She was one of the Four Quantum Emperors that guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
She was the Mikado of Old even though she stood beside the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR as she voiced out with sharp eyes at this moment.
<You all...what is the meaning of this?>
She may wonder the reasons for Avalon abstaining. But Elysium? They were the closest allies to the Quantum Dimension as they were the existences most knowledgeable on Destiny and Providence!
From the side of Avalon, Guinevere had a cold expression as she spoke out freely.
<We will abstain from choosing any sides until we hear what the discussion of this Conclave produces.>
Abstain.

The Avalon Dimension truly did so as the eyes of the Mikado of Old turned even sharper, her eyes and the eyes of many turning towards the Elysium Dimensional Rulers as from this side, a golden haired man beside the Seeker of Knowledge was the one to speak with regality and honor.

<The River of Providence foretells many things as we are currently unsure of the standing of the Quantum Dimension on the coming Cataclysm. Once this is clear, we will naturally stand with those that are with us.>
Words one would not expect from those who held a great deal of knowledge were spoken as the surroundings turned extremely tense!
<Oh my...>
At this juncture, Lilith's figure blazed with authority as she began to laugh sonorously, her voice echoing out with clear glee!
<It seems the majority do not stand with you. And since everyone here seems to love keeping things a mystery...I will illuminate everyone on the why...>
Destiny and Providence began to seethe as from the side of the Elysium Dimension, the Seeker of Knowledge gazed towards Lilith with shock as she had a thought.
'Did she know...?!'
A single thought.
And it was affirmed soon after as Lilith dropped an explosive bomb!
<The Ancestors have chosen not to interfere as everything goes towards destruction. They have abandoned us...and so has the Dimension with the only direct line of communication to them!>

A shocking piece of information was laid out at the beginning of the Dimensional Conclave as Lilith controlled the pacing, this meeting starting off with a bang as even more wonders were still to bloom!

The demonic eyes of Lilith flashed with even more grandeur as if she was waiting for this, her voice replying back with the same authority.
<Oh no, not Nine Dimensions.
After the saddening loss of the Dream Dimension and its function as an Anchor, one just needs the majority of 8, and that...I do have.>
Before her words even ended, radiant blue auras as vast as endless Seas rose up from Fantasia!

The vibrant figure of the female Fantasia Dimensional Ruler Noah had seen in the void of the past Dream Dimension was at the forefront as she floated towards Lilith with Rulers in tow, her face full of smiles as she spoke with recognition at the demoness before her.
<Dimensional Queen.>
HUUM!
Dimensional Queen.
Lilith had been called by this name before by this same being as those who were present at that time realized this was meant quite literally.
Fantasia, Niflheim, and Apollyon!

Lilith actually had reigns over three Dimensions as she even had lone Rulers from Avalon as part of her forces...and all eyes now gazed around at the remaining thrones to see if there would be any more surprises!
Prana, Mirror, Elysium, Avalon, and of course the thrones of the Dream and Quantum Dimensions were utterly still.
It was a tense moment as while rows of Nature Integration existences lined up behind her, Lilith crossed her legs pristine and spoke out.
<Let's say I have the support of just these three Dimensions.
Who do you have backing you?>
Her words dripped of devilishness as beside the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR, a woman clad in a battle armor pulsing with waves of Absolute Fundamental Authority sneered as she replied in turn.
<You've already wasted a lot of our time...we have Quantum, Elysium, Mirror, Avalon, and Prana Dimensions behind us as the leading Dimension will not change based on some schemes!>
Authority raged as the eyes of many lit up.
But Lilith smiled even wider as she didn't relent!
<Do you have it though?
The support of Avalon, Prana, Elysium...and the Mirror Dimension?>
The pristine surroundings calmed.
The woman that had spoken shone with incandescent Aura Potency of Laws and Decreta as she waved her hands towards the respective Dimensions!
The ancient Rulers from the Prana Dimension sighed as they rose to show their support.
Pristine and beautiful Rulers from the Mirror Dimension rose and showed their support!
And....
That was all!
HOOONG!
Surging waves of Providence exploded at this moment as the Quantum Ruler who had just spoken had her eyes release flames of anger as she stared towards the Avalon and Elysium Dimensional Rulers!
She was one of the Four Quantum Emperors that guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
She was the Mikado of Old even though she stood beside the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR as she voiced out with sharp eyes at this moment.
<You all...what is the meaning of this?>
She may wonder the reasons for Avalon abstaining.
But Elysium?
They were the closest allies to the Quantum Dimension as they were the existences most knowledgeable on Destiny and Providence!
From the side of Avalon, Guinevere had a cold expression as she spoke out freely.
<We will abstain from choosing any sides until we hear what the discussion of this Conclave produces.>
Abstain.

The Avalon Dimension truly did so as the eyes of the Mikado of Old turned even sharper, her eyes and the eyes of many turning towards the Elysium Dimensional Rulers as from this side, a golden haired man beside the Seeker of Knowledge was the one to speak with regality and honor.
<The River of Providence foretells many things as we are currently unsure of the standing of the Quantum Dimension on the coming Cataclysm.
Once this is clear, we will naturally stand with those that are with us.>
Words one would not expect from those who held a great deal of knowledge were spoken as the surroundings turned extremely tense!
<Oh my...>
At this juncture, Lilith's figure blazed with authority as she began to laugh sonorously, her voice echoing out with clear glee!
<It seems the majority do not stand with you.
And since everyone here seems to love keeping things a mystery...I will illuminate everyone on the why...>
Destiny and Providence began to seethe as from the side of the Elysium Dimension, the Seeker of Knowledge gazed towards Lilith with shock as she had a thought.
'Did she know...?!'
A single thought.
And it was affirmed soon after as Lilith dropped an explosive bomb!
<The Ancestors have chosen not to interfere as everything goes towards destruction.
They have abandoned us...and so has the Dimension with the only direct line of communication to them!>

A shocking piece of information was laid out at the beginning of the Dimensional Conclave as Lilith controlled the pacing, this meeting starting off with a bang as even more wonders were still to bloom!

chapters.title: Chapter 2096 I Shall Lead You!
paragraphs: <The Ancestors have chosen not to interfere as everything goes towards destruction. They have abandoned us...and so has the Dimension with the only direct line of communication to them!>
Her words began with a sneer as they ended with her voice rising ever higher with rage!
The Seeker of Knowledge and the Elysium Dimensional Rulers turned somber as they didn't expect Lilith to have already known this information this whole time.

The Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers watched on silently from their sections as this was something they knew- the former having been told by the Seeker of Knowledge as the latter were filled in by Noah!

Noah who at this time...was watching everything playing out with eyes full of shining grandeur as from his shocking actions with the Source of Dreams, he could feel his Pathogenic Will having silently latched on connecting to multiple Rulers within this Dimensional Conclave!
Yes!

Neural Encroachment was shockingly continuing with success without being found as with average Nature Integration Realm existences...why would they ever fear their connection to the Source of Dreams they had integrated to?
It created for a shocking phenomenon where Noah truly might just achieve an impossible and improbable thing as he watched how things unfolded here.

His Tri-Pupiled eyes were watching everything and silently trying to grasp who they were as among the people that gave him the gravest feelings of danger when gazing at them with Providence, there were 5 others apart from Lilith just in this Conclave.

The existence adorned with the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR title that had a calm look and a smile even at this juncture, two of the Rulers beside him, one billowing aura in the side of the Mirror Dimensional Rulers, and one ancient looking old man from the Prana Dimension!
An old man whose body brimmed with life and sighed while speaking up at this moment.
<CHARLEMAGNE...is this true?>
The voice was extremely old and filled with life as it was directed towards none other than the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.
CHARLEMAGNE!
This being was still calm amidst all this even though the Mikado of Old and the Mikado of Strength beside him looked angrily towards Lilith!
Even when two of the Four Quantum Emperors that guarded the Pylon of Ascension were enraged, he remained unfettered.
<Yes.>
His voice brimmed with power as it affirmed something that caused all those here to become enraged, some showing looks of shock and pain as everyone arose from their thrones!
The only ones to remain seated were the Elysium, Avalon, and Dream Dimensional Rulers...along with Lilith and the Quantum Dimensional Rulers!
The ancient Prana Dimensional Rulers stood up with somber gazes as the old man that had spoken sighed with life.
His verdant hair ran down to his shoulders as he opened his mouth to speak once more...but then shook his head as he sighed even more!
Shock permeated to all those who didn't know as Lilith took this time to blaze with authority and continue.

<Abandoned. I don't very much like this word as it makes us seem like sad and lost puppies...but it is true nonetheless. And following the lead of those who knew this and are letting things proceed by the Will of the Ancestors...I care not for this!>
HUUM!
<The Quantum Dimension has reigned strong for too many years. They have lost their direction just as the Ancestors...it is time to depose them from their high thrones.>
Grandiosity and valor spun from the Dimensional Queen as her exquisite figure was exemplified by power and rage!
Her eyes spat out flames of anger and regality as rows of Dimensional Rulers stood behind her while she spoke, her authority currently being unmatched as she used this time well.

<It is time to stop relying on the whims of others to protect us as we save our homes ourselves. It is time to take control of the Pylon of Ascension here and guard against whatever forces the Ancestors will send to ensure their will of Apocalypse on everything. In all this...I will lead you!>
BOOOM!
A war.
She was calling for a war with the Quantum Dimension as all those listening couldn't help but ponder.
<Hmph, unruly!>
The Mikado of Old snorted with displeasure as she rose up in anger, but CHARLEMAGNE raised his right hand as everything calmed.
His eyes released a light of serenity as he gazed at the far away Prana Dimensional Rulers that had lived nearly as long as him as his voice echoed out.
<The Ancestors have chosen this path, yes, but it does not mean they have abandoned us.>
His voice was magnetic as it ensnared many while it continued!

<They have set a path of Ascension that we have been preparing for this whole time...having collected enough resources to activate the Pylon of Ascension and send all Rulers and even their strongest Commanders through. The Ancestors have chosen for us to simply join them while the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum collapse into Oblivion.>
BOOOOM!
Shocking words that caused even Lilith to rise emanated out as they shook the whole Conclave!
Ascension!

The Ancestors wished for them to ascend and leave everything behind as the Quantum Dimension had prepared enough Resources to send all Rulers and their strongest Commanders through the Pylon of Ascension!
The Prana Dimensional Rulers heard these words as they sighed even more with ancientness.
Lilith became even more enraged as she bellowed out with maddening yet contained authority thereafter!
<All Rulers and their Commanders? You would damn the countless other lives in all Dimensions and the Dimensions themselves while running away?>
She spoke out words that the Seeker of Knowledge and Guinevere were also about to bellow out as Guinevere in particular had a look of great pain while gazing at all this!
The Pylon of Ascension was not something one could simply pass through.

Massive resources were required to do so as they didn't know how long they had been preparing to do so, but the Quantum Dimensional only had enough resources for Rulers and their strongest Suzerain Commanders!
Even this was a shocking feat as throughout history, very rarely had any beings apart from True Emperors freely left the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum!

chapters.title: Chapter 2097 The Empress Graces The Masses! I
paragraphs: Rage and power flowed all around as the calm voice of CHARLEMAGNE rang out to reply to Lilith.

<There are sacrifices made for everything, and the Pylon of Ascension cannot in any way take countless creatures across. Nobody weaker than a Suzerain would even be able to survive as in this...they shall simply follow the circle of life and death. Oh, and do not misunderstand...>
His triangular pupils released radiant and shocking light as in his calmness, a level of Tyranny rose as well!
<...All Rulers and their strongest Commanders, yes. But only those Rulers who stand with us. You and your Lineage that has continued to be unruly...are not among those on the list for Ascension.>
BOOOM!
<Any Rulers that follow behind you...will also be stricken from that list unless they feel a sudden and a great change of heart on where their allegiances lie.>
Boundless waves of Tyranny rose and whipped around madly as this being attacked with words alone, yet the damage was utterly catastrophic as it threatened the very dominion Lilith had built!
<Haha...>
And her eyes...burned with great anger at such a juncture as she laughed with rage.

<You choose who joins you for Ascension, you damn the Dimensions and countless lives within them...where in all this do you see yourselves as saviors? Where in all this do you see yourself standing as the voice of good and reason?>
Her aura rose.
The aura of Rulers behind her rose in conjunction as not a single one faltered from the words that CHARLEMAGNE had spoken out as if they had expected this!
Yet this existence remained unfettered as his history was too deep.
His power was too great.
<O Child of Hatred.>
HUUM!
His triangular pupils release a horrific light of power that didn't stem from Natural Laws or Decreta as his gaze turned exceedingly cold at this moment.
<Do not mistake my calmness for weakness, nor should you believe that I do not move against you because I cannot.>
WAA!
<Just like your father all those years ago...I deny you and everything about your Lineage. Your charade of playing Ruler and Commander will soon come to an end.>

Lilith's beautiful face contorted greatly at these words as calmness, rage, and madness rose and fell in her eyes in waves, but CHARLEMAGNE continued as his multicolored hair danced with abundant authority!
He gazed at the masses of Rulers as his eyes came to focus upon the thrones designated to Prana, Mirror, Avalon, Elysium, and even the Dream Dimensional Rulers.
<This is the Will passed down and the stance of the Quantum Dimension. Now that you know...what choice shall you make? Where do you stand?>
Fearless.
His triangular pupils shone with grand power as the way he spoke showed he didn't care whether they stood with the Quantum Dimension or against it!
That no matter their choice, things would unfold the way that they wish!
With his terrifying gaze passing over everyone, Guinevere was the first one to rise up and stare with a hint of anger and distaste towards this special existence.

<What you are calling for is genocide. Genocide against the very Dimensions we took as our home and the countless existences within it! What is the Avalon Dimension without its Avalonians? What is any Dimension without the people that make it? You would discard them as if their wills do not matter?!>
Her words were filled with anger as a purple luster of royalty swirled around her.

Morgana and the other Avalon Dimensional Rulers stood beside her to show their support as this whole time, the Imperius Avallonis remained seated- his hands resting on the hilt of the Sword of Avalon as he watched everything happening with a sharp gaze!
At Guinevere's words, CHARLEMAGNE only spared her a glance as he didn't even reply, continuing to gaze at the other Rulers.
The side of the Mirror Dimensional Rulers was quiet as a woman with mesmerizing silver hair remained seated, her gaze difficult to read as her glazed eyes rose up and replied with a sigh.
<The Mirror Dimension will follow the Will of the Ancestors.>
Providence surged as at this juncture, the Essence of Entropy uniquely began to build up with denseness in the surroundings!
CHARLEMAGNE merely nodded towards the Rulers of the Mirror Dimension as his gaze continued to the Elysium Dimensional Rulers that had somber expressions.
A golden haired man with a dense halo of light around him sighed as he spoke up.

<Elysium follows the Will of Providence that binds all Dimensions and Realities...and we fear Providence is not in line with the Will of the Ancestors. After all...they did seal and weaken it greatly with Anchors like all Natural Laws, we just never expected for them to choose its destruction even though Providence no longer affects them.>
WAA!

Shocking words echoed out from this being as the Seeker of Knowledge beside him affirmed the Will of all Elysium Rulers- while at the same time...a hint of truth as to the design of the Anchors and the Desolate Mausoleum was revealed!
The suppression of the very fabric of Reality!
No longer affected by Natural Laws!

These words caused Noah's eyes to illuminate greatly while he listened to all this, many things began to fall in line as he imagined why the Ancestors did what they did so many years ago...and why they chose to let the Apocalypse of all things proceed now.
A lot more information was needed to affirm everything, but CHARLEMAGNE once more did not stall nor say anything as his eyes only revealed disappointment while turning towards the Prana Dimension.
The Aged man that had spoken to CHARLEMAGNE locked eyes with him as these existences knew each other closely.
They had known each other before they even became Rulers as many Ages had come and gone!
<CHARLEMAGNE...you know our roots in the aspects of life itself. What exactly did you expect me to do in all this? Did you truly expect me to go against my very nature?>
Prana.
The Dimension of life.
Could it really bear the colossal loss of life that would come if things came to pass?
Another choice was made as at this juncture as with this, CHARLEMAGNE couldn't help but close his eyes for a brief second.

The choice that was just made by the ancient existence from the Prana Dimension seemed to have affected him more than anyone else as he took a moment before he opened his eyes again, his triangular pupils holding even greater coldness as his voice boomed out.
<What about you all?>
He spoke as his gaze went away from the vibrant Dimensional thrones.
He glazed over the Dream Dimensional Rulers as if their input simply did matter as his eyes were actually in a different place entirely!
If he wasn't directing his words towards the Dimensional Rulers...then who exactly was he referring to?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2098 The Empress Graces The Masses! II
paragraphs: CHARLEMAGNE.
He wasn't one of the Four Quantum Emperors that guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
And yet his distinction was even more pristine as he had the title of the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR!
He had close connections with some of the oldest and strongest Dimensional Rulers as even now, two Mikados sat beside him while the other two were currently not present in this location.
Over the years, he had not taken any titles while always being seen as one of the pillars of the Quantum Dimension.
An existence of extreme power as he was at the same stage as Lilith...if not exceeding her!

He alone had navigated the Dimensional Conclave and steered it to where it was currently along with Lilith as after listening to the Wills of the Dimensional Rulers and whether they would follow the Ancestors, he voiced out while gazing in a certain direction of the surging golden rings!
<What about you all?>
A question as if there were still others whose opinion mattered apart from Rulers!
It was a question that instantly caused Lilith's eyes to shine dangerously as she also gazed at a certain location.
Silence reigned for a brief second before an exceedingly resonant and sonorous voice full of regality and wonder bloomed out.
<Even we get a say in all this?>
A vibrant voice.
A voice that was accompanied by the fabric of Reality tearing apart and releasing the visage of a woman of extreme wonder.

Dark hair drizzled past her shoulders as she was adorned in a white battledress that pulsed with Absolute Fundamental Authority, radiance overflowing around her as the very essence of Laws in the surroundings became agitated at her appearance.
Her eyes were luminous as if they could gaze at the truth of nature, a smile ever present on her face as she seemed to emanate warmth and wonder!
It was The Empress!
Such an existence had actually appeared and graced those here with her presence!

CHARLEMAGNE did not look surprised at her appearance while other Dimensional Rulers rose up with vibrant authorities- and this was because besides this woman, four other extremely powerful auras accompanied her.

The grand figures of Aegon and Althea were among them, the other two being radiant Emperors as the valiant visage of The Invigilator, Ezekiel being seen with radiant silver white hair as even closer to the woman at the forefront was the Eminent Mastermind, Noah!

His words were terrifying as off to the side, Lilith burned with rage as she couldn't help but bellow out.
<Are you fucking kidding me? Are you truly consorting with the opinion of Tribunal Rulers at this juncture?!>

BOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2099 The Fractured Dimensions! I
paragraphs: <The Primordials aim for the end of Anchors, and that is the Will of the Ancestors as in this aspect...they can be considered allies.>
Terrible words!
Words that caused many Dimensional Rulers to seethe as the Dream Dimensional Rulers were staring at Althea and Aegon with immense bloodlust!

They had just fought these existences and even lost a Ruler to them as they were the cause of a hastened destruction to their Dimension, and now they would be made allies with the strongest Dimension that should have been using its resources to protect them?!
Lilith seemed so maddened and overflowing with rage that her crimson tinted visage was trembling with authority, but CHARLEMAGNE continued as he came to lock his gaze with The Empress.

<What the Ancestors wish for is the natural end of the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum, not their disappearance. Whatever force is moving and veiling the Dream Dimension...we will soon locate it and erase it.>
<Oh?>
The Empress spoke in question to the certainty in the words of CHARLEMAGNE as if they already had means up their sleeves!

<Yes. But it is also crucial for me to make another distinction. It is not just the Anchors...but also the Desolate Mausoleum that needs to face its natural end. This is the most important aspect of the Will of the Ancestors.>
The Empress smiled brilliantly and nodded at this as her clear eyes shone while she replied.

<...On this, we have a difference of opinions. The Desolate Mausoleum will be freed from its Anchors and regain its former glory. Its main destination is not destruction. So we agree with the Will of the Ancestors in some aspects...and disagree in others.>

Immense silence descended in the surroundings as from the thrones of the Apollyon Dimension, Lilith's visage was simmering with wrath and power as her demonic eyes locked onto The Empress at this time!
The Empress...who smiled and caused the natural laws around her to flourish as she continued.

<How about this? The Barren Lands are filled with uncertainties and enemies. Why don't we focus on what we do agree on first and achieve the natural end of all Anchors? Then we can put all our cards on the table for the Desolate Mausoleum and see where the rivers of destiny and Providence flow.>
What made The Empress such a renowned and terrifying figure in the Age of Destiny?
It was said that apart from the Eminent Mastermind, Noah, who stood beside OPPENHEIMER to scheme- she was the woman behind the Empyral Deceiver who came up with the most terrifying of schemes!
Some Rulers even believed that part of the success that OPPENHEIMER had was due to the woman by his side.

That The Empress had a major part to play as part of the reason for the Death of Hatred and many other accomplishments OPPENHEIMER had...she had a hand to play in them whether they were small or large.

And now, she came to the Dimensional Conclave as the unbelievable end result of possibly forming an alliance with the strongest Dimension at that...she actually wanted to bring such a Reality to fruition.
<You are confident in your means, O Providential Empress.>
HUUUM!
CHARLEMAGNE spoke with grandiosity from his throne as the Mikado of Old and Strength pulsed with power beside him.

<But we are even more confident in our own power. For the smoothness of achieving the natural end of all Anchors...the Primordials shall be among those following the Will of the Ancestors and thereby- our momentary allies.>
Destiny and Providence exploded out as at the same time, the concentration of Entropy that had been building up this whole time became ever potent!
The Rulers from Dream, Avalon, Prana, Elysium, Fantasia, Niflheim, and Apollyon felt their Aspects of Existence pulse with danger at a shocking course of events!
The Mirror Dimensional Rulers that had allied with the Quantum Dimension had solemn expressions due to their choice, but they stood firm as the Quantum Dimension began to blaze with glory.
<How fickle the resolve of Rulers can be.>
Lilith's voice boomed out as her body was armed with power and authority.
She was seemingly ready to make a move as the Rulers of multiple Dimensions backing her also began to blaze with phantasmal authority!

<What exactly do you expect to happen now? After countless billions and Trillions of years of history of the 9 Anchors, you will actually end it all in this Age? Fight and kill each other for the Wills of others?>
Her gaze was chilly as it was focused on CHARLEMAGNE and The Empress!
CHARLEMAGNE who glanced at Lilith once more and spoke coldly.

<Ages come and go, each one bringing about its own changes. In this Age, we shall end things and join the Ancestors as the first course of action for this Dimensional Conclave...is to find and execute the Dimensional Inimicus that is capable of displacing and veiling Dimensions.>
It was a shocking turn of events as the agenda of the Conclave was set to first aim its extremely sharp sword towards a certain enemy.
An enemy who could displace Dimensions!
CHARLEMAGNE had spoken with confidence that they would soon locate and erase this force as...exactly how did they plan to do this?
<The one capable of doing this is->
HOOONG!
CHARLEMAGNE had begun to speak when all of sudden, his eyes released a cold light as his gaze and the gazes of many beings changed.
The surroundings also churned up and began to bubble with the Essence of Natural Laws, Entropy still pervading everything with greater concentrations as rivers of it began to form!

Everything began to shake and buzz as all the Rulers here with a certain connection to the Avalon Dimension...felt its Source becoming veiled from their eyes as all others felt their power rise to even greater levels due to their Integration into Natural Laws!
It could only mean one thing.
The existence they were just talking about...had made a move once more as this time, it was shockingly the Avalon Dimension!
Another Anchor had just lost its function!

chapters.title: Chapter 2100 The Fractured Dimensions! II
paragraphs: Guinevere felt the change quicker than everyone else the moment that the Avalon Dimension completely finished being displaced as internally, she gave a sigh of relief!
After the events of this Dimensional Conclave, every Dimension had to be fearful of what was to come as Avalon Dimension...would now be protected and hidden under the Imperius Avallonis!
But this was internally.
Externally, her face became livid as she bellowed out with a fearsome draconic roar, Absolute Avalon Authority raging as she called out!
<Avalon!>
Her bellow affirmed many things for all others as they momentarily felt the Source of Avalon tremble, and now one of its core Rulers bellowed out as she didn't stop there.

Guinevere's face was livid as Morgana, Arthus, and others rose up with similar looks as even the Imperius Avallonis...he seemed to be grasping the Sword of Avalon tighter as his gaze was solemn and drawn down.
<While you all scheme and plan here, my very home has been taken as I shall not sit idle any longer!>
Authority bloomed as a spatial light began to wrap around the Avalon Dimensional Rulers.
The environment here was too tense and dangerous currently as they could utilize this chance to leave and reorganize
But...
HOOOONG!
A terrifying authority erupted from CHARLEMAGNE and the Mikado of Old and Strength as it erased any authority from the Avalon Dimensional Rulers.
With a cold gaze, CHARLEMAGNE voiced out.
<Nobody may leave this Conclave.>
BOOM!
The beautifully radiant multicolored rings of light around everyone pulsed as they began to spin.

The very fabric of Reality around them vibrated as space itself seemed to be getting carved out as the rings of light spun, dazzling Absolute Quantum Authority and Absolute Relativity Authority wrapping around everything in a show of wonder!
<We are isolated from space and time at this moment as nobody may leave until we come to an understanding.>
The resonant voice emerged again as the bodies of all Rulers were already blazing with authority and prepared for anything.
<What understanding? Do you truly want a war? Do you want to fracture the very bonds of Dimensions today as you what, hasten the destruction of all Dimensions yourselves?!>
Lilith's booming voice echoed out at this moment as her Will was also very much focused around a certain Imperius Avallonis, many thoughts surging within her as she made her preparations!
<We remain here for no other reason than the Dimensional Inimicus and the displacement of Dimensions.>
The sonorous voice of none other than The Empress rang out as the 4 Tribunal Rulers beside her remained floating like unbreakable pillars.
She gazed towards CHARLEMAGNE with a smile as she continued.
<You suspect that the Dimensional Inimicus is here? Among us in all this as he hides in plain sight?>
BOOM!
Her eyes shone with ingenuity as she asked.
And CHARLEMAGNE gave a light nod as he gazed towards Lilith and then multiple areas within this dazzling circular enclosure!

<Yes. The possibilities are limited in the Barren Lands as The Enders of Reality come to the top of the list, and we have already sent out Rulers to affirm this in the Desolate Mausoleum. As for those here...we have discerned that those with a connection to the Dimensional Inimicus are here as I shall seek cooperation from you all to affirm this and erase any suspicion.>
<Cooperation?>
The ancient voice of the existence from the Prana Dimension rang out with age and life as CHARLEMAGNE nodded.
<Yes. Just open your Souls to a search of Providence, be cleared of any association, and go do what you wish.>
Open your souls.
A simple and yet extremely complex thing to do as one had to essentially leave themselves defenseless while another probed with Providence whether they knew a specific set of information!
<Haha....>
The demonic laughter of Lilith resounded at such a juncture as CHARLEMAGNE ignored it and continued!
<And we shall start with those most recently affected by the Dimensional Inimicus as well as the one being openly opposed to us...The Apollyon, Dream, and Avalon Dimensions.>
WAA!
Providence raged as the targets were set.
Lilith was under suspicion due to her open opposition, while the Dream Dimension was the one that was first affected!
Now, the Avalon Dimension was added to this as all gazes fell on them.
<I see.>
Lilith nodded as her humanoid form slowly began to transform into a valiant demonic figure.
<You truly did just want a war. You should've said that early and not gone about this in such a roundabout way.>
HUUUM!
The Rulers around her pulsed with authority and rallied around her as in pure numbers, The Rulers behind Lilith exceeded any other party here!
<The 9 Dimensions have strived together for eons and carried out a mission handed down by those before us.>
Providence surged around her as her visage began to enlarge and grow with power.

<We have now been abandoned by those very same Ancestors as we must fight with our lives on the line to ensure not just our safety...but the safety of the very Dimensions we called homes! This...is not something I can do alone, so I shall openly seek aid from you all to fight for our homes.>
Her words extended to the Prana and Elysium Dimensional Ruler as well as Avalon and Dream!
The Dimensional Queen truly centered herself as the point of opposition as at this moment, the balance and workings of the Dimensions were on the brink.
At such a time, CHARLEMAGNE rose from his throne while shaking his head.

<You still do not understand. It is not a matter of enemies and allies any longer. It is not a matter of if the Dimensional Inimicus displacing Dimensions will perish or if the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum will meet their end. It is a forgone conclusion...it is only a matter of when all of this occurs.>
WAA!

<This is because it involves something so much larger and greater. It involves the Will of the Ancestors in the past and the Ancestors now...and these beings wish to protect and assure their interests. Do you know why there are only two Mikados here today? They are guarding the Pylon of Ascension as usual, but today...they are also preparing a welcoming ceremony.>

Lilith was under suspicion due to her open opposition, while the Dream Dimension was the one that was first affected!
Now, the Avalon Dimension was added to this as all gazes fell on them.
<I see.>
Lilith nodded as her humanoid form slowly began to transform into a valiant demonic figure.
<You truly did just want a war.
You should've said that early and not gone about this in such a roundabout way.>
HUUUM!
The Rulers around her pulsed with authority and rallied around her as in pure numbers, The Rulers behind Lilith exceeded any other party here!
<The 9 Dimensions have strived together for eons and carried out a mission handed down by those before us.>
Providence surged around her as her visage began to enlarge and grow with power.
<We have now been abandoned by those very same Ancestors as we must fight with our lives on the line to ensure not just our safety...but the safety of the very Dimensions we called homes!
This...is not something I can do alone, so I shall openly seek aid from you all to fight for our homes.>
Her words extended to the Prana and Elysium Dimensional Ruler as well as Avalon and Dream!
The Dimensional Queen truly centered herself as the point of opposition as at this moment, the balance and workings of the Dimensions were on the brink.
At such a time, CHARLEMAGNE rose from his throne while shaking his head.
<You still do not understand.
It is not a matter of enemies and allies any longer.
It is not a matter of if the Dimensional Inimicus displacing Dimensions will perish or if the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum will meet their end.
It is a forgone conclusion...it is only a matter of when all of this occurs.>
WAA!
<This is because it involves something so much larger and greater.
It involves the Will of the Ancestors in the past and the Ancestors now...and these beings wish to protect and assure their interests.
Do you know why there are only two Mikados here today?
They are guarding the Pylon of Ascension as usual, but today...they are also preparing a welcoming ceremony.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2101 The Fractured Dimensions! III
paragraphs: <...Do you know why there are only two Mikados here today? They are guarding the Pylon of Ascension as usual, but today...they are also preparing a welcoming ceremony.>
Words that even caused the smile on The Empress to fade were uttered as everything became exceedingly silent.
Only the raging aura potency of multiple Rulers reigned Supreme as the verdant hairs on the ancient Prana Dimensional Ruler that had been vocal this entire time rose in waves.
He was known as Albus.
One of the first generations of trees to sprout in the Prana Dimension.
He was an existence full of experience and wonder as his power could be veiled in ways others could not even imagine.
CHARLEMAGNE had spoken to him directly as they knew each other when they were very young, and very few could say they truly knew his power as he was among the Rulers that were simply unfathomable!
But even he turned somber when he heard CHARLEMAGNE's words.
<The Ancestors are so intent on letting everything end that they would even send others to descend? To become tainted by the Natural Laws and decreta once more?>
Albus couldn't help but ask.
CHARLEMAGNE retained his calm gaze as he replied.

<It is a heavy task for the Ancestors to descend, it is why I want you all to realize the gravity of this situation for them. It is why I want to tell you all not to fight against an unstoppable force. Those coming are existences that may have been True Emperors of a past Age, their colleagues, or even more frighteningly...a First Generation Ancestor. Even I do not know. What I do know is that all resistance is futile. What I know is that once they descend...this Age of Quintessence will become more tumultuous and cataclysmic than even the Age of Chaos, or any other destructive Ages past!>
WAA!
A True Emperor of a Past Age!
Any variation of an Ancestor!
It was a terrifying thought as even the hearts of the strongest Rulers would feel strained at this.
So much so that...
BZZZT!
Auras blazed in the designated thrones of the Apollyon Dimension.

Among those behind Lilith, multiple Rulers suddenly flew out and went towards the side of the Quantum Dimension as a Niflheim Dimensional Ruler with flaming eyes and a skull turned around and spoke with a somber tone.

<You told us before that you would never ask us to lay down our lives for you. We do not wish to lay them down now as we...shall follow the Will of the Ancestors. We cannot stand against them if they are truly descending!>
Deserters began to appear.
It was a development that was to be expected in the face of immense power!
As existences that had integrated with the very fabric of Nature and reached such a height of power, would they truly sacrifice it all just for their Dimension and the countless lives within?
It required a sense of great duty or personal belief to be able to stand against certain death to fight for what one believed!
CHARLEMAGNE said nothing at the Rulers changing sides as his focus was on Lilith and the Dream and Avalon Dimensional Rulers.
<Will you open your Souls the easy way...or shall we do it the hard way?>
A bold question that caused Lilith to burn with even more hatred.
So much hatred that she was about to bellow out when-
BOOOM...CRACK!
An extremely heavy and explosive sound rang out as the rotating multicolored rings of light that encircled this domain and everyone in it...a portion of them ripped and ruptured!
It was an action so out of line that even the Mikado and CHARLEMAGNE looked up with sharp lights in their eyes that showed even they didn't expect this.
After all, they were locked away from space and time as even Rulers of Lilith's caliber would need some time to break through.

As for others locating this domain deep in the Quantum Dimension? This was even more of an impossibility as even though the space they were in was vast, it was currently contained in a single speck of dust smaller than an atom that was floating in the multicolored hazy space of the Quantum Dimension!
Yet now...
<<What a lively cluster of food this is.>>
HOOONG!
From the ruptured ring of light, a claw came in and tore everything open and even wider as the beastial head of a dragon came on soon after.

A dragon whose scales from head to toe crackled with equal concentrations of Absolute Fundamental Authorities of Entropy and Manadynamics as ten pairs of wings radiantly lined up behind its back, its visage stepping into this space as its aura potency...was shockingly at the same level as Lilith, the Mikado, and even CHARLEMAGNE!

It was a new entrant that caused all Rulers to gaze with a sense of incredulity as in an already chaotic Conclave that had too many participating parties...another one was seemingly making an entrance now!
And shockingly...the aura was that of an Ender of Reality.
A Primordial Beast!
Its eyes blazed with authority as it gazed at the masses of Sealers and Apostates.
Sealers.
Those who chose to oppress and seal the very home that nurtured them.
Apostates.
Those who chose to shatter its consciousness into countless pieces.
But they did not know...that Reality had been steadily strengthening itself even with its Will fractured.
Even with its will spread out across the countless blooming Realities, it still grew in power!
The Primordial Beasts came to be as they stemmed from the power of Reality itself, being born from the Primordial Seas and Seas of RUINATION within the very fabric of Reality.
Even then, Primordial Beasts were looked down upon!
They couldn't rise in power as much as those who had been living in Anchors this whole time.
Not from the end of one Age to another.
But Reality was still successful in attaining multiple Nature Integration Enders as it could easily integrate natural laws into Beasts that could handle it!
But then not too long ago...Anchors began to lose their power.
And even more recently, an Anchor had fully lost its function as the power that Reality gained...was not fathomable even in the mind of the Sealers and Apostates!
After lying dormant and collecting its power this whole time, this new explosive burst of strength caused Reality to make moves in ways not even possible before.
Like learning about the meeting of Sealers in one place.
After all, they schemed and plotted within the bounds of Reality.
Within the fabric of Reality! How could they escape the eyes of Reality itself?!
And so it had waited at the designated location with the others.
They had to strike at the perfect time as even though one Anchor had lost its function, the power of Reality was still greatly restricted!
But then moments ago...another Anchor was lifted off its function.
Even in its half-slumbering state, Reality had managed to gaze upon the being responsible for this.
He was veiled uniquely, but even he moved within the bounds of Reality as even he...could not escape its gaze.
And with the Seal of another Anchor being lifted, the power that Reality could release was that much more immense as they did not need to wait for a perfect moment any longer!
So now, the First Ender of Entropy and Mana pushed its claws across the rings of essence as its draconic eyes gazed upon the masses.
At the Sealers and Apostates.
And as the rest of its brethren tore open this domain ever wider and began to appear beside him.
As the Second, Third, and Fourth Enders of Entropy and Mana appeared.
As the First to the Tenth Enders of Gravitation lined up further behind them.
As the First Ender of Providence watched in the back.

As many Enders of Nature appeared....the First Ender of Entropy and Mana echoed out as its body began to overflow with power and its jaws opened to release a Dragon's Breath that could erase Nature itself.
<<Reality sends its regards.>>
