chapters.title: Chapter 2102 The Cruel Reality! I
paragraphs: A Lineage that didn't quite get their footing in the Desolate Mausoleum and Nine Dimensions even though they were constructs born from the very fabric of Reality.
Their sole purpose was to return Reality to how it was as they moved with autonomy before, but now...Reality itself was taking a great deal of control!
Control over one of its weapons as with the recent rounds of unsealing, terrifying Enders of Nature were born.

A distinction that was now relevant not just to Enders of Reality who had attained Nature Integration- with a shocking difference now being the augmentation of a specific natural law to birth Enders of Nature!
Thus, the Enders of Entropy and Mana were born.

Then the Enders of Providence, Relativity...many variations of Enders rose as now, their grandeur was being put on full display as they launched an unexpected Siege against the most powerful existences within all Dimensions and even those currently overseeing the Main Reality!
It was an unexpected phenomenon that nobody truly expected, but once it occurred...
<Haha!>
Lilith laughed madly from her position as her body overflowed and exploded with power.
CHARLEMAGNE's figure released a resonant light as the Mikados around him also moved, the many Quantum Dimensional Rulers exploding out with power as multicolored grandeur overflowed!
The Empress and the Tribunal Rulers...their party was even more pristine as all around them...
SHAAA!
Legions of robust and glistening dark gray Abominations began to appear en masse.
Their stature and power seemed to be much greater than any other Abominations as the aura potency of 4 in particular was utterly dreadful!
They all blazed with authority as their power and claws came to be pointed towards the Enders of Nature that continued to pour into the massive rapture from above.

This was the shocking scene blooming out as even at this juncture, some still had the roles of observers as while trying to see how he could best reap benefits from this event and location, Noah was exposed to the power of Rulers firsthand to allow him to quantify just what power they had all reached.
This was because whatever Quadrillions they could dish out in Damage Values just a day ago, they could now have an output much greater after the elevation of the Laws of Reality!
So this...was a perfect opportunity to learn as he himself prepared.
He also didn't have a long period of time as he gazed at everything quickly!
And what he came to find...
The terrifying waves of a few Quadrillion Damage Values were minimal.

Most Rulers on an average scale currently showed a quantified value above 10 Quadrillion as those at the stage of Lilith, CHARLEMAGNE, and the Enders of Entropy and Mana...their power was scaled much greater than this value as their means were grand!
As for the Enders of Nature...
The Ender of Providence continued to remain outside of the rapture as shockingly, more and more Enders than previously seen continued to pour in.
Enders of Polarity. Enders of Strong Nuclear Force. Enders of Relativity!

The Visage of the Ender of Providence was singular and veiled as it seemed to watch everything occurring and only direct it all as with the number of Enders they sent here today....they truly came to hold a grand massacre!

The most powerful and ridiculously buffed Enders of Entropy and Mana that held the two most offensive Fundamental Natural Laws...their bodies released Values reaching tens of Quadrillions as even the fabric of Reality was erased before their grandeur.
And yet even amidst all this...Noah did not receive the prompt of his two Clones here entering the Point of Death and Rebirth.
Why was this?
When creatures as terrifying if not more terrifying than the most powerful Rulers appeared to target everyone here, why were his Clones not put in danger?!

His own power had increased immensely after his Base Values exploded due to the formation of the Fifth and Sixth Dimensional Layers, and they exploded further when integrating with the Source of Dreams by receiving a ridiculous boost of 5,000% Augmentation!
His output also exceeded average Nature Integration Realm existences currently as he could easily dish out over 10 Quadrillion with his skills.
He had grown far in a period of a day as even this...he knew was still not enough to withstand the terrors before him.
So his Avalon Dimensional Chassis rose while grasping the Sword of Avalon while his Dream Dimensional Chassis stood up with the Rulers around it.
He wanted to make gains from this event while understanding the many mysteries that covered it as far, far away from here...his Main Body was still forging ahead.

The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality underwent yet another round of robust elevation in a short period of time as above the massive planar layer of Dreams, another equally massive and radiant purple layer of Avalon was forged!

Incandescent purple Cosmos could be seen spinning with Seas of purple essence around them, idyllic floating landmasses stretched throughout this vast plane as uniquely, the most radiant idyllic floating landmass was not present within this reformed Avalon Dimension.
Insula Avallonis was actually found in a different location as Suzerain Avallonis Beasts currently gazed around in shock at the depths of the Dimensional Holy Land.

The domain that currently had even greater concentrations of Natural Laws as truly...swirling particles of the Essence of these Laws were surging in a maddening fashion as one could very easily mistake this place for an Empyral Domain of Nature!
Within Insula Avallonis, Lancelot was among the very few beings present who gazed at everything in disbelief as he questioned just who the being he had walked into the Avalon Dimension days ago was.

He brought him towards his father since his intuition had told him this was the being who would aid them- he just didn't expect the extent to be this much and for it to occur in such a short period of time!
He wanted to seek for him and approach him in this location but...the concentration of essences was currently so dense and heavy that even he couldn't move freely.
Part of the reason for this was the Dimensional Holy Land.

Another reason...was the billowing aura budding at the center of the Dream Dimension far below the Holy Land where at this juncture, Noah was already in the process of Integrating the Source of Avalon as he wasted no time!

The figure of Eowyn was off to the side stabilizing her completely reformed Haven as she breathed out in shock, where even she remained still while watching Noah's figure that was surrounded by surging Absolute Authorities while he achieved improbable things.

His stellar humanoid visage pulsed with Six vibrant Dimensional Layers as his Aspects of Existence pulled upon a Source through the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality- this fantastical construct of his that at this juncture...
<Master.>
Interrupted Noah in this extremely crucial moment.
And it had to do so.
<We have been discovered.>
HOOONG!

Noah's eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor opened with grandiosity and power as he heard the words of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his Will already connected to it as his senses extended to match this construct when he saw...
Four shockingly austere figures of Enders of Nature floating outside the foldings of space that the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was moving in!
All four shone with golden grandeur as they were all Enders of Providence!!!
Noah could hide from the gaze of many, many beings.
But he still moved within the bounds of Reality.
And nobody...could hide from Reality itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 2103 The Cruel Reality! II
paragraphs: Four Enders of Nature shockingly gazed at the moving Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality in a progression of events that even Noah did not calculate!
After all, even CHARLEMAGNE, Lilith, and all others in the Dimensional Conclave did not predict the Siege of Reality to arrive.
They were all proficient in Destiny and Providence.
They all knew to ponder fate as some even delved into the Parallel Paths similar to Noah to gaze upon the countless possibilities.
But nobody caught on to the moves of Reality.

Reality whose constructs currently moved with such precision and ferocity that apart from sending Enders of Nature into the Quantum Dimension...there now stood Four Enders of Providence outside Noah's Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
Each one shone with power that no average Nature Integration Realm existence could match as any Enders of Nature that were augmented by Fundamental Natural Laws...were not to be taken lightly.

Hell, there was even a single Ender of Providence floating silently in the back of the ruptured space of the location of the Dimensional Conclave that discovered everything- seemingly ready to send commands to adapt to the other Enders at any moment.
And now, four of such creatures shining with utmost glory and power floated outside Noah's home.
HUUUM!
Providence surged with grandeur as within a Cosmos of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, Hyperion awoke as his eyes released blinding blue light- his draconic elephantine face gazing upwards.
Little Henry, Kazuhiko, Halcyon, and many others were also remaining in this region as there eyes also turned up!

Those with enough power could see across the folds of space and Cosmos to gaze upon many things as Little Henry and a few others...became somber at seeing the hazy phantoms of four Enders buzzing with power that they had yet to see!
Where even Noah's upgrades and increase in aura that they constantly come across...this was the first they felt this type of Aura Potency!
And it came from four separate Existences as they realized they were facing an utterly unprecedented event.
HUUUM!
The figure of Hyperion released a blinding light as space around him fluctuated, his body forming into a beam of light that began to surge upwards.
An ordeal had begun as at this juncture, nobody fully knew how it would play out!
The Second Ender of Providence gazed at the hidden construct before that was giving off the allure of three Sources.
Two it recognized very well as these Sources had been suppressing Reality for the past Ages, and another was a weak but budding force that it also felt a sense of familiarity with!
This was the Domain that the Will of Reality had been observing ever since it rose on its radar.
The importance granted to this endeavor today was just as great if not greater than the many other areas Enders of Nature were deployed, with the being in question...
SHAA!
Appearing at this juncture in a stellar fashion.

The folds of space opened to reveal an incandescent bring whose body glimmered with waves of light, but this meant nothing to the Four Enders of Providence here as what they focused on was this being's Aspects of Existence.

They affirmed what Reality had seen from its recent observations that this being had truly bound the Source of Dreams that was placed by the Sealers so long ago, and he had now done the same thing to the Source of Avalon as he was binding it to himself as well!
These sets of actions were extremely unique as in a sense, this being had aided greatly in the empowerment and freedom that Reality had right now, but Reality itself...could not leave him be.
The unique power he had to do what he did was too great.
Its repercussions too grand!
And he was taking while binding it to himself as in the end, he would attain a great power.
A power that might be more than sufficient for him to do whatever he wanted in the Desolate Mausoleum...and to the Desolate Mausoleum.
Reality could not have this.
After all, the very beings that moved within it countless eons ago- they had absconded after using its own power to seal it!
To oppress it in unimaginable ways as from this, Reality learned it could not trust those it could not control.

Years after its suppression, it once more faced an unprecedented event where it was split into countless fragments- an action that doomed it to damnation as this time, it was those that resided in its depths.
Apostates!
Sealers and Apostates- all born from the same branch.
So now, even though this existence had aided and even conducted a recent action that continued to aid and free it from its binds- Reality was unconvinced.
It could not trust what it could not control.
It was shown this time and time again!
Their actions had turned Reality cautious. Their actions had turned Reality calculative.
Their continued actions...had made Reality cruel!
So the Second, Third, and Fourth Enders of Providence was here.
They were here for no other purpose than...
<<Judgment.>>
HUUUM!
The four Enders of Providence spoke at the same time as the fabric of Reality trembled.
From the foldings of space, a figure wrapped in light broke through as it was a reclamation of another one of the constructs of Reality- it was the visage of Hyperion!

The eyes of the Irregularity flashed at this moment as a radiant Xyston appeared in his hands, his eyes wild and unfettered as if he could even stand against the Four Enders of Providence without multiple of his Clones perishing.

The Third Ender of Providence moved to receive Hyperion as it was a creature in the form of a 9-Headed Phoenix, its many eyes sharp and shining with ingenuity as its flaming claws grabbed onto Hyperion.

Hyperion whose body was struggling all this time, but paused and became still soon after as a resonance of Lineage shone from him and the Third Ender of Providence whose eyes showed scenes dating back the past years!
The 9 pairs of eyes on this incandescent gold Phoenix then shone as its voice filled with authority thundered out.
<<Irregularity Noah Osmont...cede control of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.>>
BOOOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2104 Control! I
paragraphs: <<Irregularity Noah Osmont...cede control of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.>>
The Enders of Providence began a line of communication as it was a truly heavy sentence!

It wasn't truly a communication with the Enders of Nature as much as it was a communication with Reality, the eyes of the Enders releasing radiant white blue light as an extremely powerful will coagulated here!
It saw many things.

It was how even at this moment, radiant phantom golden lines erupted from the Irregularity before it as the authoritative voice continued, this time from another Ender of Providence that had the form of an Empyral Ten-Winged Providential Tigress.

<<Whether on the Main Path or Parallel Paths, the result is all the same as Reality pervades all paths. Reality thanks you for your actions thus far and seeks control of the construct you are bound to.>>
HUUM!
Extremely cold words echoed out as Reality truly could not have things repeat themselves again.
Time and time again over countless eons, it had been failed. This time, it sought control over the things that would affect it the most!
The only issue was that it had tried to reclaim the parts of Reality in the construct below. It could not do it as there was too much of a bond.
The issue was the being in question.
The being whose eyes shone with the same grandiosity and Tyranny it remembered from the Sealers eons ago.
The being that it had seen in other Paths say the same thing with utmost Tyranny.
At this juncture, it knew that it was about to hear the same thing again.
But it had planned for too many possibilities as even then, it knew what had to be done!
Noah felt himself facing an unprecedented situation that he had actually brought upon himself in his search for power!

Had he not freed the Dream and Avalon Dimensions to bind them to himself, he wouldn't have made Reality regain so much of its power that now...its power seemed like a ridiculously strong contender for everything!
This was because one must understand...only two of its Seals had been lifted.
Only the Dream and Avalon Anchors had lost their functions as the mere full Understanding of Natural Laws had their boosts moved from 1,000% to now 3,000% in augmentations.
For every single natural law.

Those who understood and then integrated Natural Laws gained greatly in power. As for Reality itself that was made by these very Laws...it had grown capable of producing Enders of Nature that could match beings at the level of Lilith currently!

At only the freeing of 2 Seals. If Noah continued on his path for power and assimilated another Dimension or two into his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality...just how terrible would the power that Reality can wield become?

An even more stupendous question was the strength of Natural Laws...each one would gain an equivalent augmentation of 10,000% after the remaining 7 Dimensions were removed. With such a power in terms of Natural Laws and the height of glory of the fabric of Reality...how had the Ancestors managed to seal it with the 9 Anchors?
There were too many gaps to fill.
There were too many questions!
But one thing remained abundantly clear.
Reality was an extremely difficult enemy as one could not escape it.
So when its forces came knocking and sought control of the construct that made so many things possible for him...what move was the best for Noah to make?
SHIING!
Even after hearing the Enders of Providence utter out that the Parallel Paths did not matter, Noah still perused what he could while utilizing <I Am the Main Character>.
And in every possible path...Destiny and Providence turned tumultuous as the future was unknown!
But the light of Tyranny began to burn bright in his eyes.
As he finished connecting with a Second Source and his Aspects of Existence pulsed with an even greater change...an epiphany bloomed in his mind!
Why was the Will of Reality acting like this?
When he had aided and freed it of its bonds, why did it seek to take the tools he utilized to do it?

Noah's mind was robust and powerful as he didn't have to think for too long for things to become clear. His mind traversed to the events of the Ancestors eons ago and then the actions of OPPENHEIMER in the last Age.
These events...had twisted Reality into gaining a shocking sense of hate and distrust!
So the way to deal with this...
The path before him gradually cleared as he realized exactly how to deal with Reality itself.
What seemed like the most direct and clear answer of fighting...was incorrect!
So instead, he voiced out grandly while staring at the celestial beastial visage of four Enders of Providence.
"The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality I've forged this whole time...it lives and dies with me."
Without a speck of authority.
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor addressed the Will of the Barren Lands!
Out of the many possible paths, the one with least resistance was taken.
The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality lives and dies with me!
It was a very clear answer that stated no matter what...this construct would remain bound to him until the end of his life.
He did not have to pull every card he had out and begin a deadly fight against Reality.
So he instead threatened it with the very thing it sought by bringing for Enders of Nature here!
But Reality truly had turned cruel as in the next instant...

<<You would not be capable of choosing the path of mutual destruction. I have seen you. I have seen those you hold dear within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality. Even though you may be binding Sources of Nature, you are bound even more by the same emotions that bound Sealers and Apostates. You would not choose a path that will lead to the destruction of all things in this construct. You...have not reached the stage to ascend and overcome such karmic bonds.>>

chapters.title: Chapter 2105 Control! II
paragraphs: << You...have not reached the stage to ascend and overcome such karmic bonds.>>
The pairs of eyes of the foremost Ender glanced down with a burning gaze as Noah returned with calm eyes, putting away the Dimensional Xyston entirely as he replied.

"I have faced many enemies and allies in my short life. I've gone against what were believed to be insurmountable enemies and come out on top. I can make Reality my enemy...but what I wish to do is too connected to Reality for me to do that. I have goals...I have ideals!"
WAA!
Noah's dazzling hair whipped around with tyranny as he continued!

"All these goals and ideals though...are dependent on the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality. On this home I have made. It truly cannot be given away as even if I have to take the most drastic action that would hurt me the most...it would hurt you a great deal more as Reality would continue towards Cataclysm. Dimensions would continue towards Cataclysm. But with my means, I can stop this. With my means, I can continue to unseal all Anchors as we both win! Why can things not be done this way?"
Waves of destiny and Providence rose as they were quickly ground down to Dust by the 4 Enders of Providence.
Why could it not allow Noah to continue holding this terrifying tool in his hands? Why did it want him to cede control of the capability to free it that he had been utilizing this whole time?!
The answer was something Reality understood the most as it did not relent, pulling out one last card before everything fell apart.

<<Do you wish to attain the Seat of the True Emperor of this Age? Even that is a construct connected to the Source of Reality. It is not an impossibility to bend what was forged long ago and focus this authority on you. Just leave the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality behind...and I can pull the strings to make you the True Emperor of this Age.>>
Reality's greatest weapon was unveiled.
Rulership.
True Emperor!
Everything turned silent.
But soon after...
Noah's vibrant eyes released vibrant splendor as he replied calmly.
"No."
WAA!
His Main Body was radiant as his Kainos Authority and title fully blared and released themselves, the words QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR shining brightly above him.
"I do not need the allure of Rulership as in this Age, nobody but me shall attain the Seat of the True Emperor."
<<That is not guaranteed. There are others exceeding you in Aspects of Quintessence as they receive aid from outside these Lands. I can guarantee it for you.>>
An abrupt reply came as towards this, Noah only shook his head.
The surroundings churned with essence as the dominant auras of 4 Enders of Nature cascaded down, things becoming extremely tense and oppressive at this juncture!
Why could the Irregularity not be left alone as he continued to remove the Anchors?

This was a question that this Irregularity had posed as the answer...was simply that he would achieve a power that would be capable of greatly affecting Reality if he really came to bind all Nine Anchors.
When that time came, what was to prevent what occurred in the past from repeating again? From the actions of Sealers and Apostates?!

"How about this? You cannot deny my nature as from Hyperion, you have seen why I do the things that I do. It is fine if you do not trust me. In fact, it is understandable after all the events that have occurred throughout history. So...why don't you watch me and what I continue to do? As I continue to unseal the Anchors and grant you a level of freedom you haven't had in eons?"
The Enders of Providence gazed at Noah coldly as they did not reply.
"Gaze upon the countless Parallel Paths and see...what actions do I take time and time again?"
Dense silence descended once more as a second later...the deep voice of Reality bellowed out slowly and with solemnity.
<<Irregularity...you are not truly within any of the Parallel Paths.>>
BOOOM!
Providence surged as a shocking statement was uttered from the mouth of the Third Ender of Providence as it transmitted the Will of Reality!

<<What you see when you gaze upon the myriad Paths and what I saw were mere reflections of yourself that exist only when focusing on the you that is here and your probabilities. When ignoring you and focusing on others...Noah Osmont is not prevalent in any Parallel Paths. His actions are not heard of. His accomplishments are nonexistent. The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality does not exist in any other Parallel Paths, otherwise I would have simply attained it from countless possibilities. Irregularity...you are such a being as you seem to only be moving on this Main Path.>
HOONG!
Noah's Origin shuddered as the Integration with the Source of Avalon was nearly affected!
The words released were too unbelievable as Reality itself asserted that he was not present in the myriad Parallel Paths!
When he gazed at himself through <I Am The Main Character> or when being like Guinevere gazed back at his parallel self in the Avalon Dimension...it was only a reflection of himself.
If he was not focused on by those from this Main Path, nobody would be able to locate a Noah Osmont in the myriad of Parallel Paths!
It was a set of information that caused many questions to rise as even Noah's mind was computing millions of thoughts at this juncture.
His eyes retained their bright light of Tyranny as after a few short seconds of solemnity, he shook his head while gazing back at the Enders of Nature sharply.

"It matters not. I've removed only two Anchors as you have regained such a level of power that can likely overwhelm me if you so choose. When I remove a third or fourth anchor...won't you become even more powerful and reclaim a stupendous amount of authority. When all 9 Anchors are released, can anyone in these Barren Lands even stand against you? Something with your grandiosity...do you truly need to fear someone like me? If it is a matter of trust, have these Enders remain here to watch and ascertain. My answer to you is that I will not cede control of what I have worked so hard to achieve, but you are always welcome to observe as I continue to aid you and stop the coming Cataclysm!"
WAA!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor remained standing on his radiant ground even in the face of the Will of the Barren Lands!
No matter what treasures and authority were dangled before his eyes.
No matter what explosive knowledge or truth came out!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor did not waver!

When he gazed at himself through <I Am The Main Character> or when being like Guinevere gazed back at his parallel self in the Avalon Dimension...it was only a reflection of himself.
If he was not focused on by those from this Main Path, nobody would be able to locate a Noah Osmont in the myriad of Parallel Paths!
It was a set of information that caused many questions to rise as even Noah's mind was computing millions of thoughts at this juncture.
His eyes retained their bright light of Tyranny as after a few short seconds of solemnity, he shook his head while gazing back at the Enders of Nature sharply.
"It matters not.
I've removed only two Anchors as you have regained such a level of power that can likely overwhelm me if you so choose.
When I remove a third or fourth anchor...won't you become even more powerful and reclaim a stupendous amount of authority.
When all 9 Anchors are released, can anyone in these Barren Lands even stand against you?
Something with your grandiosity...do you truly need to fear someone like me?
If it is a matter of trust, have these Enders remain here to watch and ascertain.
My answer to you is that I will not cede control of what I have worked so hard to achieve, but you are always welcome to observe as I continue to aid you and stop the coming Cataclysm!"
WAA!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor remained standing on his radiant ground even in the face of the Will of the Barren Lands!
No matter what treasures and authority were dangled before his eyes.
No matter what explosive knowledge or truth came out!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor did not waver!

chapters.title: Chapter 2106 Extinction Of Nature! I
paragraphs: "You've had many enemies across eons."
The voice of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was resonant as he spoke fearlessly towards the Four Enders of Providence.
The atmosphere was tense without a proper pathway set to occur as Noah continued.

"Those within the Main Reality are your enemies, those outside of it in the Dimensions are your enemies...and even those outside these Barren Lands are your enemies, with some of them even set to descend in the future to come. You are the very fabric of Reality, and yet nobody is standing by your side. Why make yet another enemy when you could possibly have someone fighting for you after all these eons?"
<<You do not fight for the sake of Reality. You did not remove the 2 Anchors for anybody other than yourself.>>

"Yes. But it still stands that it benefitted you. It still stands that when I remove another Anchor, you will once more regain greater levels of power. Even though it is for myself- it is also Reality in the end that benefits!"
HUUM!

The Will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was unshaken as at this moment, his vibrant body actually turned around and gazed at the hidden boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality below him as his figure...actually began to descend into it!

"Attack me and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality if you wish, or watch and observe as I remove Anchors and you continue to elevate to greater heights. We have better things to do than go back and forth when in actuality, the goals we seek are the same."
Shockingly, Noah turned his back and returned to the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as he left behind words that could be heard with astounding clarity for the Endeds of Nature!

"The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is open to you...just know that the Rulers of the Sources I have bound are extended the banner of allies as even though they were past Rulers of Anchors that bound you- they are now under me and will only be utilized to further achieve my aims."
Against an unprecedented nexus event and possible threat against the very fabric of Reality, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor said what he had to say as he promptly returned back to his abode!
The Four Enders gazed at this sight with sharp eyes as the fabric of space around them trembled.

The folds of space became twisted and torn as soon after, it ripped apart to reveal multiple more terrifying auras of Enders of Nature as at their forefront, an Ender that looked to be an ancient species of beast from the Age of Power could be seen.
Its body looked like a chimera of a Draconian Qilin Phoenix as it swirled with three Absolute Fundamental Authorities of Entropy, Manadynamics, and Relativity!
Its body shone with radiant blue, black, and purple fur and scales as ten pairs of flaming aurora of wings burned on its back.
It had pupils that looked like clusters of Realities that flashed with power at this moment as it voiced out.
<<Go. Cover it on all sides and keep watch.>>
WAA!

Behind it, 5 Enders of Relativity flew out and went towards the Boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, another 5 Enders of Manadynamics and 5 of Entropy also flying out as they seamlessly passed through the Boundary!

At the same time, the figure of Hyperion was released as his eyes regained their countenance, looking around with solemnity as his gaze came to land on the Draconian Qilin Phoenix that looked at him coldly and flicked his figure into the unique construct below them.
<<You also keep watch, and remember the Source you stemmed from.>>

A terrifying development occurred as the Will of Reality had not even shown most of its terrific force, where if Noah truly had chosen the path of fighting and mutual destruction...it would be hard to predict what would have unfolded!
But now, 15 powerful Enders of Nature entered the bounds of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as for the Will of the Barren Lands...this location was more important than anything else currently.
It could not rely on the Irregularity alone if it could not gain control of the construct, and it had to guard it to make sure it wasn't destroyed!
After all, it was one of a kind across the many Parallel Paths.
The Draconian Qilin Phoenix that spoke coldly as its eyes filled with clusters of Reality shone with pure white light as it commanded the Four Enders of Providence before it.

<<Cover its four directions as it traverses across the Boundary Between Realities. Veil it with Providence and prevent any Apostates or Sealers from discovering it! Keep an eye on the Irregularity and any new authorities he attains.>>

An austere development bloomed as a very hidden and fortified land was gradually becoming an impenetrable fortress, the Auras hidden within it would be enough to cause some particularly powerful existences to turn somber!

The Draconian Qilin Phoenix watched all this occur with coldness as being the first Ender of Nature to be reforged with three Fundamental Natural Laws, its power was mighty as its authority and responsibility were even more so!
After achieving one of the possible results here- albeit one it didn't truly like, its gaze turned towards a certain direction as it pierced across the veils of space.
It stared towards the direction of none other than the Main Reality!
Parallel Paths.
The sum of all probabilities that stemmed from major Nexus Events in the Main Path.

The myriad of Parallel Paths are constantly transposed on each other...and at the same time they're not as very few existences could gain access to them to view their Parallel Selves, nor could they do anything more complex than viewing!

The Parallel Paths were different versions of probable Realities that did not occur in the Main Path, existing alongside it as with them- others could extrapolate possible futures or try to better grasp possibilities with Fate, Destiny, or Providence.
And others...well, they did much, much more!

chapters.title: Chapter 2107 Extinction Of Nature! II
paragraphs: In the Quantum Dimension.
In a region of a multicolored sea of Quantum Essence that stretched out endlessly.
HOOONG!

Terrifying waves of power were felt within this sea as an object smaller than even a grain of sand held some of the most terrifying contenders of the current Age within- this circular domain being the location of the Dimensional Conclave as currently, an Ender of Providence was outside a pulsing rupture of space watching the chaos within!
A chaos that held Enders, Dimensional Rulers, Tribunal Rulers, and even bodies of the Irregularity!

The Ender of Providence watched all this as in her mind, countless commands were sent out to the Enders of Entropy and Mana, Relativity, Gravitation...multiple Enders of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws weaved in as many were directed towards Lilith and the rows of Rulers behind her, towards The Empress and the Tribunal Rulers around her surrounded by Legions of Abominations, but even more were directed towards the Quantum Dimensional Rulers.
The reason for this was not the Mikado of Old or the Mikado of Strength.
They were powerful to be the one of the two that guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
But they still weren't the reason why two of the Enders of Entropy and Mana surged towards them along with over a dozen other Enders in tow!
It was for...none other than the visage of the INSURMOUNTABLE DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.
The being who had taken the lead in the Dimensional Conclave!
Just what was his power?
As he faced this unexpected situation, his calmness had already returned as his body released a wave of unique power.
And a moment later...
SHIING!
Golden doorways began to open around him as from them, figures that looked exactly like him in form but had variations in their adornments appeared.

Their eyes shone with the same triangular pupils as they held great power and purpose within them, their bodies lighting up with Absolute Quantum Authority and multiple Fundamental Natural Laws as 10 of such figures shot out towards the ancient beastial bodies of Enders of Nature!
They were not Clones.
They were existences that seemed exactly like CHARLEMAGNE but at the same time not as these...were his Parallel Selves that he had called out from Parallel Paths!
It was a unique capability that someone in the Age of Destiny had expressed as a major part of his power that very few could replicate.
It was something most Rulers knew well because of the Legends of this being as when it was seen by all, Lilith was the one to erupt with unbound rage while bellowing out!
<YOU DARE?!>
BOOOM!
Her figure ignored the Enders of Nature around her as she instantly turned onto a streak of light towards none other than CHARLEMAGNE.
CHARLEMAGNE who was currently not just using an ability similar to the existence that was Hatred- but exactly the same one without an ounce of fear!
But this wasn't all.
The body of CHARLEMAGNE that had called out his parallel selves breathed in as his chest expanded, his hand folding into a fist that he threw out to the space below him.
A fist that seemed to be moving slowly, but as it moved across space...an incandescent glow of gray light began to build around this fist with great concentration.
It was the light of NULLITY.
BZZZT...CRACK!

It felt so immensely dense and concentrated even more than the NULLITY Beasts surrounding the Tribunal Rulers that also gazed over this direction with surprise and solemnity- their eyes and the eyes of all here only being able to catch his fist smashing onto the fabric of Reality as soon after, circular waves of NULLITY began to spread out with his fist at the center!
Waves of NULLITY that instantly erased all the surging authorities from all being in this space emanated out as the only authorities still raging were from Manadynamics!
And before the shocking dust could even settle to allow others to react, the interminable gaze of CHARLEMAGNE released splendorous light as his fist unfolded and turned into a palm.
A palm that he brought to cover the left side of his chest as his body began to illuminate with an indescribable light.

A light that formed into rays of terrifying lights as with his figure at the center, countless rays of Obsidian green essence that very few were familiar with emanated from him and targeted all those labeled as enemies by him!
It was a shocking show of power.
A power that seemed to far exceed the upper tier of beings as fearlessly, CHARLEMAGNE targeted all enemies here himself!
Parallel selves, NULLITY, and the Absolute Authority of Poison that was utilized by the True Emperor of the Age of Terror.
CHARLEMAGNE felt all of these coursing within his body as he released it all without a delay, his eyes cold and calculating as even if Reality itself stood before him- he would not falter!
But of course, Reality was still a fortress to tackle as he didn't need to expend all his strength on it now.
So while the innumerable rays of Absolute Authority of Poison emanated from him and all nearby enemy Rulers tried to defend, he called out once more.
<Age of Haven.>
HUUM!
Abstruse and immense power from a past Age filled him once again, his body swirling with four foreign essences as his figure turned into particles of pure light.
Particles of light that were so fast that he instantly appeared behind Lilith's enraged figure, his hands pulsing with NULLITY as they slashed down with great killing intent!
BZZZT!

Time was moving extremely slowly as shockingly, Lilith did not even turn around as her butterfly-like wings that had bloomed behind her fluttered with a spatial light, her figure instantly becoming displaced as in her place- an incredulous and confused Niflheim Dimensional Ruler appeared!
Before he could even ascertain what was happening, the hand of CHARLEMAGNE pulsing with NULLITY smashed down as the Aspects of Existence of this Dimensional Ruler trembled.

It was a Wraith Lich Emperor whose incorporated body wheezed with fear at this moment as it felt its multiple Lines of Integration to Niflheim, Gravity, Polarity, and Weak Nuclear Force all become shredded and desegregation in a mere instant!
The hand of CHARLEMAGNE then seemingly enlarged to cover everything about this Ruler as it crushed down upon everything it enveloped, a life being snuffed out right after.

An existence that had been Integration with Nature...had fallen so easily as he had received tens of Quadrillions of Damage Values that emptied his Barrier, Vitality, and an instant desegregation of all integrated Sources as Nature was extinguished soon after!
HOOONG!

A dying light illuminated as a Ruler fell, CHARLEMAGNE's figure being seen in this location as Lilith's displaced figure gazed forward with eyes of utter madness, a bellow rising from the depths of her soul as her forehead split open to reveal a terrifying crimson demonic eye.

An eye that pulsed with wonder as an instant later, three crimson portals opened to reveal the figures of Undead Emperor Feng and other fantastical amalgamations of Undead that had the auras of Rulers!
It was a breathtaking scene to see amidst the Dimensional Conclave that had become one of utmost chaos.
Dimensional Rulers began to fall as nature itself was extinguished!
Too many beings were involved and moving as amidst all of this, very few were paying attention to the forces of Dream and Avalon that had also begun to move at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 2108 Extinction Of Nature! III
paragraphs: The current battlefield was filled with monsters.

Genuine and increasingly terrifying monsters that at the very peak, one of them was casually releasing attacks that could evaporate average Nature Integration Realm existences within an instant- their integrated Laws being desegregated and their bodies destroyed soon after!
And while this being did this, his Parallel Selves were also moving against other Rulers and Enders as they stood toe to toe with them or even overpowered them in aura.
Then, there was a demoness that was currently enraged while three Undead Nature Integration existences surged beside her!
<To even dare to use his legacy?! You are not worthy!>
HUUM!

Her body resonated with Undead Emperor Feng and the other two Undead Emperors beside her, drawing upon their authority as it surged into the crimson eye on her forehead and kept her on the same level as her attacker- CHARLEMAGNE.
The existence that would not be denied what he wished for!

He attained shocking speed that only the fastest True Emperor from the Age of Haven was famous for, his figure constantly staying at Lilith's tail as his Parallel Selves focused on the other parties he needed to scrutinize.
At this juncture in this increasingly chaotic battlefield, one of his Parallel Selves gazed towards the Dream and Avalon Dimensional Rulers.
And his eyes became ever sharper as these beings...were being wrapped in a silvery spatial light while surging towards the only exit that was the ruptured space amidst the Quantum Rings!
The only exit that had Enders of Reality blocking in and continuing to pour more of their forces through.
CHARLEMAGNE looked at the scene and snorted as one of his parallel selves began to surge towards the two parties.
He expected them to be held back greatly by the Enders of Nature as thereafter, he wanted to focus on capturing a few beings in particular!
One of them was the newly crowned Imperious Avallonis whom all the Avalonian Dimensional Rulers listened to.
The other one was the newly appearing Dream Dimensional Ruler that also fell under suspicion, CHARLEMAGNE wishing to put all these suspicions to rest as he surged towards them with purpose!

That was until moments later...his eyes shone with incredulity and surprise as the interference he expected from the Enders of Nature along with the chaotic battle where they fought for their lives while trying to escape...did not occur.

He instead saw the Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers with confidence completely wrapping their Authority around enhancing their speed and spatial waves of light as they actually passed the Enders of Nature as if they did not exist!

The terrifying Enders of Nature with their vibrant beastial forms also didn't pay any heed to them as they continued surging inwards towards the Abominations and Tribunal Rulers as well as CHARLEMAGNE's forces.

It was a shocking scene as even some of the Dream and Avalon and Dimensional Rulers seemed surprised that things were playing out in this manner, with the one wielding the Sword of Avalon at the forefront as one by one...they disappeared into the ruptured ring of light as the Ender of Providence that stood at the very center of it only spared them a cold glance while continuing to watch the chaotic battle unfolding within!

This unbelievable scene was caught by the eyes of many, the most important ones being Lilith, CHARLEMAGNE, and the Tribunal Rulers-the latter groups instantly becoming somber as in their minds, the act of the Enders of Nature utterly ignoring the two groups of Dimensional Rulers that had their Anchors lifted from the Desolate Mausoleum meant only a single thing.
That these beings had defected under the banner of Reality as somehow...it was Reality itself that had gained enough power to begin lifting the Anchors with the aid of these Rulers!

The genuine possibility that the very Fabric of Reality was the Dimensional Inimicus rose in their hearts at this moment, although in the mind of Lilith who was convinced of the identity of the Dimensional Inimicus- she only gained a greater level of shock as she attached even more importance to the Irregular that she knew much more than others here.
HOONG!
At this juncture, the figure of Charlemagne released a dazzling wave of power as while chasing Lilith, his main Visage bellowed out.
<The Will of Reality is behind the disappearance of the two Anchors! Find the Dream and Avalon Dimensional rulers and you shall find the two Anchors!>
Entropy surged as in a chaotic battle with combatants that could easily wipe out average Nature Integration Realm existences, Noah had conducted a single move that changed many things.

One of the major changes was the most powerful enemies had now placed the target of the Dimensional Inimicus on none other than Reality, their already valid suspicions of the Dream and Avalon Dimensional Rulers were also affirmed, as CHARLEMAGNE was not given the chance to search any souls!

Noah had taken this option away as he instead took his Avalon and the Dream Dimensional Chassis to safety as the moment this was accomplished, another change occurred in the Rapture that the Ender of Providence guarded.

The aura of a True Sanguine Clone appeared as even though Noah couldn't jeopardize the Avalon and the Dream Dimensional Chassis as they were too important, he also could not miss out on such an enormous Nexus Event that had large clusters of loot along with its intense dangers.
So a True Sanguine Clone was sent forth.
And at this moment, time slowed and nearly came to a stop in his eyes.
Time slowed as he did something he had done a few times before.
He stopped an instant...and he stretched it out as much as possible with the time dilation effect of the Dimensional Holy Land and his own mind that could compute countless thoughts within a moment.
The events of the Dimensional Conclave and the abundantly powerful existences within it seemingly came to a stop as his perspective entirely shifted to his main body!

Genuine and increasingly terrifying monsters that at the very peak, one of them was casually releasing attacks that could evaporate average Nature Integration Realm existences within an instant- their integrated Laws being desegregated and their bodies destroyed soon after!
And while this being did this, his Parallel Selves were also moving against other Rulers and Enders as they stood toe to toe with them or even overpowered them in aura.
Then, there was a demoness that was currently enraged while three Undead Nature Integration existences surged beside her!
<To even dare to use his legacy?!
You are not worthy!>
HUUM!

Her body resonated with Undead Emperor Feng and the other two Undead Emperors beside her, drawing upon their authority as it surged into the crimson eye on her forehead and kept her on the same level as her attacker- CHARLEMAGNE.
The existence that would not be denied what he wished for!

He attained shocking speed that only the fastest True Emperor from the Age of Haven was famous for, his figure constantly staying at Lilith's tail as his Parallel Selves focused on the other parties he needed to scrutinize.
At this juncture in this increasingly chaotic battlefield, one of his Parallel Selves gazed towards the Dream and Avalon Dimensional Rulers.
And his eyes became ever sharper as these beings...were being wrapped in a silvery spatial light while surging towards the only exit that was the ruptured space amidst the Quantum Rings!
The only exit that had Enders of Reality blocking in and continuing to pour more of their forces through.
CHARLEMAGNE looked at the scene and snorted as one of his parallel selves began to surge towards the two parties.
He expected them to be held back greatly by the Enders of Nature as thereafter, he wanted to focus on capturing a few beings in particular!
One of them was the newly crowned Imperious Avallonis whom all the Avalonian Dimensional Rulers listened to.
The other one was the newly appearing Dream Dimensional Ruler that also fell under suspicion, CHARLEMAGNE wishing to put all these suspicions to rest as he surged towards them with purpose!

That was until moments later...his eyes shone with incredulity and surprise as the interference he expected from the Enders of Nature along with the chaotic battle where they fought for their lives while trying to escape...did not occur.

He instead saw the Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers with confidence completely wrapping their Authority around enhancing their speed and spatial waves of light as they actually passed the Enders of Nature as if they did not exist!

The terrifying Enders of Nature with their vibrant beastial forms also didn't pay any heed to them as they continued surging inwards towards the Abominations and Tribunal Rulers as well as CHARLEMAGNE's forces.

It was a shocking scene as even some of the Dream and Avalon and Dimensional Rulers seemed surprised that things were playing out in this manner, with the one wielding the Sword of Avalon at the forefront as one by one...they disappeared into the ruptured ring of light as the Ender of Providence that stood at the very center of it only spared them a cold glance while continuing to watch the chaotic battle unfolding within!

This unbelievable scene was caught by the eyes of many, the most important ones being Lilith, CHARLEMAGNE, and the Tribunal Rulers-the latter groups instantly becoming somber as in their minds, the act of the Enders of Nature utterly ignoring the two groups of Dimensional Rulers that had their Anchors lifted from the Desolate Mausoleum meant only a single thing.
That these beings had defected under the banner of Reality as somehow...it was Reality itself that had gained enough power to begin lifting the Anchors with the aid of these Rulers!

The genuine possibility that the very Fabric of Reality was the Dimensional Inimicus rose in their hearts at this moment, although in the mind of Lilith who was convinced of the identity of the Dimensional Inimicus- she only gained a greater level of shock as she attached even more importance to the Irregular that she knew much more than others here.
HOONG!
At this juncture, the figure of Charlemagne released a dazzling wave of power as while chasing Lilith, his main Visage bellowed out.
<The Will of Reality is behind the disappearance of the two Anchors!
Find the Dream and Avalon Dimensional rulers and you shall find the two Anchors!>
Entropy surged as in a chaotic battle with combatants that could easily wipe out average Nature Integration Realm existences, Noah had conducted a single move that changed many things.

One of the major changes was the most powerful enemies had now placed the target of the Dimensional Inimicus on none other than Reality, their already valid suspicions of the Dream and Avalon Dimensional Rulers were also affirmed, as CHARLEMAGNE was not given the chance to search any souls!

Noah had taken this option away as he instead took his Avalon and the Dream Dimensional Chassis to safety as the moment this was accomplished, another change occurred in the Rapture that the Ender of Providence guarded.

The aura of a True Sanguine Clone appeared as even though Noah couldn't jeopardize the Avalon and the Dream Dimensional Chassis as they were too important, he also could not miss out on such an enormous Nexus Event that had large clusters of loot along with its intense dangers.
So a True Sanguine Clone was sent forth.
And at this moment, time slowed and nearly came to a stop in his eyes.
Time slowed as he did something he had done a few times before.
He stopped an instant...and he stretched it out as much as possible with the time dilation effect of the Dimensional Holy Land and his own mind that could compute countless thoughts within a moment.
The events of the Dimensional Conclave and the abundantly powerful existences within it seemingly came to a stop as his perspective entirely shifted to his main body!

chapters.title: Chapter 2109 A Moment In Time! I
paragraphs: Noah's eyes and Will were turned upwards as he gazed at the wonders he had contributed to.
He breathed out calmly as he reflected on the precipice he stood on right now, where a large portion of his actions were always done with the ideology of only moving forward!

Yet he had truly arrived at a grand point in time as even if it wasn't normally registered in his mind after it had been warped from him dreaming for millions of years and everything else he went through, he had arrived at a place others could not even imagine.
This was exemplified greatly by the scene that he currently looked at.

Across the folds of space from the Dimensional Holy Land his main body had relocated to, he could see the outline of an Ender of Nature stationed inside the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality- albeit near its boundary...as it spread its aura out and gazed both afar and within!

There were multiple Enders like it spread out across the Boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as there were even Four Enders of Providence in all 4 directions actively releasing an imperceptible golden veil over this whole construct!
This...was the precipice he had arrived at.
Where someone within less than 2 years, from a life of normalcy on a blue planet...he was now communicating and tangling with the very Fabric of Reality.
It was surreal to see as even for him who rarely looked back and only continued to forge forward, he was brought to a stop!
But...even this reflection could not last long.

Because as much as he could look at where he was then and the place he had arrived now, the present was always ever changing as all of these accomplishments...they could all be taken away if he was not careful enough!
So his path had to be clear in his mind.

As he stared out into the expanse of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and felt the successful binding of the Source of Avalon to him and the grand changes it caused as his body erupted into incandescent waves of light...he affirmed many plans and possibilities.
The most important thing he sought was power, but on the side of binding Sources of Decreta...he had to bring it to a halt after Avalon as too many uncertainties were arising with his actions!
He was strengthening his enemies at a greater pace than himself every time he pulled out an Anchor as even Reality itself was strengthened to an alarming degree.
The Rulers that had lived for billions and Trillions of years had too strong of a foundation and had already bound multiple Natural Laws.
The foundation of Reality didn't even need to be mentioned as it showed its prowess in the recent day!
But what about him?
He had only bound two Sources of Nature and no Natural Laws as his foundation...even though it was robust, it was still much lesser than the strongest beings!
And this was only logical and natural as ridiculously, it had only been around a week since Noah jumped from the Firmaments of Ascendancy and into the stage of Nature Integration.
Even his Refinement of EMPYRAL Bones, Organs, and Musculature was only coming to completion now as it was propelled upwards with the constant boosts in power his Aspects of Existence experienced!
But he needed a more robust foundation.
He needed to integrate with Natural Laws so he could truly enjoy the boosts of the removal of Anchors just like everyone else.
Because the power of beings like CHARLEMAGNE and Lilith was reaching destructive and unimaginable levels- and they would only continue to rise as time passed!
And when it came to binding the Sources of Reality...
<There should be enough of an accumulated Source for three Natural Laws or possibly one Fundamental Natural Law currently, Master.>

The voice of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality rang out in his mind as the pathway to binding Natural Laws was already laid out. He had to simply bind these Sources of Nature that were pervasive across the fabric of Reality...and he had swallowed enough of Reality to slowly build up a Source that the Enders of Nature themselves saw when they first appeared!
They had seen the Sources of Avalon and Dream within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, as well as a budding Source of this unique construct itself.
A Source that had only continued to grow in power as for Noah to bind more and more Natural Laws, he only needed to devour more of the Fabric of Reality!

It wasn't just the Realities in the Desolate Mausoleum- even the Dimensions were part of Reality as Natural Laws affected them as well, and the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had been greatly strengthened when Dream and Avalon Dimensions were assimilated into it.
And Noah had attained enough of a Source of Reality- even if it was a minuscule portion of it, to bind some Laws to himself.
This would be a part of his strength as to survive on a battlefield where beings like The Empress, Lilith, and CHARLEMAGNE moved in, Noah would need even greater sources of power!
Enough to withstand tens of Quadrillions of Damage Values safely while dishing out something similar.
So in this 'instant' that was stretched out into an extended period of time for him, a lot had to be done for him to prepare!
"Begin the design of the next form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques, Empower everything that can be Empowered, fuse all Ascendant Edicts into the Stanchions..."
HUUM!
Space began to vibrate with splendor as his Origin began to move.
His Origin that along with his body and soul were currently undergoing their own unfinished changes brought by the Integration of the Source of Dreams and Avalon!
"As for the Natural Law to bind...you mentioned the word 'probably' when talking about Fundamental Natural Laws?"

<Yes, Master. You would not be able to attain true and full Integration as Fundamental Natural Laws are too pervasively connected to the fabric of Reality and cannot have their entire Source contained within me. I might only be able to give you a semblance of control, but it will not be as profound as the Sources of Dimensions.>
Things would never be made so easy for him as his eyes shone with brightness at these words, his Will ringing out again.
"No matter, we shall see what comes of it. Begin with the Integration of Manadynamics."
WAA!

His body was already surrounded by surging waves of radiant light. But they seemed to always increase in concentration and grandeur as Noah sought to boost himself in order to survive against some of the strongest beings within the Barren Lands!

chapters.title: Chapter 2110 A Moment In Time! II
paragraphs: Every single one of his actions came with purpose as they all went towards making him progressively more powerful as he accumulated grander and grander levels of authority.

As Noah finished putting together Ascendant Edicts into his Stanchions and began the process of Integrating with the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics, he looked at the result of the grand action of integrating with the Source of Avalon that came with its own wonders!
<The Source of Avalon has been Opened.>
<The Source of Avalon has been Bound by the Quintessential Kainos Emperor.>
<Another quintessential action has been taken!>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>

Boundlessly radiant prompts had come down over the past few seconds as the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had taken the task of bearing the weight of yet another Source for him while he bound it to himself.

With this Source as well...Noah's will instantly connected to it as he saw the dozens of Rulers integrated with it, once more choosing those that Providence did not warn him about as the targets for <Neural Encroachment>!
<You have integrated your Will into another Nature as you gaze upon the profundity of Avalon.>
<You can freely utilize Absolute Avalon Authority to the extent that your Soul can bear.>
<The Augmentation from the Source of Avalon has been greatly elevated.>
<You have gained an unprecedented level of control over the Source of Avalon and those it is bound to.>

Similar prompts to when he bound the Source of Dreams arose as when he focused on the details of the Decretum itself, he saw the augmentations of 5,000% Augmentation to True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values along with the 75% nullification whenever he received attacks containing either the Essence of Avalon or the Absolute Avalon Authority!
But the Decretum of Avalon carried something extra similar to how the Decretum of Dreams had its own uniqueness of the Dream of the Oneiric.
It was a particularly dazzling excerpt from the description of Avalon!

<Decretum of Avalon>::... With Absolute Avalon Authority, you can form the Absolute Avalon Clone that can negate all incoming True Dimensional Avalon Damage Values, or you can utilize Absolute Avalon Authority to wrap around you in a protective shield that can also negate all incoming True Dimensional Avalon Damage Values...
Every decretum had its perks.

Avalon's perk was complete dominance as Noah knew this to be uniquely applicable to him, with those who did not bind the Source like him only enjoying 90% Nullification if they enact an Absolute Avalon Clone or spend large reserves of Absolute Avalon Authority that he could now use endlessly to the extent his soul could bear!
All these...were just part of the major gains from Avalon.

What was even greater was something that Noah had come across when he first bound the Source of Dreams as well, only this time...quantifiable results were shown as his body began to glitter with a pure milky white gold light.
<Due to the Integration with the Source of Dreams and Avalon, your Aspects of Existence have accelerated their transformation to reach a higher stage.>
The light was profound and full of roaring calm, tearing across his body this whole time as its presence was enough to cause a domino effect on many things!
<All of your Bones, Organs, and Musculature have attained the EMPYRAL State.>
HUUUM!
An austere symphony of revelation and transformation played as his stellar main body changed his very surroundings to cause a sea of multicolored essences to bloom around him.

His fair skin twinkled with the cosmic light of reality as it turned translucent sometimes, where one could occasionally see shining golden bones underneath this skin along with musculature that was tout with the allure of crimson gold light!
THUMP!

The beat of his heart caused crimson, gold, and blue glimmering blood of Mana and power to surge across every part of him as his organs were suffused with rainbow colored resplendence, his pupils spinning like cosmos in his eyes as his whole body seemed an ancient celestial treasure undergoing forging!
<Your constitution can now more easily integrate with Nature.>
<You have exceeded the Mythical Paragon's Empyral Foundation and attained a foundation in the upper ranks in this Age.>
<You are the 3rd to attain the distinction of a type of a Quintessential Empyral Foundation.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age significantly decreases.>
Noah's luminous eyes flashed with a tyrannical authority at this last prompt as he continued on regardless!

<Your robust foundation has greatly affected your physique, with each Cycle of the Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique now granting 3,000 Base True Damage and Defense Values, +150 Million Units to the Maximum Essence Reserves the Essence of All Established Dimensions, and the capability to withstand 12 Quintessential Dimensional Infinite Reality Passages...>
His body had become tough and robust as his life force...ah, it was so dense!

<The VITALITY Ecritures are now produced from your EMPYRAL Bones, Musculature, and Organs at a pace 1,000 times faster than the usage of the Essence of Reality. The total number of VITALITY Ecritures after the recent transformation is 15,000.>
Weaved at the very depths of his blood cells, vibrant green ecritures of VITALITY glimmered with glory as they elevated his life force to even greater levels.
But this wasn't the extent of the transformation brought about through the integration of the Sources of Dreams and Avalon.
The transformation to his Aspects of Existence was something much greater that granted him...
<Your Existence has been elevated.>
<The Authority accessible to the True Emperor of an Age is becoming quantified under your gaze. Utilization of it is possible when the distinction of your Existence elevates even further.>
The Authority accessible to the True Emperor of an Age!

For the Age of Quintessence...it was Quintessential Kainos Authority that Noah had been reading over and over again on it being greatly increased, significantly increased, or Quintessentially increased.
It was the crown and throne above him that was still forming even now!
This authority...could also be utilized!

chapters.title: Chapter 2111 A Moment In Time! III
paragraphs: In a raging multicolored sea of essence, Noah's will focused on the crown and throne above him as the surging grandeur and authority of these constructs he had looked at many times...they seemed to be getting more clear under his gaze!
An authority that could be molded by True Emperors.
How infinitely close was Noah to this stage that he could now quantify this authority?
There were many questions about it, but its quantification was just beginning as Noah would have to wait before he could even see how it could be utilized.
As he marveled at this, the transformation hastened other changes within his body as the multicolored pillars of light that connected his Dimensional Layers began to suffuse with light.

The Ascendancy Stanchions were next to release grand light as Noah was successful in filling each one with Ascendant TABOO Edicts, their comprehensive boosts becoming ever greater as the augmentations it granted Noah rose higher!

<For every 10 Ascendancy Stanchions resonated within your Origin to achieve the strongest Quintessential True Form, the base AND additional multiplier of 30,000 total is granted for your Damage and Defense Values.>
From 15,000 Augmentation per 10 Ascendancy Stanchions, the number was doubled as Noah continued to scale upwards with his power.
At this moment in time, he was also doing one of the most important things yet.
The Integration of a Fundamental Natural Law.

His body was already covered with countless radiant rays of colors, but the allure of blue never left him as his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had already begun the process of Integrating with Manadynamics.
The Source being utilized was the Source accumulated in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality itself!
So this process...was actually much easier than even the Integration with the Source of Dreams and Avalon, even if Noah couldn't achieve the same complete integration.
HOOONG!
A glorious symphony played as his Heart of Mana began to radiate glory.
As his very vessels glimmered cerulean blue while the space around him...was forcefully altered as all multicolored essences transformed and because painted with a gorgeous cerulean radiance!
An incandescent color of blue that showed accumulating Absolute Mana Authority and represented something grand.
Far away from Noah's position.
Within the Main Reality.
A massive and dense swirling mass of the Essence of Natural Laws formed into a pillar of light stretching out for an unknown number of light years.
It was the Main Empyral Domain of Nature that sat at the very center of the Main Reality!
Within it, terrifying auras of the strongest Primordials dwelled as the True Bodies of multiple Tribunal Rulers would even occasionally be in this location.
The current number of Tribunal Rulers within was unknown, with the vast area calm with the swirling waves of essence that only continued to increase in density due to another Anchor being removed!
At such a time, near the outskirts of this central Domain of Nature.
BZZT!
A spatial crack silently formed as the distinguished visage of a Draconian Qilin Phoenix emerged while emanating absolutely no waves of power.

Blue, black, and golden flames covered its glorious body as its scales and feathers couldn't be clearly seen, its vibrant pupils arriving at this domain but turning around soon after to gaze opposite to it.

Towards a far away construct that it had left multiple Enders of Nature to watch and protect- her gaze was piercing across the layers of space and gazing at the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as it felt a shocking change!
<<He has begun...>>
Brilliance shone within its eyes as they shone with utmost coldness, her gaze returning to the Empyral Domain of Nature before her as she placed her claws on its swirling outer layer.

HOOOONG!
The massive and vast stretch of the Emypral Domain of Nature trembled as its swirling mass of essence momentarily came to a halt.
Reality was always there pervasively, and it simply needed a conduit to conduct grand actions!
A halt of the biggest Domain of Nature...was a terrifying phenomenon as this was a location of dense essence that held a significant amount of the Source of Reality at its absolute center.

And Reality never moved unless it was absolutely certain of its actions.
CRAAACK!
Like a piece of a puzzle breaking, the vast stretches of the Domain of Nature broke away from the Main Reality.

Within its frozen space, multiple different essences of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws lit up like bright fireworks as the fabric of space very quickly became twisted- a massive spatial singularity forming with the Draconian Qilin Phoenix at the center as this singularity began to shrink and fade!

chapters.title: Chapter 2112 A Moment In Time! IV
paragraphs: A long-planned attack of Reality in a way that other creatures could not even understand!
An attack...but who truly was its target?
The Primordials had just lost a crucial piece of their power as a part of the fabric of the Main Reality was torn away- one that granted them a great edge over others across the eons!
They were among the casualties on the path of war.
But the Tribunal Rulers and the Primordials...were only that. They weren't the main target of this action!
HUUUM!

The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality trembled in a never before seen fashion as outside of it, the Four Enders of Providence that had a golden film of light surrounding this construct had suddenly glimmered with grandeur.

The thin golden layer they had spread out seemed to actually act as a conduit for a massive traversing singularity- a singularity that was taken across the spacetime continuum and directed into the center of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality they were supposed to be shielding!
And at the very center, it bloomed!
Within the Dimensional Holy Land, it bloomed and covered everything with a maddening concentration of the essence of a myriad of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws.
Was this Reality fully allying with Noah and supporting him with such a grand gesture?
The answer was shockingly in the opposite direction.
<Maste-!!!>
BOOOM!
A terrifying will spread out along with the blooming singularity that contained the Main Empyral Domain of Nature of the Desolate Mausoleum!
The voice of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had rung out briefly before it was drowned in the raging swirls of the Essence of Natural Laws.
This Empyral Domain of Nature was a crucial part of Reality that held an extremely dense concentration of the Will of Reality.
But even more so, it held dense concentrations of Natural Laws. But nothing was more concentrated and dense than two Fundamental Natural Laws in particular- Manadynamics and Entropy!

And in the Dimensional Holy Land, Noah had been surrounded by the cerulean light of Absolute Mana Authority as he integrated with the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics through the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

And when the singularity of the Empyral Domain of Nature exploded, he was at its very center as an immense influx of the essence of Manadynamics flooded into him and his connection with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
It was only natural.

After all, it was exactly the Natural Law he was fusing with. But the only issue...was that an extremely dense Will had attached itself with shocking concentrations into the influx of the Essence of Manadynamics surging through Noah and his connection with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
It was the Will of Reality.
It was the Will that was still seeking control of this stupendous construct!
It had plotted and planned as it acted at an absolutely opportune time, where the moment Noah began integrating with any Natural Laws, Reality would have acted!
It had tried to reassimilate its source of Nature from the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and unto itself many times before.
But the connection and binding this construct had with Noah was too dense as it could not reassimilate anything!
But if Reality happened to gain access to this connection.
If somehow its Will could penetrate this connection at a crucial time with the permission of the being that bound this construct...
HOOONG!
An unbelievable symphony rose and played grandly as this was exactly what had occurred.

The Fundamental Natural Law was too closely connected with Reality, and Reality used this to its advantage as at this juncture- an unprecedented blade was pointed towards Noah and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
It was a blade that was infusing the Will of Reality through the line of connection between Noah and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality while the Source of Manadynamics was trying to be bound.
It was the perfect attack at a perfect time!

At the center of it all, Noah's body that had been calm this entire time became the center of a storm as the instant all of this happened, his visage trembled as his eyes and mouth bellowed out in shock.

He felt the shockingly ancient and unimaginably strong will of reality enter through with the very Natural Law he was trying to bind, this line of connection expanded greatly to the extent that if it was a thin thread before, it had become a massive pillar of a connection now!
And in this expanded connection, the Will of Reality utilized it to surge into the very Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that was binding Manadynamics.
It was a sure kill move.
It was the most threatening move to Noah's Hegemony as he didn't even have time to think, only acting on instinct as he bellowed out.
<OOOOOOH!>
A grand and bellowing cry that reverberated all around and caused the souls of all beings in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to tremble!

A bellow that buzzed in the ears of the cold faced Enders of Nature surrounding the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, as well as the visage of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix that had appeared within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as well.
It was a bellow that came from his very soul as the first instinct he had was to stop the process of Integration to Manadynamics!
But the instant he was about to undertake that action...
<A Source of Reality has been bound by the Quintessential Kainos Emperor!>
<The Source of Manadynamics has been partially integrated into the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and the Soul of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor.>
<A stupendously quintessential action has been taken!>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increases!>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age quintessentially increa-!>
Grand prompts came down as their golden luster shone with an almost mocking grandiosity!
BOOOM!

A refulgence of grandeur exploded out as shockingly, the influx of the essence of Manadynamics from none other than the Main Empyral Domain of Nature of the Main Reality was enough to instantly cause the Integration Noah was seeking to complete.
But this was a death sentence!
Because all of this essence was painted with the Will of Reality that forcefully infused itself into the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and now fought a battle for supremacy.
The Will of Reality moved to entirely control the construct that could allow for great changes in this Age.

And the Quintessential Kainos Emperor turned absolutely livid as when one instinctual move didn't work he instantly tried another as the Source of Dreams and Avalon instantly surged under his command as Absolute Dream and Avalon Authority began to senselessly leak out of him!
