chapters.title: Chapter 2113 A Moment In Time! V
paragraphs: Under his command, the Units of the Absolute Dream and Avalon Authority that he could utilize as much as he wanted to the extent that his soul could bear...countless of such units erupted out as they carried Noah's Will and the Will of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality- Noah directing it all towards the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality where two Wills were battling for Supremacy!
HOOONG!
It was two Wills but frankly, the more ancient one and the one that had lived across countless eons was rapidly devouring the one that barely came to fruition recently.
It was an extremely perilous juncture as a high-paced symphony rang out with haste!

The influx of two new Sources caused a brief and extremely momentary pause as sparks of Singularities bloomed, Noah's livid figure barely being able to catch the communication of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality after it had been cut off before.
<Master! The Will of Reality is too potent! I need more of the Source of Reality to hold it at bay and push it out->
More of the Source of Reality.
What Noah and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had been accumulating so far by swallowing Realities and two Dimensions!
At these words, Noah's raging Will acted on instinct once more as Absolute Dream Authority flourished.
He wanted to do something, but would he really be left the chance to do it?
When Reality had planned so extensively and with such purpose?
SHIIING!

Just as he began to move, the dazzling visage of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix appeared in the Dimensional Holy Land as its radiant figure shot out towards Noah's incandescent visage like a beam of judgment!
And it was at this same moment that Noah bellowed out.
<Infinite Dream!>
Infinite Dream.

When he had utilized this before, he had been able to segment his soul into a few hundred and then a few thousand portions into Realities to dominate them and assimilate them into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
But when he utilized it on this day...
HOONG!
His figure radiated power and grandeur as hundreds of thousands of streaks of light shot out.
Portions of his soul that would each seek a Reality as in an instant, this number exploded past 1 Million!

And even more portions of souls still came out as each one was bathed with large reserves of Absolute Dream Authority! An authority that Noah put in place to make from Dream and into Reality only a single thing.
Speed.

The quickest speed to have his portions of Souls instantly release his will to dominate the beings and the loose consciousnesses of the Emerging and Prime Realities he entered as they would be assimilated right after.

The light of providence surged as from the Dream Dimension, Eowyn's figure that had been consolidating her power this whole time felt the shocking changes through her bond to Noah, her figure rising up while erupting with Absolute Dream Authority as she surged towards the Draconian Qilin Phoenix that was moving towards Noah!
But the enemy this time was utterly terrifying.
HUUM!

Her golden figure was instantly blindsided as a visage smashed into her like a meteor of light, a Celestial Titan shining with the aura of Entropy appearing as it was one of the Enders of Entropy placed on the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to watch!
<ROAR!>

It bellowed out towards Eowyn's figure that trembled at this moment as arcs of Entropy crackled over her body, blood leaking from her mouth as her strength alone had not risen enough to match an Ender like this!

But she grit her teeth as Absolute Dream Authority bubbled forth around her. Her heart trembled with Providence as even she knew a crucial time had come, where many things would be decided in the seconds to come.
And even though she didn't have the strength...
<YAAA!>
Her golden hair whipped around madly as she surged forward to get past this Ender with vibrant authority.

Others like it and even more Enders surged and surrounded the raging Holy Land that was now swirling with countless essences of Natural Laws. The Empyral Domain of Nature fully bloomed at this moment as the concentration of essence in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was reaching an utterly alarming level.
And at this time...
Rivers of incandescent Realities began to appear above the Boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

They were wrapped with Absolute Dream Authority that was senselessly leaking from Noah's portion of Soul, making an impossible feat of speed a possibility as these realities very quickly began to stack around the Boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as their Cosmos began to shoot down with grandeur!
It was a shocking scene that was backed up by the authority of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as he sought to rapidly increase the accumulation of the Source of Reality for his construct.

His Soul cried out with glory as it bore the weight of utilizing an unknown number of Units of Absolute Dream Authority, thousands of Realities soon beginning to appear above the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as they disappeared into it silently, their Cosmos falling down like stars as for every new Reality assimilated, the concentration of the Source of Reality under the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality strengthened!
HOOONG!
A radiant light of splendor suffused the surroundings of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as this process began, but it would not be left alone so simply.
A Draconian Qilin Phoenix neared the center of the Dimensional Holy Land at this moment.

The terrifying Draconian Qilin Phoenix that could no doubt stand her ground against beings like CHARLEMAGNE neared Noah as her massive draconic claws burning with the golden flames of Providence surged forward- their purpose not being to destroy as they were meant to contain!
After all, the one who was still bound to the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality could not perish!

The claws of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix were within grasp of Noah's visage when at this juncture, his livid eyes burning with pure plasma of Mana turned towards it as the eyelids were shut firm since he had gone into slumber.
Yet his Will was robust as even while slumbering in his Infinite Dream, he spoke out with tyranny!
<Absolute Authority.>
Absolute Authority!
The newest feature of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that allowed him to reject entry to all those he had bound the Source of!
And just now...he had bound one of the Sources of Reality.
Manadynamics.

It wasn't a complete binding, but it was binding nonetheless as the Ender whose body was forged in three Fundamental Natural Laws including Manadynamics...its astounding visage came to a stop an inch away from Noah's figure that was bathed in Quintessential light!!!

The terrifying Draconian Qilin Phoenix that could no doubt stand her ground against beings like CHARLEMAGNE neared Noah as her massive draconic claws burning with the golden flames of Providence surged forward- their purpose not being to destroy as they were meant to contain!
After all, the one who was still bound to the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality could not perish!

The claws of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix were within grasp of Noah's visage when at this juncture, his livid eyes burning with pure plasma of Mana turned towards it as the eyelids were shut firm since he had gone into slumber.
Yet his Will was robust as even while slumbering in his Infinite Dream, he spoke out with tyranny!
<Absolute Authority.>
Absolute Authority!
The newest feature of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that allowed him to reject entry to all those he had bound the Source of!
And just now...he had bound one of the Sources of Reality.
Manadynamics.

It wasn't a complete binding, but it was binding nonetheless as the Ender whose body was forged in three Fundamental Natural Laws including Manadynamics...its astounding visage came to a stop an inch away from Noah's figure that was bathed in Quintessential light!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2114 A Moment In Time! VI
paragraphs: The claws of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix were an inch away from Noah's blazing and livid visage as even in a slumber, his eyes burned with rage!
His will gazed at into the cold eyes of this Ender of Nature as if he was gazing at the Will of Reality itself as his authority emanated out.
<You have disappointed me.>
Noah spoke out with eyes of wrath as even though he understood the stance of the Main Reality- he could not agree and sympathize with it.
No matter if it didn't trust and had been betrayed by its own people time and time again!
For it to wage war against him...
He understood history.

He knew that for Reality, it was only logical for it to seek control of the one thing that could change its fate as it knew its reliance on beings had failed time and time again. He knew that even though he understood himself in his Heart and what he was doing was the best for Reality...the Will of Reality was naturally not him as fully leaving its fate into the hands of another being was not ideal.
He knew all this...yes he was still livid at its actions today as if he couldn't let his will be known peacefully, he would make it known tyrannically!
HOOONG!
He rejected the Manadynamics dwelling within the Draconian Qilin Phoenix through the feature of Absolute Authority as its body began to move backwards.
Only a third of it was made up of an essence Noah could reject, but it was still a major part of its Aspects of Existence as its whole body was rejected from the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
Along with it, 5 Enders of Mana that were within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality were pushed out, only leaving behind Enders from other Sources that Noah could not yet reject.
Enders that neared the Dimensional Holy Land and became bathed in its swirling waves of essence as they looked coldly towards Noah's slumbering figure that seemed more awake than ever!
5 Enders of Entropy came the closest at Noah as they didn't attack, with the only reason being the fact that Reality knew this attack did not pan out with the best possible result for it.

This was because at this juncture, tens of thousands of Realities were stacking themselves atop the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as their Cosmos shot down like starry stars, more and more fractions of the Source of Reality reinforcing the Will of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as the fight between it in the budding Source...had reached an impasse where it could not proceed!

Instead, it even began to be pushed back as with the partially bound Source of Manadynamics and the ever-increasing strength of the Will of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality...this stupendous attack actually ended in a failure!

<<Your disappointment means nothing to me. I only seek the best possible result and method to prevent Cataclysm. Putting control in my hands naturally guarantees the best possible results as there is no reliance on the Will of another entity.>>
WAA!
The Will of Reality emanated from the closest 5 Enders of Entropy as Noah's ancient slumbering visage replied coldly.
<I have tried the path of peace. I have told you that I do not wish for a war with the very same thing I am trying to save. Do you truly wish for destruction?!>
The wrath in his voice was clear as Reality replied right after!

<<Control has always been the only thing I seek. If I can gain it, this is the best possible result. If I cannot and the only pathway between destruction is through you continuing your path with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, then so be it. Take this Empyral Domain of Nature as a gift to further aid you and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality. But make no mistake, when you release another Anchor and I recover more power...or when any other opportunity presents itself for me to bid for control of this construct, I will take it. Past mistakes shall not be repeated again.>>
HUUM!
Providence surged as Reality made a promise.
It would not stop vying for control as it wanted to rely on itself- the actions of the Ancestors and Primordials having truly warped Reality as it solely wanted to rely on itself!
But it was a logical construct.
If it could not gain control, it would protect and aid the tool that would continue to unseal and elevate it.
Until the next time came that a chance presented itself!
<Foolish!>
BZZT!
Noah's will bellowed out as the consequences of the Empyral Domain of Nature settling in the Dimensional Holy Land were just now unfolding.
His boundless will of Tyranny whipped around with glory as hundreds of thousands of points of light that were Cosmos joined his Reality every second, his voice emanating out with utmost coldness!

<Let this serve as a warning as well as another look into my character. I shall gladly take this Empyral Domain of Nature and devour your Will in recompense. If and when you do try this again and ultimately fail, the price will be much higher. For now...your Enders are no longer welcome in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!>
His crown and backbone of a throne shone as his Quintessential Kainos Authority seemed palpable and ready to almost move under his beckoning!

He didn't yet have the authority under <Absolute Authority> to kick them out, but this card had now been revealed to Reality as it was partly the reason for its loss- with the claws of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix not being able to reach him and disrupt his Infinite Dream due to this.

Now, he made his Will known to Reality as this unique Will flashed in the eyes of the Enders of Entropy and other Enders of Nature, their figures becoming warped in a spatial light as they disappeared and rematerialized outside of the Boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
It was a fantastical scene to witness at this moment in time as from afar, Eowyn's figure breathed a sigh of incredulity as she finally reached the Dimensional Holy Land!

chapters.title: Chapter 2115 A Moment In Time! VII
paragraphs: Noah's slumbering will gazed at this coldly at the Enders of Nature outside the boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as his wrath subsided.
The actions of Reality were logical and illogical at the same time.
The Desolate Mausoleum and the Nine Anchors...all of it had been warped over the years as the actions they followed could at times be unfathomable!
But the action done today was enough to be considered a Nexus Event by itself.
The Main Empyral Domain of Nature had been taken from the Main Reality and placed into Noah's home as the Primordials had suffered a terrifying setback!
It was an action that no doubt caused other branching Parallel Paths to form that involved all the possibilities of how things could have played out.
But since the one involved was an existence who wasn't truly present in Parallel Paths...how exactly would these versions of Realities look like?
It was a question with no answer as apart from Primordials losing, there was Noah gaining a whole lot from this whole ordeal.
<This is unprecedented...>
The voice of Eowyn rang out as she wiped away the crimson gold blood on her lips while coming to stand by Noah's slumbering Main Body.
This single action today had too many consequences as even now, tens of thousands of Realities were being assimilated as a certain Source was being strengthened greatly!
As the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality overpowered and assimilated the Will of Reality in its Source, its voice finally rang out again with clarity.
<Master, enough fractions of the Source of Reality will have been attained to support the Integration of 2 more Fundamental Natural Laws or 6 Natural Laws by the end of the day.>
WAA!

One of the boons revealed itself as the even bigger boons of partial binding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics had yet to fully reveal themselves, their prompts continuing as Noah's slumbering will gazed at them coldly.
<The Integration of Manadynamics is causing a Fundamental change in the Heart of Mana.>
<The Quintessential Kainos Mana Circulation Vessels are being elevated.>
<With the elevation of the Quintessential Kainos Mana Circulation Vessels as the framework, the Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique has undergone a fundamental elevation.>

<Each Cycle of the Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique now grants 6,000 Base True Damage and Defense Values, +300 Million Units to the Maximum Essence Reserves the Essence of All Established Dimensions, the capability to withstand 18 Quintessential Dimensional Infinite Reality Passages, and the capability of evolution as more cycles pass is retained.>

The Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique experienced yet another robust round of Empowerment as it brought Noah to even greater levels, his Damage Values now after all the augmentations approaching tens of Quadrillions close to the numbers he saw from the terrifying beings within the Dimensional Conclave!
As for the exact value, this could only be quantified when he tested it after all boosts settled as for now, they still continued.
This time...it was his Heart.
THUMP!
The glorious Heart of Mana that redefined how Noah cast his abilities shone with a starry blue luminosity as it pumped pure Absolute Mana Authority through Noah's vessels!

The Heart of Mana that could pay for any ability in full so long as its cost was less than 5 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality or 10 Units of Absolute Authority, or 50 Billion Units of Dimensional Essence or the Essence of Natural Laws.
It was an Absolute Connate Reality Engine that fundamentally changed Noah's fighting style and continued to allow him to spam shocking abilities freely!
And now, its radiance was utterly blinding as it was elevated even further.

<The Heart of Mana>:: Born from a mutation of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor and his authority as an Infinite Conduit, it was brought to fruition by Manadynamics and bathed in its Fundamental Absolute Authority to bring about something unique. It has been further strengthened by the Integration of the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics into the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, this Integration allowing for even greater levels of Reality Alterations to arise- especially on the aspect of Mana. At its current stage, the Heart of Mana shall pay all the resource costs of skills requiring less than 30 Units of Absolute Decreta and Natural Law Authority, 20 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality, 200 Billion Units of the Essence of Decreta and Natural Laws, and grant an alteration of an unlimited usage of the essence for concepts below Natural Laws. When exceeding the set numerical boundaries, the Heart of Mana shall pay 75% of the cost of the cast ability as with this Absolute Connate Reality Engine, resources are bound to not be a problem for you. It has resonated with your Vessels as the efficiency of essence has been optimized to greater levels, increasing your True Reality Cast and Attack Speed Values by 50,000%. Its numerical boundaries can be exceeded and changed depending on your own power as the Heart of Mana is nearing its final form...
Grandiosity.
In the midst of swirling essences of Natural Laws, the color blue greatly won in denseness and concentration as Noah's body became even more quintessential!
This was just part of the boons brought by Reality's actions and allowing Noah to have the instant integration with Manadynamics.

The details for integrating this Source itself were yet to be quantified due to Noah's soul being in a slumber and stretched out into millions of portions- where he wasn't able to fully feel the Source of Manadynamics within the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as its percentage augmentations were bound to be astonishing.

But among the many changes, the placement of the Main Empyral Domain of Nature into the center of his Dimensional Reality now meant he could begin comprehending and understand all Natural Laws from now on!
And the assimilation of even more concentrations of the fabric of Reality meant only one thing.
<The features of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality are also undergoing elevation with the continued accumulation of the Source of Reality.>
<The Dimensional Holy Land is currently morphing into the Dimensional Empyral Domain that contains an abundant amount of essence of multiple Natural Laws and Decreta.>
<The Dimensional Reality Xyston is undergoing elevation.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2116 A Moment In Time! VIII
paragraphs: The moment stretched out in time had many unexpected things occur as it neared its end.

This was because Noah knew he was reaching a sufficient level to survive the shocking battles unfolding, and this was affirmed by nothing else than the boons he had set out to attain when he first began this moment in time, as well as the unexpected boons that came due to the actions of Reality.

The Dimensional Holy Land was transforming into the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature that contained multiple Natural Laws and Decreta, this making many things possible as the influx of new Natural Laws was now an inevitability, as well as the continual increase in understanding of the current Laws Noah held!

The other...was the all-around elevation of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as its Source of Reality was being increased rapidly- more and more Realities still coming down at this moment as Noah continued his Infinite Dream.
When Hundreds of Thousands of portions of his Soul returned...he didn't accept them back into his body as he sent them out again for the same task!
It was a terrifying direction he chose to take as this would soon put a strain on his soul with how much Absolute Authority he was spending, but he still felt okay at this juncture so he continued!
Which caused the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to grow in wonders. Which caused the Dimensional Reality Xyston to reach another stage.
Its first stage could dish out 1 Quadrillion as in its description, it was stated that future increases in its output would increase exponentially.
It wouldn't just be a doubling of 1 Quadrillion to 2 as Noah's tyrannical will gazed upon its grandeur at this juncture.

<Dimensional Reality Xyston>:: A weaponized form of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality in the shape of a Spear. It holds the weight of the accumulated Realities and Dimensions within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as it has transcended any augmentations from outside sources, with a single swing from it being able to currently release an output of 25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values. Wielding it for the Quintessential Kainos Emperor is akin to an extension of his will as no resource requirement is required...
25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values with every swing.
No resource cost!

This was what the weight of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality could do at its early stages! But what Noah truly looked forward to...was him swinging the equivalent weight of All Dimensions and all of the fabric of Reality!
Now that...would be truly grand as his enemies could only despair.

But apart from the Xyston and other features of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality elevating, there was still the crucial integration of Manadynamics that had granted transformations to the Heart of Mana among others.
But what exactly was its boon after the partial integration with Noah?

Fundamental Natural Law <Manadynamics>:: A ruling authority that governs the absolute workings of Reality. Understanding it to completion means comprehending this aspect of Reality as you can easily influence it in an unimaginable manner... After the partial binding of the Source of Manadynamics, the Current Boosts are elevated to 15,000% Augmentation to All Essence Reserves, Essence Exchange Value, True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values. With the partial binding of this Source, you have come closer to understanding the Undefined Authority as you have unlocked Quintessential Nature Resonance. The more Keys of Reality you bind to yourself, the greater your Quintessential Natural Resonance Value becomes and the closer you come to the understanding and utilization of the Undefined Absolute Authority...
HUUM!
The cerulean sea of essence around Noah surged as his Soul reacted to the ridiculous wonders...as well as something new.
Quintessential Nature Resonance!
Noah's will focused on this new construct right away as new details arose.

<Quintessential Nature Resonance>:: You have begun integrating with Nature as the Sources bound to you resonate at the depths of your Soul to grant a Resonance Value. This Resonance Value will augment your Defense, Damage, Vitality, Resource...all Values under you after all other augmentations have been accounted for. The greater the Resonance Value, the greater power you can exert through Nature. Current Resonance Value- .15( Dream ~.025, Avalon ~.025, Manadynamics ~.1)
A new form of a multiplicative augmentation to Noah's already impressive roster!
To fully understand just what this seemingly small value actually signified, we have to look at Noah's current Damage Value which had been elevated by tens of Quadrillions.

His Base Values came from his Six fully saturated Dimensional Realities in his Origin, the values from his Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique, and a few other smaller sources- and then all these values were multiplied by the augmentations from his Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the Ascendancy Stanchions, and lastly the Decreta and Natural Laws!
The above-mentioned augmentations were three multipliers.
When multiplying his Base Values and these multipliers, Noah's Damage Value Output exceeded 50 Quadrillion and was in fact teetering at a value of 52 Quadrillion!
Now, a fourth multiplier apart from the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the Ascendancy Stanchions, and the augmentations from Decreta and Natural Laws came.
It was the Quintessential Nature Resonance Value of .15!
After all the prior augmentations, Noah's Damage Value of 52 Quadrillion was elevated even further by the Resonance Value of .15 as his true output now became 59.8 Quadrillion!

And this Resonance...was just coming from the Integration to Manadynamics, Dream, and Avalon. When he added more decreta and Laws in the future, the Resonance Value would continue rising as his power would also elevate even higher!
His will calmed after being disrupted by Reality's actions as he gazed at everything.
The assimilation of hundreds of thousands of Realities continued as his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality continued to strengthen.

He could bind 2 more Fundamental Natural Laws or 6 Natural Laws as with the words of Reality that it would always continue seeking control, Noah had to be careful whenever he bound new Sources of Nature!
But as he finished his preparations now, his slumbering will still in the middle of an Infinite Dream bellowed out authoritatively.
<Begin the Integration of Providence...>
WAA!
He forged forward fearlessly as he would like to see Reality try something similar while the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was continuing to get strengthened!
Base Damage
6 Saturated Paramount Kainos Dimensional Realities = 6,080,000 TDV
Quintessential Natural Born Mana Physique = 170 Completed Physique Refinement Cycles * 6,000 TDV per Completed Physique Refinement Cycle = 1,020,000 TDV
[Eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor] = 5,000 TDV
TABOO LETHE's [Oblivion] = 100 TDV
Quasi-TABOO Relics = 25 TDV
TOTAL BASE DAMAGE CALCULATION — 6,080,000 TDV + 1,020,000 TDV + 5,000 TDV + 100 TDV + 25 TDV = 7,105,125 TDV
Multipliers
[Throne of Quintessential Tyranny] = 5x
Ascendant Quintessential Kainos Emperor True Form = 4,507,500x

Fundamental Natural Laws, Natural Laws, & Decreta = 0.177x from Gravitation + 0.165x from Polarity + 150x from Manadynamics + 3x from Entropy + 30x from Providence + 60x from Dream + 5x from Prana + 60x from Avalon + 5x from Mirror + 5x from Apollyon + 5x from Niflheim + 1x = 324.342x
TOTAL MULTIPLIER CALCULATION — 5x * 4,507,500x * 324.342x = 7,309,857,825x
TOTAL TDV CALCULATION — (6,080,000 TDV + 1,020,000 TDV + 5,000 TDV + 100 TDV + 25 TDV) * = 7,105,125 TDV * 7,309,857,825x = 51,937,453,578,853,125 True Dimensional Damage Values!

It was a terrifying direction he chose to take as this would soon put a strain on his soul with how much Absolute Authority he was spending, but he still felt okay at this juncture so he continued!
Which caused the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to grow in wonders.
Which caused the Dimensional Reality Xyston to reach another stage.
Its first stage could dish out 1 Quadrillion as in its description, it was stated that future increases in its output would increase exponentially.
It wouldn't just be a doubling of 1 Quadrillion to 2 as Noah's tyrannical will gazed upon its grandeur at this juncture.
<Dimensional Reality Xyston>:: A weaponized form of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality in the shape of a Spear.

It holds the weight of the accumulated Realities and Dimensions within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as it has transcended any augmentations from outside sources, with a single swing from it being able to currently release an output of 25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values.
Wielding it for the Quintessential Kainos Emperor is akin to an extension of his will as no resource requirement is required...
25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values with every swing.
No resource cost!
This was what the weight of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality could do at its early stages!
But what Noah truly looked forward to...was him swinging the equivalent weight of All Dimensions and all of the fabric of Reality!
Now that...would be truly grand as his enemies could only despair.

But apart from the Xyston and other features of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality elevating, there was still the crucial integration of Manadynamics that had granted transformations to the Heart of Mana among others.
But what exactly was its boon after the partial integration with Noah?
Fundamental Natural Law <Manadynamics>:: A ruling authority that governs the absolute workings of Reality.
Understanding it to completion means comprehending this aspect of Reality as you can easily influence it in an unimaginable manner...

After the partial binding of the Source of Manadynamics, the Current Boosts are elevated to 15,000% Augmentation to All Essence Reserves, Essence Exchange Value, True Damage Values, True Defense Values, and True Vitality Values.
With the partial binding of this Source, you have come closer to understanding the Undefined Authority as you have unlocked Quintessential Nature Resonance.

The more Keys of Reality you bind to yourself, the greater your Quintessential Natural Resonance Value becomes and the closer you come to the understanding and utilization of the Undefined Absolute Authority...
HUUM!
The cerulean sea of essence around Noah surged as his Soul reacted to the ridiculous wonders...as well as something new.
Quintessential Nature Resonance!
Noah's will focused on this new construct right away as new details arose.
<Quintessential Nature Resonance>:: You have begun integrating with Nature as the Sources bound to you resonate at the depths of your Soul to grant a Resonance Value.
This Resonance Value will augment your Defense, Damage, Vitality, Resource...all Values under you after all other augmentations have been accounted for.
The greater the Resonance Value, the greater power you can exert through Nature.
Current Resonance Value- .15( Dream ~.025, Avalon ~.025, Manadynamics ~.1)
A new form of a multiplicative augmentation to Noah's already impressive roster!
To fully understand just what this seemingly small value actually signified, we have to look at Noah's current Damage Value which had been elevated by tens of Quadrillions.

His Base Values came from his Six fully saturated Dimensional Realities in his Origin, the values from his Quintessential Natural Born Infinite Mana Physique, and a few other smaller sources- and then all these values were multiplied by the augmentations from his Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the Ascendancy Stanchions, and lastly the Decreta and Natural Laws!
The above-mentioned augmentations were three multipliers.
When multiplying his Base Values and these multipliers, Noah's Damage Value Output exceeded 50 Quadrillion and was in fact teetering at a value of 52 Quadrillion!
Now, a fourth multiplier apart from the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny, the Ascendancy Stanchions, and the augmentations from Decreta and Natural Laws came.
It was the Quintessential Nature Resonance Value of .15!
After all the prior augmentations, Noah's Damage Value of 52 Quadrillion was elevated even further by the Resonance Value of .15 as his true output now became 59.8 Quadrillion!
And this Resonance...was just coming from the Integration to Manadynamics, Dream, and Avalon.
When he added more decreta and Laws in the future, the Resonance Value would continue rising as his power would also elevate even higher!
His will calmed after being disrupted by Reality's actions as he gazed at everything.
The assimilation of hundreds of thousands of Realities continued as his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality continued to strengthen.

He could bind 2 more Fundamental Natural Laws or 6 Natural Laws as with the words of Reality that it would always continue seeking control, Noah had to be careful whenever he bound new Sources of Nature!
But as he finished his preparations now, his slumbering will still in the middle of an Infinite Dream bellowed out authoritatively.
<Begin the Integration of Providence...>
WAA!
He forged forward fearlessly as he would like to see Reality try something similar while the Source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was continuing to get strengthened!
Base Damage
6 Saturated Paramount Kainos Dimensional Realities = 6,080,000 TDV
Quintessential Natural Born Mana Physique = 170 Completed Physique Refinement Cycles * 6,000 TDV per Completed Physique Refinement Cycle = 1,020,000 TDV
[Eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor] = 5,000 TDV
TABOO LETHE's [Oblivion] = 100 TDV
Quasi-TABOO Relics = 25 TDV
TOTAL BASE DAMAGE CALCULATION — 6,080,000 TDV + 1,020,000 TDV + 5,000 TDV + 100 TDV + 25 TDV = 7,105,125 TDV
Multipliers
[Throne of Quintessential Tyranny] = 5x
Ascendant Quintessential Kainos Emperor True Form = 4,507,500x

Fundamental Natural Laws, Natural Laws, & Decreta = 0.177x from Gravitation + 0.165x from Polarity + 150x from Manadynamics + 3x from Entropy + 30x from Providence + 60x from Dream + 5x from Prana + 60x from Avalon + 5x from Mirror + 5x from Apollyon + 5x from Niflheim + 1x = 324.342x
TOTAL MULTIPLIER CALCULATION — 5x * 4,507,500x * 324.342x = 7,309,857,825x
TOTAL TDV CALCULATION — (6,080,000 TDV + 1,020,000 TDV + 5,000 TDV + 100 TDV + 25 TDV) * = 7,105,125 TDV * 7,309,857,825x = 51,937,453,578,853,125 True Dimensional Damage Values!

chapters.title: Chapter 2117 A Moment In Time! IX
paragraphs: Reality had stated that it would always bid for control whenever another chance arose, so just the Integration of another Natural Law where Noah was prepared might not be an event that Reality considered an opportunity.
It would try to hit Noah when he least expected it just like the initial try with the transportation of the Main Empyral Domain of Nature!
This was why he forged forward without fear as he finished his preparations.
He was ready to have his True Sanguine Clone make a move in the Quantum Dimension as the last piece of the puzzle before he fully participated in this battle was the formation of an ability.
The Fifth Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique!

The Third and Fourth Forms were respectively the Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg and the Beacon of Thorny Consecration as the Fifth Form that was being designed this whole time...it was at its completion!
Its design had to be even more special than the prior abilities, and the mixture of skills did not disappoint as a wondrous ability was born.

[Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Fifth Form]:: An amalgamation of 6 abilities of the Assassin Emperor of Severance, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation, Domain of Apocalypse, Bloodfiend, Incarnation of Fire, and Ashes to Ashes Dust to Dust. It has brought to fruition the ability of Quintessential Singularity Ignition that releases a manifestation of your blood and Will into raging flames around your body- flames that are made up of miniaturized modified engines of the Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkriegs that will latch and burn upon contact. When active, your body becomes a Singularity of Flames as you can affect the laws of the spacetime continuum around you, being able to release a barrage of enemies on enemies from afar or gravitate your enemies towards you to burn even closer. When receiving damage from any source while this ability is active, there is a 50% Chance to release a burst of Quintessential Retribution that releases Damage Values equivalent to 50% of your maximum possible Damage Value Output. All enemies that are damaged through this skill will be affected by the Bleeding Flames Reality Altering Affix, where the target will bleed Quintessential Flames that can spread around their bodies to deal 50% of the maximum damage output of the skill every microsecond until the flames are extinguished. When an enemy dies to Quintessential Singularity Ignition, their corpse will automatically explode to deal 200% of the skill's initial damage output. The final output Damage Value of this ability is set to a minimum of 10 Quadrillion True Dimensional Damage Values after accounting for your base boosts and multipliers. The minimum Damage can change and fluctuate in the future depending on your own base Damage Values and multipliers. Cost to cast: 10 Billion Units of the Essence of Reality and 10,000 Trillion Mana. Cost to keep active past 5 Microseconds: 1 Billion Million Units of the Essence of Reality every Microsecond.
A grand ability.

An ability that loosely allowed him to turn his body into a singularity of flames after he incorporated the Saintess of Fiery Damnation and Incarnation of Fire that stemmed from a long untouched skill tree of the <Herald of Fire>!

These two abilities along with the prior ones utilized to make the Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg...allowed for Noah to birth Quintessential Singularity Ignition as flames made up of countless miniaturized Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkriegs were born.
Quintessential Singularity Ignition that came with multiple.reality Altering concepts that would cause great headaches to Noah's enemies!

This was the Fifth Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques, and it didn't mean Noah had to use it alone. He was keeping the Beacon of Thorny Consecration active as the Heart of Mana paid the price for it.
He could also call down the massive blue domain of the Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg whenever he wished.
He could then call down the Quintessential Singularity Ignition as his enemies...oh they were in for a surprise!
With this...he left ready.
He was now ready to go as he finished off all preparations by giving one last gaze of his Will over the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature!

Other boons from the actions of Reality had yet to show their true effect as when the Main Empyral Domain of Nature exploded in the Dimensional Holy Land, the forging process for the elevation of RUINATION and the Primordial Disk was still ongoing.

The sudden surge of the Essence of a myriad of Natural Laws had been drawn into the Blacksmith's Forge and tainted the process of forging with a dense infusion of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws to the extent that Noah himself could not fathom what changes this would bring.
He would only know with time as alone with the Integration with Providence, Noah left behind some more commands as the moment in time was about to end.
<Absorb the essences of foreign Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws, focus on increasing understanding of Gravity and Polarity...and let us bring Entropy to completion.>
He had many cards up his sleeves.
He had enough Quintessential Kainos Natural Decretum Seeds.
He had Loot from NULLITY Beasts that would be getting utilized and he was about to gain even more of such loot in the Quantum Dimension.
He had many things that he was simultaneously doing while he revealed himself in the Quantum Dimension!
In his mind, the flow of time began to change.

Even while in slumber with his Main Body, his perspective switched to the True Sanguine Clone in the opening rift of the Quantum Rings while in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, the bodies of The Avalon and Dream Dimensional Rulers that had escaped from this location were just now arriving!
They would get to view the battle occurring here through the eyes of Noah's Dimensional Chassis as for now...
HUUUM!
Essence began to vibrate around Noah's True Sanguine clone as many gazes of Rulers were on him as he floated beside the Ender of Providence.
He even turned to give this Ender a cold gaze to serve as a reminder and warning before his figure floated into the deadly battlefield!
The Visage of CHARLEMAGNE was prominent as he and his Parallel Selves controlled a portion of the battlefield which was the Dimensional Conclave.
Then there was Lilith and her forces, lone Dimensional Rulers, and then the Tribunal Rulers that were all paying attention to his arriving figure as the winds of Destiny and Providence weaved madly!

chapters.title: Chapter 2118 Singularity Ignition And Retribution! I
paragraphs: Vibrant multicolored rings surrounded everything as the only exit had Enders of Nature surrounding it, this whole domain where the Dimensional Conclave took place floating in the midst of a vibrant multicolored sea within the Quantum Dimension.
The powerhouses within were abundant as they ranged from all Dimensions but Dream and Avalon as these Rulers had taken the path of veering away from this bloody conflict!
In the midst of all this, the visage of Noah's True Sanguine clone gazed coldly at the Ender of Nature before floating into this deadly domain.

His gaze was pertinent to the eyes of many as those that had seen him before- he held the same face as the Avalon Dimensional Chassis to them as CHARLEMAGNE's words of the Dimensional Inimicus being Reality with Avalon and Dream siding with it resonated brightly!
If they could capture this being, the whereabouts of Avalon and Dream could be unveiled.
This issue...was important to a few specific parties at this juncture.
One of them was the Tribunal Rulers and the other was the Quantum Dimension!
But the former weren't the first to make a move at Noah's appearance as the gaze of The Empress and the rest of the Tribunal Rulers changed soon after.
This was because they had gotten word of the disappearance of the Main Empyral Domain of Nature and the image of an Ender that was captured at its moment of disappearance!

This caused the gazes of Aegon and Althea to turn bright with wrath as among the 5 Tribunal Rulers, the two of them exploded out with power as their massive NULLITY Repics appeared within their hands- their eyes targeting none other than the Enders.
This left behind the Quantum Dimension as the party with the most interest to find the location of Avalon and Dream Dimensions as it was their people that moved towards Noah!
More accurately, CHARLEMAGNE watched on coldly as it wasn't even him who made the move this time.
He was one of the most powerful beings here, but he wasn't the only one.
There were the Mikado of Old and Strength who guarded the Pylon of Ascension.
Their power was mighty as they could not be discredited!
At this juncture, the Mikado of Old was the nearest to Noah's visage apart from CHARLEMAGNE as she made the first move.
Her figure was no longer in a human form as she had taken the form of her racial Lineage of the Royal Quantum Lightwalker.
Lightwalker!
A unique race of existences that were few in number as their Bloodline was VENERABLE at the start, and as they grew more powerful and refined it...ZENITH was not out of the picture!

As the name implied, they were made of a unique form of light at their core as the Mikado of Old had the star-like form of a regal multicolored creature with four pointed edges, a singular pristine eye present on the frontal surface of its face as its four edges were its strongest weapons.
They pulsed with a deadly light of Fundamental Natural Laws and Absolute Quantum Authority as part of the reason for the terror of the Royal Quantum Lightwalker...was their speed.
At birth, they could exceed the speed of light.
At their height of power?
SHIIING!
Not even a microsecond was required as the massive visage of a four-pointed star appeared behind him!
The truly powerful Rulers were the only ones who could follow this shocking speed as among those paying attention, Lilith was the very first.

She sought to understand the extent that this being could pose a threat to others as this was part of the reason she didn't reveal his identity, but when she saw that he couldn't even react against the speed of the Mikado of Old, she was disappointed!
Noah's visage could be seen still floating silently under their sharp eyes as he didn't react in any way to the danger that had appeared behind him- as if he didn't even know it was there.

This caused Lilith to be disappointed as even though he had whatever unique capability he had to affect Anchors, he needed the power to back it. If a Clone of his could so easily be dominated or killed...he wouldn't be able to play a major part in the events to come!
The result of what would happen next could easily be discerned.
Or so they thought.
<A child jumping int->
BZZT!

The words of the Mikado of Old resounded just as its sharp star-like edge filled with multiple Absolute Authorities reached inches of the back of Noah's head, its goal being clear desegregation and destruction as the memories of this being could be read thereafter!
But before this sharp stellar edge could reach his head, the fair hands of its intended target reached out.
Without even turning around.
As if he didn't even need to turn around!

His bare hands reached out as his fingers grasped onto the stellar edge of the Mikado of Old filled with Absolute Authorities, the fabric of Reality pulsing and beginning to shatter at the contact point as his ringers clamped down as if they were made of quintessential metal!
This...was the interception of tens of Quadrillions of Damage Values.
And he did it so easily as how could he not?!
His Beacon of Thorny Consecration alone exceeded 60 Quadrillion Defense Values. His Celestial Lich's Armament of Devotion which was also always active also exceeded 60 Quadrillion Defense Values.
This was already over 120 Quadrillion in Defense Values as his Innate Dimensional Barrier was not even yet brought into the picture!
The Defense Values he had set up encapsulated the extent of the damage that a Mikado had released.
A Mikado!
One of the Four existences that guarded the Pylon of Ascension!
It was preposterous to see as from afar, Lilith's gaze turned utterly bright as a dazzling smile erupted from her face.
From afar, CHARLEMAGNE's gaze turned extremely cold along with a few other existences who could follow this speed!
They all realized that this being had not bothered to even turn around when a Mikado was attacking not because his eyes and will could not even keep up.
It was simply that he didn't even feel the need to turn around.
At this juncture, their eyes and wills were moving in the time scale of nanoseconds as they all saw the eyes of Noah seemingly come to life as his gaze and will landed on each of them.
As he gazed upon all of them while holding back an attack of a Mikado, waves of Haki emanated out of his will as he spoke with authority!
<Dredges of the past and inconsequential Rulers...it is time for you all to step aside.>
WAA!
Boundless Tyranny began to dance wildly as a booming symphony of battle glory began to resound in the surroundings!

chapters.title: Chapter 2119 Singularity Ignition And Retribution! II
paragraphs: Tyranny!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor spoke out in the face of exceedingly powerful existences within domineering grandeur as his words caused the minds of all Rulers to be roused!
And while his bare hands grasped the sharp pointed star end of a Royal Quantum Lightwalker, Noah uttered forth coldly.
<Fifth Form.>
<Quintessential Singularity Ignition> was called out.

A stellar blue light then dazzling erupted from Noah as it bloomed into cataclysmic cerulean flames that instantly wrapped around his whole body- flames that pulsed with grandiosity as they seemed to be made up of countless miniaturized cerulean Blitzkriegs of lights!
These raging flames seemingly had a tyrannical Will as they engulfed the resplendent form of the Mikado of Old and caused a massive explosive force akin to the birth of a singularity!

And...it truly was the birth of a Singularity as the visage of the Mikado of Old was knocked backwards at an unprecedented speed as over 60 Quadrillions Quintessential Damage Values smashed into it- in addition to the Thorn Damage from the Beacon of Thorny Consecration.

The eyes of all beings rose with shock at this astounding display from a relatively unknown being as before they could even fully react, they saw the cerulean flames that had bathed this being roar out with waves of Haki as one could barely see Noah's figure within make a beckoning motion towards the figure of the Mikado of Old that was just thrown away.

And within the span of a few nanoseconds...space twisted as a shocking and undeniable Gravitational pull erupted to wrap around the glorious four-pointed star form of the Mikado of Old as her visage reappeared right before Noah, only to be engulfed by the Flames of the Quintessential Singularity Ignition once more!
BZZZT!
The singular eye on this powerful existence trembled as it was shocked to find at this moment that its Innate Dimensional Barrier...had just shattered.
Its Vitality then began to be eaten up as shockingly golden blood of light leaked from it as it actually burned to become hot cerulean flames that further coiled around it!
It was such a shocking development that the Will of the Mikado of Old explosively bellowed out thereafter and exploded with power, trying to put up a distance as fast as possible!
<OOOOOOH!>
SHIING!
The means of truly powerful existences were many.
Her figure of light instantly turned into countless Shards that flashed and disappeared, reforming beside CHARLEMAGNE's visage as her single eye shone with disbelief and rage!
Her will and the Wills of many locked onto the existence currently bathed in exceedingly stellar blue flames.
The flames could seemingly warp the fabric of Reality around him as the spacetime continuum fluctuated as if a singularity was blooming!
It was the reveal of a shocking personage of power that was unknown before this, but he now gazed upon the masses as his power meant too many things.
From afar, Lilith's smile turned into a raucous laugh as her visage released even greater power, the three Undead Emperors beside her shooting out pillars of crimson light that connected to her.

Undead Emperor Feng had an impassive gaze as his eyes stopped on Noah's ignited visage, the other two Undead Emperors being a Glacial Zombie Emperor and an Abyssal Halcyon Titan who burned brightly at this moment- their source of power all connecting and flowing into Lilith as her Aura Potency became maddeningly tyrannical while her figure released a bellow and surged towards CHARLEMAGNE!
The choice of enemies in this battle.
This was a crucial thing as if one chose a certain powerful enemy, they would be left in a bitter battle for nearly the whole duration of the battle!
So the Wills of many observed to see which combatant this new entrant would choose.

And the gaze of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor pressed down on the masses as he moved away from the protected Mikado who now had one of CHARLEMAGNE'S bodies and the Mikado of Strength come near her.
The big bosses could be targeted later when their resource reserves were more depleted as the Quintessential Kainos Emperor would not bind his time to them entirely!
His gaze went to those a level below them.
His gaze went to the somewhat average in power Rulers as well as...the Legions of NULLITY Beasts surrounding the Tribunal Rulers.
His eyes were already seeing the All Source Enhancers as his figure that remained ignited flickered and disappeared!
ZIIP!

The distance between space twisted and malformed as he seemingly squeezed and shorted it to jump from one location to another within a fraction of a nanosecond, his body burning with wild stellar cerulean flames as he reappeared...in the midst of one of the 5 vast NULLITY Beast Legions.
It was the Legion under Aegon as the eyes of this Ruler instantly honed onto Noah.

Noah whose gaze remained placid as with his hands free, he moved them towards his chest as if he was pulling on the very fabric of space around him! This pulling motion caused the stellar cerulean Flames surrounding him to rage as they gave off an obscene Gravitational pull while spreading out like scorching blue waves- the bodies of hundreds of nearby NULLITY Beasts being pulled towards him as they were smashed with an area of effect damage exceeding 60 Quadrillion!
HOOONG!

Their gray scales cracked and shattered as the bodies of over half of these NULLITY Beasts instantly became crushed by the oppressive Absolute Mana Authority that made up most of these terrifying blue flames.
And the moment their bodies shattered...
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Their corpses exploded into massive scorching waves akin to miniature singularities that utterly decimated any other lifeforms nearby!
BOOM!...
It was akin to a glorious chain reaction that decimated the remaining half of the NULLITY Beasts.
This in turn left the attractive force of the Singularity Ignition to pull in even more NULLITY Beasts as a domineering voice was heard once more!
<Third Form.>
Quintessential Singularity Ignition had the undeniable ability of deploying a force of attraction against enemies to pull them close.
The Third Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques was the Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg which had a repulsive force that wouldn't even let enemies come close!

After pulling more NULLITY Beasts in as they only just began to burn, Noah's visage erupted with a Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg as a repulsive force smashed out with the deployment of a domain, the newly pulled hundreds of NULLITY Beasts bellowing out as they were reduced to cinders right after- their bodies blown away as their corpses exploded into scorching singularities that burned hundreds more!
Within a few nanoseconds.
All encompassed in less than a microsecond!

A chain reaction began where the feature of Quintessential Singularity Ignition of exploding the corpses of destroyed enemies for 200% of the Damage...it was too much of an obscene construct as seas of cerulean scorching singularities were spreading all around- each one exceeding 120 Quadrillion Damage Values!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2120 Singularity Ignition And Retribution! III
paragraphs: From the Quintessential Singularity Ignition, chains of scorching flames that tore apart the very fabric of Reality exploded from every corpse that was made as a result of the cerulean flames!
Because of this, a number of NULLITY Beasts exceeding a few thousand fell and turned to dust under Noah's gaze as his visage looked like an Incarnation of Apocalyptic flames!
He was truly putting on an Apocalyptic display.
He showed he was powerful.
But he wasn't the only powerful being here.

Radiance erupted in the midst of the NULLITY Beast Legions as Aegon's gaze had a trace of wrath, his hands waving a massive gray greatsword on the path of the bellowing blue explosions of Singularities as a wave of NULLITY shot out to form a wall!
In another direction of the NULLITY Beasts Legions, the cry of a bow rang out as the area above Noah soon became encompassed by simmering gray arrows of vibrant radiance.
Althea had also made a move that came from a NULLITY Relic as a few tens of Quadrillions of Damage Values rained down!
Two Tribunal Rulers made moves to contain Noah and his outburst as he truly seemed like an unstoppable raging Singularity.
While the prompts of loot cascaded over his eyes and he faced the counterattack of two Tribunal Rulers, his head rose up as he bellowed madly!
<OOOOOOH!>

A bellow raging with Haki and power as soon after, the flames of Singularity around him received an infusion of Absolute Dream and Avalon Authorities on top of Billions of the Essence of Reality- the stellar cerulean flames turning into billowing waves of cataclysmic fire that stretched out with him at the center and threatened to down everything!!!
But once more, he wasn't the only powerful being here.
As his body released Seas of scorching flames and he seemed ready to assert his dominance once more...
SHAA!
Two more auras appeared to his left and right.

The Invigilator, Ezekiel could be seen with radiant silver-white hair as he carried a radiant gray Flail in his hands that he pointed forth. The Eminent Mastermind, Noah, carried a dazzling gray Spear that released an aurora of grandiosity!
The both of them shockingly moved in conjunction as they spoke simultaneously.
<Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity>
The fabric of Reality flashed with darkness and a gray radiance for an instant.
From four directions, dark gray walls appeared as they ignored the very fabric of Reality to instantly close in on the raging Incarnation of flames!
His visage that had nearly turned the surroundings into a scorching sea was seemingly instantly snuffed out as it was enclosed into an unbreakable prison of NULLITY.
A prison that looked like a casket as the radiant Spear from the Eminent Mastermind shot out like a nuke that instantly pierced this casket at its very center!
It entered from the front of the casket and pierced through the back in a shocking development.
Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity.
An ability that isolated the target from the very fabric of Reality as what did this mean?
<The arrogant fool is done for.>
Aegon spoke out while extinguishing the remaining blue flames as he knew of the shocking attack that two Tribunal Rulers had thrown out in conjunction really well.

An inescapable prison that cut one off from Reality itself as only NULLITY surrounded them- it meant that they would not even be able to pull upon the Sources of Nature as they were cut off from even the decreta and Laws they were integrated with!
So one could not even usher and call forth Absolute Authority within it.

And while contained in the <Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity>, a NULLITY Relic had pierced through it while the walls themselves constantly attacked and decayed one's Origin with the essence of NULLITY as they would face attacks on all sides while they couldn't even defend, the only fate for them being death!
Yet...
DUM!
The eyes of the Tribunal Rulers sharpened as a droning sound was heard from within the Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
Like drums of War.
Like a beast that couldn't be kept chained breaking out!
But how was this possible?
He should have been blocked off from even Sources of Nature as he wouldn't have been able to protect himself!
But Reality was different.
What they had trapped was not a being that had merely integrated with Nature.
He had bound its source entirely as he could pull upon as much Absolute Authority as his soul could bear, and Absolute Pure Mana Output would change this to pure Authority of Manadynamics!
But this wasn't why the Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity was vibrating while droning sounds bellowed out.
It was because the four walls of this Casket were releasing attacks on all sides- and constantly at that.

The already cast Quintessential Singularity Ignition had multiple Reality Altering affixes alone of them...was Quintessential Retribution activating 50% of the time when he received attacks from any sources!
And within the terrifying casket, Noah was receiving attacks constantly as he didn't even have to lift a linger.
Terrifying waves and arcs of deeply blue flames began to explode and burn around him as they only increased in concentration and frequency!
DUM!
DUM!
CRACK!
The pristine and clear crystalline gray surfaces of the Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity began to crack.
The moment they did, arcs of violent blue flames began to burn in the surroundings as they surged out like flaming tongues of lightning and began to fill the surrounding space.
It was Retribution.
Quintessential Retribution!
DUM! CRACK!
And the cracks extended as the Turbid Casket of Interminable Nullity soon had cerulean gaps freely seen all around it as it was shattered by a shocking force soon after!

The dazzling silver gray Spear gravitated onto the Eminent Mastermind as his eyes twisted coldly, his gaze and the gazes of many landing on the culprit who was surrounded by flaming arcs of Singularities.
Flaming arcs of Retribution that spread out maddeningly and with rage to cause an eruption of a storm of blue flames!
And at the center of it all, the culprit was nonchalant as he even had his hands behind his back.
His tyrannical gaze passed over the Eminent Mastermind, The Invigilator, Aegon, and Althea as they were still surrounded by Legions of Abominations as he voiced out.
<Pathetic.>
WAA!
