chapters.title: Chapter 2121 Who Are You?!
paragraphs: <Pathetic.>
WAA!
His words ushered out crystal clear as 4 Tribunal Rulers had surrounded him, and even they could not hold him down!
So his Tyranny rose ever higher as his voice continued while he tapped the air behind him.
<For you all...it seems that I do not even need to rise from my throne.>
Space fluctuated and vibrated.
It felt like another singularity was blooming, but it emanated within Noah's own body as he called an Innate authority from his own Lineage!
Multicolored with its structural makeup seemingly forged from stellar crystalline connate metals, a massive throne inscribed with dazzling blue lemniscate ecritures bloomed.
It was the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny.
Dazzling in grandeur and magisterial in majesty, it had been moved from the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature as Noah's True Sanguine Clone...sat upon it fearlessly.
Against terrifying enemies, he truly sat down!
As if they were all beneath him!
As if they couldn't compare!
His figure and throne burned with blue flames as even the Reality around him was melting, the Four Tribunal Rulers gazing towards him coldly as at this juncture, The Empress made a move.
And this move began with a sonorous voice of utter majesty.
<Who are you?>
SHIING!
Ignited with flames of a singularity and situated on a blazing throne, Noah's gaze reacted to this voice as he turned towards the far away Empress.
The one who sat beside OPPENHEIMER.
The one behind his success from what others believed!
She had not truly made any moves in this battle as nobody fully grasped the extent of her power.
Her dazzling dark hair pulsed with grandiosity as she floated forward calmly while voicing out towards Noah!
Who was he?
Who was this new combatant that was connected to the Avalon and Dream Dimensions that seemed to
now be allied with the Will of Reality?
<Who am I?>
HUUUM!
His voice resonated out in the form of Haki as the surrounding space trembled.
His identity.
He had hidden it for the most part in order to not draw attention to himself when he couldn't fully protect himself and his interests.
Even now, he wasn't the most powerful person out there as even on this battlefield, there lay terrifying monsters!
And this wasn't to even mention the hidden powerhouses within Dimensions...or the True Emperors and any Ancestors that would very soon choose to descend in order to fulfill their wishes.
But this name and distinction stood for something.
Unmatched in this Age.
The epitome of multiple Aspects in this Age.
The most prime example of an Emperor in this Age!
Could he truly achieve this if he remained cautious and continued hiding his title?
If he were to freely let it be known, he would be targeted by all those who seriously sought the Seat of the True Emperor!
And if he was targeted...terrifyingly powerful enemies would throw themselves at his feet.
Enemies that if he could overcome...his already insane and unrealistic pace of progression would become even more Reality breaking!
So when the right hand of OPPENHEIMER asked him who he was...
<I have been called many names in the past.>
HOOONG!
Mana and Entropy surged as Providence began to spill around wildly.
Many eyes were focused here as even the battle Enders constricted their pupils as they did not expect what was to come!
As he sat on his throne with beautifully scorching blue flames and arcs of light raging around him, he leaned back and tapped on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as he spoke.
<I have been called many names. The 9th Infernal Lord, The Progenitor, the Tyrannical Emperor...and even the Ethereal Dimensional Emperor.>
WAA!
As he spoke, he tapped the handrest of his throne as a dazzling solidified crown appeared above him, the words <ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR> blooming with fantastical grandiosity as he wasn't done!
<But you all...can call me by another name!>
The <ETHEREAL> portion next to his distinction fluctuated and changed as the arcs and tendrils of unquenchable flames of authority around him seemingly carved it out.
<QUINTESSENTIAL>
BOOOM!
Billowing streams of Providence surged out from cracks in space as they washed over his grand figure.

Shining brightly under the eyes of all, the distinction of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR was laid bare as it swirled around a solidified crown that floated backwards to stand atop the backbone of a Throne that shone with utter brilliance!
And the Emperor seated upon the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny gazed upon the swathes of truly powerful beings in this Age as his Will emanated out.
<You all can crawl back from the caves you came out of and retire. This Age...is not for you to shine bright in.>

<Gaze upon the embers of your past grandeur and rule. Remember of the Ages past and the Eras gone...because that is the last glimmer of brilliance you all can achieve. From here on out, there will be no fight for the Seat of the True Emperor. There will be no cycles of Ages after mine. Rejoice in your past accomplishments and relish in them as for you all, there is no future. No future...unless you bend under my Will.>
Stark silence.

Utmost shock and incredulity led to utmost silence as briefly, the chaotic battlefield had no attacks being thrown out as only the sound of crackling cerulean flames surging around a singular figure could be heard!
This single unveiling changed so many things as it took more than a microsecond until the results of all beings were displayed!
From afar, Lilith's smiling and raucous expression froze as the crimson eye on her forehead turned extremely chilly.
She realized she had made a grave mistake.
The being she had chosen not to reveal in order to bring more chaos to the fight for the authority of the True Emperor...he actually had the distinction as the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR!
In this Age of Quintessence!
A seat of authority...that she had to grasp in order to attain her ideals.
She had actually helped keep such a being hidden!
<AWOOO!>

A howl of rage bellowed out from her as the crimson eye on her forehead expanded evermore, her skin cracking and splitting in an obscene way as dense waves of authority swirled around her- the connections she shared with the three Undead Emperors around her only being strengthened as they turned into pillars of light.

Pillars that were so massive that they wrapped around the Undead Emperor Feng, the Glacial Zombie Emperor, and the Abyssal Halcyon Titan as all three terrifying beings became twisted in space and flowed to be absorbed into her expanding crimson eye!
Her form began to change and gigantify as with horrendous waves of power, she shot out like an unchained beast towards the cold faced QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR as she wasn't the only one.
Out of the many blazing auras of power in this enclosed domain, the vast majority all surged towards Noah without so much as a word.

The reveal was done as the intended consequence bloomed at this moment, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor gazing at all of this with eyes and Will that utterly bubbled forth tremendous levels of Tyranny as seated upon his throne- his palm opened to clasp a newly appearing Xyston that he pointed towards all the surging enemies!!!

sentences.text: <Pathetic.>
WAA!
His words ushered out crystal clear as 4 Tribunal Rulers had surrounded him, and even they could not hold him down!
So his Tyranny rose ever higher as his voice continued while he tapped the air behind him.
<For you all...it seems that I do not even need to rise from my throne.>
Space fluctuated and vibrated.
It felt like another singularity was blooming, but it emanated within Noah's own body as he called an Innate authority from his own Lineage!
Multicolored with its structural makeup seemingly forged from stellar crystalline connate metals, a massive throne inscribed with dazzling blue lemniscate ecritures bloomed.
It was the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny.
Dazzling in grandeur and magisterial in majesty, it had been moved from the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature as Noah's True Sanguine Clone...sat upon it fearlessly.
Against terrifying enemies, he truly sat down!
As if they were all beneath him!
As if they couldn't compare!
His figure and throne burned with blue flames as even the Reality around him was melting, the Four Tribunal Rulers gazing towards him coldly as at this juncture, The Empress made a move.
And this move began with a sonorous voice of utter majesty.
<Who are you?>
SHIING!
Ignited with flames of a singularity and situated on a blazing throne, Noah's gaze reacted to this voice as he turned towards the far away Empress.
The one who sat beside OPPENHEIMER.
The one behind his success from what others believed!
She had not truly made any moves in this battle as nobody fully grasped the extent of her power.
Her dazzling dark hair pulsed with grandiosity as she floated forward calmly while voicing out towards Noah!
Who was he?
Who was this new combatant that was connected to the Avalon and Dream Dimensions that seemed to
now be allied with the Will of Reality?
<Who am I?>
HUUUM!
His voice resonated out in the form of Haki as the surrounding space trembled.
His identity.
He had hidden it for the most part in order to not draw attention to himself when he couldn't fully protect himself and his interests.
Even now, he wasn't the most powerful person out there as even on this battlefield, there lay terrifying monsters!
And this wasn't to even mention the hidden powerhouses within Dimensions...or the True Emperors and any Ancestors that would very soon choose to descend in order to fulfill their wishes.
But this name and distinction stood for something.
Unmatched in this Age.
The epitome of multiple Aspects in this Age.
The most prime example of an Emperor in this Age!
Could he truly achieve this if he remained cautious and continued hiding his title?
If he were to freely let it be known, he would be targeted by all those who seriously sought the Seat of the True Emperor!
And if he was targeted...terrifyingly powerful enemies would throw themselves at his feet.
Enemies that if he could overcome...his already insane and unrealistic pace of progression would become even more Reality breaking!
So when the right hand of OPPENHEIMER asked him who he was...
<I have been called many names in the past.>
HOOONG!
Mana and Entropy surged as Providence began to spill around wildly.
Many eyes were focused here as even the battle Enders constricted their pupils as they did not expect what was to come!
As he sat on his throne with beautifully scorching blue flames and arcs of light raging around him, he leaned back and tapped on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny as he spoke.
<I have been called many names.
The 9th Infernal Lord, The Progenitor, the Tyrannical Emperor...and even the Ethereal Dimensional Emperor.>
WAA!
As he spoke, he tapped the handrest of his throne as a dazzling solidified crown appeared above him, the words <ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR> blooming with fantastical grandiosity as he wasn't done!
<But you all...can call me by another name!>
The <ETHEREAL> portion next to his distinction fluctuated and changed as the arcs and tendrils of unquenchable flames of authority around him seemingly carved it out.
<QUINTESSENTIAL>
BOOOM!
Billowing streams of Providence surged out from cracks in space as they washed over his grand figure.

Shining brightly under the eyes of all, the distinction of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR was laid bare as it swirled around a solidified crown that floated backwards to stand atop the backbone of a Throne that shone with utter brilliance!
And the Emperor seated upon the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny gazed upon the swathes of truly powerful beings in this Age as his Will emanated out.
<You all can crawl back from the caves you came out of and retire.
This Age...is not for you to shine bright in.>
<Gaze upon the embers of your past grandeur and rule.
Remember of the Ages past and the Eras gone...because that is the last glimmer of brilliance you all can achieve.
From here on out, there will be no fight for the Seat of the True Emperor.
There will be no cycles of Ages after mine.
Rejoice in your past accomplishments and relish in them as for you all, there is no future.
No future...unless you bend under my Will.>
Stark silence.

Utmost shock and incredulity led to utmost silence as briefly, the chaotic battlefield had no attacks being thrown out as only the sound of crackling cerulean flames surging around a singular figure could be heard!
This single unveiling changed so many things as it took more than a microsecond until the results of all beings were displayed!
From afar, Lilith's smiling and raucous expression froze as the crimson eye on her forehead turned extremely chilly.
She realized she had made a grave mistake.
The being she had chosen not to reveal in order to bring more chaos to the fight for the authority of the True Emperor...he actually had the distinction as the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR!
In this Age of Quintessence!
A seat of authority...that she had to grasp in order to attain her ideals.
She had actually helped keep such a being hidden!
<AWOOO!>

A howl of rage bellowed out from her as the crimson eye on her forehead expanded evermore, her skin cracking and splitting in an obscene way as dense waves of authority swirled around her- the connections she shared with the three Undead Emperors around her only being strengthened as they turned into pillars of light.

Pillars that were so massive that they wrapped around the Undead Emperor Feng, the Glacial Zombie Emperor, and the Abyssal Halcyon Titan as all three terrifying beings became twisted in space and flowed to be absorbed into her expanding crimson eye!
Her form began to change and gigantify as with horrendous waves of power, she shot out like an unchained beast towards the cold faced QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR as she wasn't the only one.
Out of the many blazing auras of power in this enclosed domain, the vast majority all surged towards Noah without so much as a word.

The reveal was done as the intended consequence bloomed at this moment, the Quintessential Kainos Emperor gazing at all of this with eyes and Will that utterly bubbled forth tremendous levels of Tyranny as seated upon his throne- his palm opened to clasp a newly appearing Xyston that he pointed towards all the surging enemies!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2122 Quintessence! I
paragraphs: Across the spacetime continuum.
Within the folds of the Boundary Between Realities of the Desolate Mausoleum.

The Visage of an existence was hidden within as he gave off an air of contained power, his eyes luminous as at times they seemed as small as stars while at other times...they were larger than even Cosmos!
This existence was veiled in the layers of space as he was undisturbed since the end of the Last Age, his gaze far-reaching as at this moment, his luminous eyes opened wide to gaze forward.

They peeled across the layers of space as Providence surged around this being, a scene being refracted before him soon after that showed the image of a tyrannical Emperor surrounded by blazing blue flames showing his distinction clearly!
<...The Key has unveiled itself?>
The eyes of this being rose quizzically as he gazed with scrutiny, the identity of this existence being something it was waiting for a long, long time!
And now that his identity was unveiled...
<It seems that time is coming ever closer. The time for the complete end of history...or the ushering of a new one.>
HUUUM!
The fabric of Reality trembled at his thoughts as this existence still didn't make a move.
It wasn't his time yet...even though this time seemed to be infinitely near!
Across these very same folds of the Boundary Between Realities.
BZZZT!
The Primordial Temples across Realities were trembling and shaking chaotically as all Primordial Seers overseeing them felt an unprecedented change!
A number of weeks ago, the enemy of Primordials had risen as the statues of the Primordial Temples had bled crimson gold blood.
At this moment, these statues shattered and overflowed with crimson blood as the identity of the enemy was made clear!
Painted in glorious crimson gold, the words QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR luminously showed above all Primordial Temples.
The Seers saw their future enemy clearly as they didn't find out who he was through their own efforts, it was only after he had revealed himself that his identity became clear!
And this unveiling fundamentally changed many things as this being effectively pointed the sword of Primordials and many others directly towards him!
As for whether he would survive as the target of all powerful Emperors of this Age...
Well, this could only be proven if his distinction remained to be true.
If he truly showed and exemplified Quintessence!
And the show of this would be felt by nobody else more than those currently in an enclosed domain with him in one of the many distant multicolored Seas of the Quantum Dimension.

There were a variety of beings who reacted in a unique manner as the distinction of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR being known, with the figure of Lilith howling out in rage and ignoring everyone else as she shot out towards Noah's visage.
In her mind, his words continued to repeat over and over again as she felt like she had been played!
<Remember of the Ages past and the Eras gone...because that is the last glimmer of brilliance you all can achieve...Remember of the Ages past...>
OOOH!
Her figure only increased in stature and speed while such words repeated in her mind, billowing Entropy surging around her as she sought the incandescent Emperor that remained seated this whole time.
Another party that did something similar was the forces of the Quantum Dimension as finally...CHARLEMAGNE made a move.

He and multiple of his Parallel Selves surged even as Enders of Nature placed themselves on his path, with the Mikado and other Rulers of the Quantum Dimension moving towards Noah with utmost coldness as this being stood opposite to their aims and ideals- with the throne of the True Emperor needing to be taken by someone on their side in order to fully achieve what they sought!

The Tribunal Rulers were already close as they blazed with NULLITY and prepared to release Apocalyptic attacks, with even The Empress adopting a sharp expression as her body began to glow with an even more radiant shade of NULLITY.
Then, there were others who took different actions.
There was Albus from the Prana Dimension who gazed at everything with his ancient gaze as he kept the Prana Dimensional Rulers back.
There were the Elysium Dimensional Rulers whose bodies were illuminated by Providence as they stared towards Noah in shock while also not making a move!
But...the vast majority of Rulers from other Dimensions present were surging towards the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR.
How would he face the attacks of the strongest beings here?!
His tyrannical visage retained his grandeur as his Will echoed out amidst enemies nearing his position, his face becoming increasingly radiant and magisterial.
<Let me show you...just what Quintessence is.>
His Will focused on Lilith, CHARLEMAGNE, the Mikado, Tribunal Rulers, and any other Rulers that were rushing in this direction.
He only focused his Will on them as in the next second, most of their figures came to a halt as their eyes turned insurmountably somber, becoming filled with incredulity and shock soon after!

This was because at that instant, they felt a malicious and dominant Will pervading the depths of their very souls through a pristine connection as this will- it carried something extremely nefarious.
Through their own Integration to Decreta!
They felt a dominating will press upon their soul as unbelievably...this will began to burn with cerulean blue flames.

The Quintessential Kainos Mana had the capability of pressing his Will down through the Lines of Integration of the Sources he bound, but he didn't choose the feature of Neural Encroachment that would be rebuffed by the truly powerful beings the moment that they realized a will try to dominate them.
He instead wrapped his will with the flames of the Quintessential Singularity Ignition as he bypassed any and all defenses that his enemies had.

It was a move even he didn't fully know if it would work but...his will carried the Absolute Mana Authority of the flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition as he achieved a feat that utterly broke the scales of power!
If the ability of Neural Encroachment could pass through the Lines of Integration, why not the scorching flames of a singularity?!
And so...over 60 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values coursed through the Dream and Avalon Lines of Integration of his enemies as they smashed directly onto their souls.
An unprecedented result occurred next!

chapters.title: Chapter 2123 Quintessence! II
paragraphs: The truly powerful Dimensional Rulers more often than not had integrated a majority if not all of the Decreta of Dimensions, with the enemies before Noah either having integrated Dream or Avalon, or some having even integrated both!
They received Damage that seemingly came from the very depths of their souls as even their Innate Dimensional Barriers were not affected.
Beings like CHARLEMAGNE and Lilith came to a halt as Providence shone around them, their expressions turning extremely ugly as their Aspects of Existence acted by instinct.

The Tribunal Rulers and Mikado were the same as the moment they felt their Souls cry out and Providence and Destiny warn them of an utterly disastrous result, their souls painfully took the actions of shattering the Lines of Integration to either Dream or Avalon or both of them right away!

But some Rulers from the Niflheim, Fantasia, Mirror, Quantum...all of them that had begun to surge towards Noah just a step behind the truly powerful figures and had either Avalon or Dream Integrated- all of them became points of dazzling cerulean singularities.

Their defenseless souls could not withstand an initial outburst of tens of Quadrillions of Damage Values before they reacted to even shatter their Lines of Integration as their souls were instantly overcome and began to burn to cinders.
In the fantastical domain surrounded by multicolored Quantum Rings, over a dozen blue singularities burned and then exploded into an even grander expanse of blue flames soon after!
The cries of flames was the only thing that could be heard as these actions were too shocking!
And all of them came after the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR had said a single sentence.
Let me show you...just what Quintessence is.
This was what he had uttered.
HOOONG!
In response to these shocking actions, the auras of the most powerful Rulers blazed ever higher as they all had the same epiphany!
This being before them was the real deal.
Because if he was working in conjunction with Reality and they had done something to the Avalon and Dream Dimensions...
<The Sources of Dream and Avalon Dimensions have been tainted and can be used to attack you! Desegregate with these Decreta!>
Lilith howled out with immense rage and pain as this was the loss of two Sources of Nature!
The augmentations and capability to utilize their Absolute Authority were shockingly shattered as the capabilities of this existence sitting upon the Throne were truly unfathomable.

But the aura around Lilith, Tribunal Rulers, CHARLEMAGNE, and the two Mikados only raged higher as at this moment- even the dormant aura of the most powerful being among the Mirror Dimensional Rulers came forward to make a move!
Because they all had the same thought.
They could not let this being before them survive as the capability to taint the very Sources of Nature...it could not be allowed to exist!
So they moved forward with even greater resolve and power as one being in particular performed a unique action.
It was CHARLEMAGNE and his calculating gaze as his main body stayed behind.
Instead, his Parallel Selves were the ones that surged forward as shockingly, they weren't affected by the unfathomable attack that the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR had just released.
They were not from this path.
What they integrated with were not the Avalon and Dream Dimensions of this Main Path as they were not affected!
It meant this existence had not gained the capabilities to extend his will across the Parallel Paths.
It was all the more reason to strike him down now!
As the being wielding the most power here and not currently injured, he had his Parallel Selves ignore the attacks of Enders and swarm towards the being seated upon the Throne.
The being that at this moment shook his head dominatingly while hoisting the Dimensional Reality Xyston in his hands.
<You all still do not get it.>
WAA!
The Eyes of the Tri-Pupiled Kainos Emperor were piercing as they currently dripped with grandiosity!

A foreboding feeling rose in the hearts of all beings as The Empress in particular at this moment...had her eyes release a stellar glimmer that nobody else saw as a radiant gray light erupted to cover her body and soul.
Her eyes were sharp as her fair hands rose while controlling billowing waves of NULLITY while the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR finished his words.
<Quintessence...if showing it to you all is not enough, I will engrave it upon your souls as you perish.>
His Will erupted out.
He had latched upon the Lines of Integration for Dream and Avalon, but this wasn't the only Source he had bound to himself.
He had also integrated himself with an even stronger Source of Nature that all powerful existences relied upon- a Source of Nature that made up the very fabric of Reality!
His will latched onto Manadynamics.

And his visage lit up with beautiful blue flames as he wrapped the Lines of Integration stemming from this Source he had partially bound with blazing blue flames made up of countless miniaturized Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkriegs!
Entropy seethed in turn at the shocking and wanton destruction about to unfold.

The Hearts of the truly powerful Rulers shuddered as they felt the surging flames burn at the very depths of their souls- and from a sacred Natural Law that no single being should be able to alone greatly influence!
The quintessentially blazing flames actually encroached to decimate their souls from this Source.
This was Manadynamics.
A Fundamental Natural Law that governed the very balance of Reality!
Lilith had bellowed for all Rulers to leave behind Avalon and Dream and desegregate them as they alone were a tremendous loss.
But the Integration of a Fundamental Natural Law?
It granted them too great power as to release it from Integration...it was an insurmountably hard choice!
But the truly powerful made this choice right away as they knew what was at stake.

The truly powerful felt the unfathomable incredulity and shock as their instincts instantly allowed them to shatter this connection they felt as they suffered yet another heavy injury, as well as their power receiving a great reduction!
The truly powerful did this.
Others...took a bit longer to make this instant decision.
And this length of time...
It cost them a great deal.
It cost them too much!
HOOONG!
A blaring horn rang out as in the next moment, only silence could be heard as something terrifying became a reality.

A scintillating blue light as if a Reality was burning emanated out as the Mikado of Old and the Mikado of Strength had their figures become bathed with cerulean blue flames that began by destroying their very souls.

Quintessential Treasure Cache was activated silently for the two of them as in an unbelievable turn of events, the bright bodies of two of the Four Mikado that guarded the Pylon of Ascension were being scorched black as their corpses...exploded into massive singularities soon after!
It was an unreal scene.
It was something that should not at all be possible as this next unfolding event seemingly occurred in a void of silence as the stature of these two renowned and powerful Rulers burned.
But they weren't the only ones.
Oh, they weren't the only ones!!!
Among the Tribunal Rulers, one being was also just a nanosecond behind on making the choice of instantly shattering their Integration to Manadynamics!

A scintillating blue light as if a Reality was burning emanated out as the Mikado of Old and the Mikado of Strength had their figures become bathed with cerulean blue flames that began by destroying their very souls.

Quintessential Treasure Cache was activated silently for the two of them as in an unbelievable turn of events, the bright bodies of two of the Four Mikado that guarded the Pylon of Ascension were being scorched black as their corpses...exploded into massive singularities soon after!
It was an unreal scene.
It was something that should not at all be possible as this next unfolding event seemingly occurred in a void of silence as the stature of these two renowned and powerful Rulers burned.
But they weren't the only ones.
Oh, they weren't the only ones!!!
Among the Tribunal Rulers, one being was also just a nanosecond behind on making the choice of instantly shattering their Integration to Manadynamics!

chapters.title: Chapter 2124 Unfathomable Grandiosity! I
paragraphs: The Mikado!
They guarded the Pylon of Ascension!
They were extremely powerful existences that had lived through multiple ages as in this Age of Quintessence, their gazes were on a boundless future.
This was because in this Age, the status quo would change as they would not remain guarding the Pylon of Ascension any longer!
The Ancestors were bound to descend as a new path would be opened after the destruction of Dimensions and Reality, with the gazes of the Mikado being on grander frontiers than the Barren Lands.
But even with those hopes and dreams backed by their terrifying strength...neither could have foreseen that it would all go up in flames on this day!
Through the Fundamental Natural Law of Manadynamics, many existences were hurt as the bodies of The Mikado of Old and Strength that had turned into blazing singularities were not the only ones.

Amidst the Primordial NULLITY Legions, a scintillating point of cerulean light burned as the person within the surging blue flames had an expression of incredulity as if he did not believe what was happening.
As if it was something that could not happen!

His hand that held the massive radiant gray sword had its bronze skin crackled and scored beyond measure as from within, his soul had thoroughly been covered by the Flames of a singularity as he was desegregated from all other bound decreta and Natural Laws a moment after, the light of Vitality in his eyes being extinguished as his visage soon exploded into a terrifying singularity that drowned out thousands of NULLITY Beasts!
A Tribunal Ruler.
A Seeker of the End!
Aegon...had fallen.
HOONG!

A piercing cry echoed out silently amidst the scorching flames as the NULLITY Relic he held disappeared amidst the raging flames, this unbelievable development falling under the eyes of all as utter silence pervaded the surroundings!
Disastrous.
It was utterly and cataclysmically disastrous for all those involved as nobody knew the consequences that would arise from the death of a Tribunal Ruler!
Albus gazed at everything from the designated thrones of the Prana Dimension, his ancient eyes dim as he and all the Prana Dimensional Rulers he had held behind had yet to suffer an ounce of damage.
He had lived across many Ages and come across multiple True Emperors.
He had seen the Ascension of True Emperors on their path before they took the Throne, and he had seen a variety of them and their disposition!
Some were tyrants who killed indiscriminately as all those in their opposition fell, and others only did enough to attain the authority and power they needed.
In the Age of Slaughter, countless Emperors had perished to the extent that the strongest beings were reduced by 80%!
Currently, it is the Age of Quintessence.
Looking at the burning singularities that used to be Dimensional Rulers, Albus had yet to ascertain how many Emperors would fall before everything drew to a close.
But as he saw the gaze of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR focus on only those attacking him and direct his might only to them, Albus was given an inkling to the character of this existence.
An existence that had somehow managed to grow capable of affecting the Lines of Integration of Nature.
A terrifying capability that would put any Emperor of Age a weapon that could cleave the path towards the Seat of the True Emperor!

But even as he saw all of this unbelievable might that actually cost the life of two of the Four Mikado that guarded the Pylon of Ascension and even a Tribunal Ruler...Albus still shook his head with tiredness and despondency as this Age was truly different from all others.
Other Ages did not have the complete destruction of everything on the line.
Other Ages did not have the interest of the Ancestors...who would be descending to personally achieve the aims that they sought!
So even with all this power that this exceptional being expressed...could it really fare against True Emperors of the past Ages and the Progeny of Ancestors outside these Barren Lands?
It was a despondent thought from the strongest Prana Dimensional Ruler as his body began to light up with a radiant verdant light, his Will also seeing the need to do his part!
Austere waves of Providence shone amidst raging waves of other essences.

At the depths of the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, the figure of Eowyn watched Noah's main body with an ever changing gaze as she saw the many essences of different Natural Laws flowing into him.

Every part of his seemed to be absorbing the essences of Natural Laws as he would gain an understanding of them sooner or later, while the understanding of his current Laws only continued to elevate to greater levels.

But apart from this, three dazzling Quintessential Treasure Caches had appeared above him as they shone with utmost splendor- these Caches belonging to the defeat of the Mikado of Old, the Mikado of Strength, and the Tribunal Ruler- Aegon!
Along with this, a massive radiant gray greatsword appeared beside the newly appearing Treasure Cache as it was the NULLITY Relic that Aegon used to carry!
Towards this, Eowyn simply heard Noah's billowing Will thundered out as this sword began to move.
<Break it down and Infuse everything about it into RUINATION and the Primordial Disk. This should allow them to complete their transformations.>
WAA!
An ever terrifying concentration of materials was veered towards the relics still burning brightly in the Blacksmith's Forge as the Will of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality did what it was told.
A will so powerful that while all of this occurred, he was binding another Source of Nature through the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
A partial binding that at this moment...
SHIIING!
Completed as rays of utterly magisterial golden light emanated from all around.

The rays of light formed into massive golden pillars that went from incorporeal until they materialized into shocking wonders- a myriad of golden pillars filled with Providence manifesting as Eowyn was shocked to see them smash towards Noah's regal figure!
The impact was immaculate and terrifying as thereafter...everything froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 2125 Unfathomable Grandiosity! II
paragraphs: Eowyn was still connected to Noah in a unique way as what he saw, she saw.
So she saw his actions as he terrifyingly used the Lines of Integration of the Sources he bound to attack those opposing him!
It was a shocking means for him to attain as the worry of his enemies getting stronger the more Dimensions he released was slowly destroyed with this.
So long as he integrated Sources of Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws, he could force his enemies to shatter their Lines of Integration as their boons would be cut off!
He would first weaken them, and then he would decimate them.
With such moves in his arsenal, how could the most powerful existences that relied on Natural Laws stand against him?
Their only option was to stop him in the quickest time possible- and that was actually seconds ago!
Because now, he had also bound Providence.
The Natural Law that acted akin to the light that would illuminate the unknown.
If he removed this from his enemies...how could they even foresee the wonders to become? Because Destiny alone would not be enough!
Thinking of this, Eowyn couldn't help but imagine the grand future.
The future that was full of possibilities and yet at the same time...a lot of uncertainties!

And before she could think any further, the complete integration to Providence occurred. The partial binding of the Source of Providence was also accomplished as multiple fantastical golden pillars of light smashed unto Noah.
They released incandescent lights all around that encompassed everything to the point that even Eowyn felt her mind blank out!
All thought stopped.

At the center of it all, Noah was the only one who experienced exactly what shocking change was brought forth. It was a unique sensation he had only come across a few times before where he felt as if his consciousness was entirely taken out of his physical form and placed elsewhere.
This time he seemed to be looking at an expense of gold, and among all of this halcyon grandeur...innumerable White Lines ran parallel amongst each other.

One line in particular was much larger than countless of them combined as it pulsed with a shocking amount of Providence- the same Providence that was also shared by the innumerable branches connected to it!
It was the Main Path and the Myriad of Parallel Paths.

The partial binding of the Source of Providence had somehow allowed Noah to gaze upon the unique scenes of the innumerable Parallel Paths as his consciousness lit up brightly while delving fully into it, intent on understanding exactly what this concept entailed.
While his main body did this, the events in the Quantum Rings that contained the Dimensional Conclave continued to unfold!

Unseen by many, the Elysium Dimensional Rulers had their figures tremble as a golden light pierced across their eyes that then gazed towards the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR in sheer disbelief and wonder.
But there was enough of disbelief and wonder to go around!
Because the action of granting true death to a Tribunal Ruler was more than enough to stop everything in its tracks.
The gaze of the Eminent Mastermind Noah was of utmost solemnity while Ezekiel and Althea had looks of utter Fury and disbelief in their eyes.
Then there was The Empress.
Then there was CHARLEMAGNE who also gazed towards Noah with solemnity as he looked at the scorching Seas of Singularities where the two Mikado used to be!
Off to the side, Lilith had an utterly ashen expression as she realized just the sheer gravity of opportunity she had let slip up and let loose this whole time.
Many did not take action right away, but one being sighed with solemnity as her fair hand reached to tap her chest.
<You should not have done that.>
Her voice was clear as it rang out amidst the blazing flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition.
From her chest, her hand seemed to be pulling from her heart.
She was The Empress, and she held a special position and power among Primordials.
She may not have taken the first ranking as the most powerful Tribunal Ruler, but this did not matter to her as she exceeded this ranking in another way!
She was connected to OPPENHEIMER.

Others had received many boons and treasures from OPPENHEIMER as they wielded great power, but what about the woman he always had by his side? What would she carry that stemmed out of these Barren Lands? What method of protection and power did OPPENHEIMER grant to the one he left behind?
SHIIING!
From the hand placed over her heart, she made a pulling motion as...a flower came out.

A pure and simple flower that had 10 silver gray petals and a bud that shone with an innumerable light of NULLITY. It moved left and right as if it was alive, its sheer existence causing the fabric of Reality to tremble as it caused grand changes!

Just by appearing outside of her body, the surroundings instantly changed as a sea of NULLITY exploded out and bathed everything around her, the NULLITY Beasts trembling as their bodies rapidly increased in size and power!
And this...was just from its appearance.
Thereafter, The Empress sighed again as she repeated her words while blowing onto the flower.
<You truly should not have done that.>
A single petal fell as The Empress blew...and this petal disappeared an instant after.
And within the shred of a nanosecond...
WAA!
A radiant silver gray light spread out as...
Everything became blanketed by NULLITY.
The scorching flames burning all around were extinguished as any semblance of Natural Laws were denied, everything in the surroundings becoming painted utterly gray!
With her hands cradling the point of incandescent gray light as if it was a rising sun, The Empress called out calmly.
<The Primitivus Nullity Originator>
The gift from OPPENHEIMER to The Empress that exceeded all the NULLITY Relics that Tribunal Rulers had received.
The Primitivus Nullity Originator!
A treasure that would be much sought after even outside the Barren Lands!
An inexhaustible construct that released endless Essence of NULLITY of such pristine quality unlike anything shown so far.
It was activated at this moment as all of Reality turned a shade of gray!

chapters.title: Chapter 2126 Unfathomable Grandiosity! III
paragraphs: All of Reality turned gray!
All laws and decreta were withdrawn into one's own body and origin as any output outside of this...was an impossibility.

It was a Reality Altering Construct that far exceeded anything others knew as even the grandeur of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR was shadowed as his scorching blue flames all but faded, the only ones still burning being in his immediate surroundings around his Throne of Quintessential Tyranny!
And even these...seemed to be getting threatened by the ever-increasing light of NULLITY that was more potent than anything felt before.

A terrifying tool was pulled out as even the Quintessential Kainos Emperor squinted his eyes while controlling his authority, prompts rising before his eyes as he focused on the flower that caused such great changes to Reality!
<You have fallen under the domain of The Primitivus Nullity Originator.>
<The output of all abilities outside of your body and immediate sphere of influence is nullified.>
<The Augmentations of Natural Laws and Decreta are reduced by half.>
<The Augmentations of all Constructs and Concepts are reduced by half.>
<All Resource utilization has been reduced by half...>
Multiple unavoidable debuffs came down as everything changed the moment that The Empress made a move!

And her move was not wasted in the slightest as the Legions of the Abominations roared out will moving with unprecedented power, their deadly eyes honing in on the Enders of Nature whose body had lost their luster.

Meanwhile, Althea, Ezekiel, and the Eminent Mastermind all turned into gray streaks of light as they were stupendously faster than anything else here- their figures very quickly appearing near Noah's position as they released deadly attacks!

Lilith's figure had transformed into an utterly demonic existence as massive butterfly-like wings erupted from her back, a humanoid daemon form showing itself as her skin was tainted crimson red while 2 pairs of demonic horns pierced towards space. Her limbs turned into massive flaming hooves as her demonic face held three eyes- the one on her forehead spitting out pure Hatred and anger as she voiced out to herself something only she could hear.
<Father...stay with me one last time. Give me the power to rectify what they did to you long ago. Restore my path towards the True Throne!>
A silent cry.
Her third eye bled tears of crimson gold light as she called upon her Lineage- as she called upon Hatred!
BOOOM!
And even more power surged into her as like an unfurled Daemon from the deepest pits of Apollyon, she surged towards the cerulean flaming Emperor situated upon his throne.

And while it took a few nanoseconds to adapt, CHARLEMAGNE also made a move as his own visage was wrapped with NULLITY- all of these powerful existences erupting out with all their power as they only wanted to achieve a singular goal right now.
The extinction of this being before them before he became exceedingly powerful and tainted even more Sources of Nature!
But there were others who didn't seek the same end.
SHIING!
In front of CHARLEMAGNE's main body, the visage of Albus appeared as the Olden existence from the Prana Dimension finally made a move.

In the world of utter gray where all Sources of Nature were repressed, his old figure was covered by a luminous verdant light as his hands swung like the branches of an ancient tree to knock onto CHARLEMAGNE and keep him in his place!
<My friend...you have veered far from the path we used to walk on.>
His ancient voice echoed out as his body bubbled with life force, standing before CHARLEMAGNE as the other Prana Dimensional Rulers surged towards his Parallel Selves.
They weren't the only ones as in the utterly gray space, multiple golden points of light finally made a move to surround CHARLEMAGNE's Parallel Selves as well as Lilith's raging figure!
It was the Elysium Dimensional Rulers that finally joined the fray at this juncture.
They were the most attune with Providence as it told them of something that was an impossibility before, but now seemed like normality when looking at the being involved.

So they chose their side as among all the enemies rushing towards Noah, only the three Tribunal Rulers were able to get through as Enders of Nature were also still in the field standing against others!
A Spear, a Bow, and a Flail all pointed towards Noah as the Eminent Mastermind, Althea, and the Invigilator surrounded the enthroned figure on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny.
The figure that gazed at everything coldly even while such shocking restrictions were imposed upon him to the extent that half of his Damage Output was nullified!
This prompted the need of understanding NULLITY and even a weapon that could withstand it.
He needed a weapon capable of carving out NULLITY and fighting alongside it.
He needed RUINATION!
But... in a domain like this, there was another weapon that caused him to be just as fearless.
The weapon capable of dealing 25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values with every swing...was also just as valuable.
Its output was not affected in any way. The Weight of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality did not change!
So the Dimensional Reality Xyston rose as Noah moved with his throne and surged forward even with all these limitations!
SHING!
He swung the Xyston that became bathed with the flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition as he faced the first attack that arrived.
It was a blazing silver-gray arrow that radiated death and NULLITY.
BOOM...BZZZT!

The impact was reality rending as Noah parried the massive arrow from Althea while still sitting on his throne, his hand twisting and directing the Xyston to this right side soon after as he smashed onto a spiked Flail that released suns of NULLITY.
Another resounding impact as if it was the Cataclysm of Realities echoed out as the thin flames of Absolute Mana Authority stopped the scorching suns of the Flail in their tracks!
Noah then gloriously threw the Xyston from his right hand and onto his left as without even looking, its stellar spearhead met another incandescent Spear full of power!
It was the NULLITY Relic in the form of a Spear from the Eminent Mastermind.
From Noah.
HUUUM!
A low thrumming symphony echoed out with wonder as Spear and Spear met as they tore apart the fabric of Reality.
Arcs of NULLITY cried out while Absolute Mana Authority surged around the Dimensional Reality Xyston and fought for supremacy against the NULLITY Spear!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor then turned his head during this point of impact as he stared at the regal figure of the Eminent Mastermind.
As Noah...stared coldly and with unfathomable grandiosity towards another Noah!
As he rebuffed the attacks against three Tribunal Rulers while still remaining seated on his throne!!!

Her third eye bled tears of crimson gold light as she called upon her Lineage- as she called upon Hatred!
BOOOM!
And even more power surged into her as like an unfurled Daemon from the deepest pits of Apollyon, she surged towards the cerulean flaming Emperor situated upon his throne.

And while it took a few nanoseconds to adapt, CHARLEMAGNE also made a move as his own visage was wrapped with NULLITY- all of these powerful existences erupting out with all their power as they only wanted to achieve a singular goal right now.
The extinction of this being before them before he became exceedingly powerful and tainted even more Sources of Nature!
But there were others who didn't seek the same end.
SHIING!
In front of CHARLEMAGNE's main body, the visage of Albus appeared as the Olden existence from the Prana Dimension finally made a move.

In the world of utter gray where all Sources of Nature were repressed, his old figure was covered by a luminous verdant light as his hands swung like the branches of an ancient tree to knock onto CHARLEMAGNE and keep him in his place!
<My friend...you have veered far from the path we used to walk on.>
His ancient voice echoed out as his body bubbled with life force, standing before CHARLEMAGNE as the other Prana Dimensional Rulers surged towards his Parallel Selves.
They weren't the only ones as in the utterly gray space, multiple golden points of light finally made a move to surround CHARLEMAGNE's Parallel Selves as well as Lilith's raging figure!
It was the Elysium Dimensional Rulers that finally joined the fray at this juncture.
They were the most attune with Providence as it told them of something that was an impossibility before, but now seemed like normality when looking at the being involved.

So they chose their side as among all the enemies rushing towards Noah, only the three Tribunal Rulers were able to get through as Enders of Nature were also still in the field standing against others!
A Spear, a Bow, and a Flail all pointed towards Noah as the Eminent Mastermind, Althea, and the Invigilator surrounded the enthroned figure on the Throne of Quintessential Tyranny.
The figure that gazed at everything coldly even while such shocking restrictions were imposed upon him to the extent that half of his Damage Output was nullified!
This prompted the need of understanding NULLITY and even a weapon that could withstand it.
He needed a weapon capable of carving out NULLITY and fighting alongside it.
He needed RUINATION!
But... in a domain like this, there was another weapon that caused him to be just as fearless.
The weapon capable of dealing 25 Quadrillion Quintessential Damage Values with every swing...was also just as valuable.
Its output was not affected in any way.
The Weight of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality did not change!
So the Dimensional Reality Xyston rose as Noah moved with his throne and surged forward even with all these limitations!
SHING!
He swung the Xyston that became bathed with the flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition as he faced the first attack that arrived.
It was a blazing silver-gray arrow that radiated death and NULLITY.
BOOM...BZZZT!

The impact was reality rending as Noah parried the massive arrow from Althea while still sitting on his throne, his hand twisting and directing the Xyston to this right side soon after as he smashed onto a spiked Flail that released suns of NULLITY.
Another resounding impact as if it was the Cataclysm of Realities echoed out as the thin flames of Absolute Mana Authority stopped the scorching suns of the Flail in their tracks!
Noah then gloriously threw the Xyston from his right hand and onto his left as without even looking, its stellar spearhead met another incandescent Spear full of power!
It was the NULLITY Relic in the form of a Spear from the Eminent Mastermind.
From Noah.
HUUUM!
A low thrumming symphony echoed out with wonder as Spear and Spear met as they tore apart the fabric of Reality.
Arcs of NULLITY cried out while Absolute Mana Authority surged around the Dimensional Reality Xyston and fought for supremacy against the NULLITY Spear!
The Quintessential Kainos Emperor then turned his head during this point of impact as he stared at the regal figure of the Eminent Mastermind.
As Noah...stared coldly and with unfathomable grandiosity towards another Noah!
As he rebuffed the attacks against three Tribunal Rulers while still remaining seated on his throne!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 2127 The Pylon Of Ascension Illuminates! I
paragraphs: Blazing demonic flames of authority surged around Lilith as her devilish hand in the form of a hoof pierced through the chest of an Elysium Dimensional Ruler that stood in her way.

Her three eyes were filled with madness as the Rulers that stood beside her from Fantasia and Niflheim very carefully approached to lend their support, but a sense of oppressiveness and fear existed whenever they drew close to the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR on his throne!
And they could see him now as he rebuffed three Tribunal Rulers even while falling under the great suppression of the terrifying Primitivus Nullity Originator.
They hesitated as they were followers, but the one who led them had a lot at stake. Her dreams and aspirations.
What she set her heart to achieve after the end of the Last Age!
The appearance of the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR threatened all of this as for Lilith, this was now life and death.
HUUUM!

Her hooved hands ripped apart the Elysium Dimensional Ruler whose eyes remained filled with the light of providence even as he perished, his body being burnt to Ashes as he was desegregated and destroyed!
Lilith moved forward once more as soon after, yet another Elysium Dimensional Ruler stood in her path as the gaze of this one was exactly the same as the one she had just killed.
The Seeker of Knowledge had a gaze that said whatever would happen at this juncture was only an inevitability.
Only one of the many probabilities in the Endless River of Providence.
<Move!>
And the Dimensional Deceiver only bellowed out with rage at the delay as she spread forth destruction!

In another direction, CHARLEMAGNE stood before Albus as the figure of this Prana Dimensional Ruler unfurled into a massive verdant tree, its branches shining with a metallic sheen and releasing innumerable authority while they counterattacked against the waves of NULLITY that CHARLEMAGNE released.
<Old friend...>
While ripping apart the very fabric of Reality and destroying the many branches that surged towards him, CHARLEMAGNE'S voice emanated out grandly.

<I do not fight for the destruction of the Anchors and Desolate Mausoleum because I want to. I did not suddenly undergo a change to become someone you do not know. I only looked at the Absolute facts and saw the path I must follow. Nothing can stand in the way of what is to come. Past True Emperors cannot, nor can this Age's True Emperor who has not even been decided. The Will of the Ancestors is undeniable...otherwise, how could they bind Reality itself so long ago?>
His words still carried domineering authority, but they also tried to convey understanding for the sake of the past relationship these beings had as Albus's archaic voice replied.

<Maybe so. But across the Ages, I have not seen an Emperor that has been capable of influencing the very Sources of Nature. With him, there lie many possibilities to follow apart from utmost destruction.>
WAA!

The most powerful Dimensional Ruler of the Prana Dimension saw Noah's power and thought of possibilities, but even then...CHARLEMAGNE still shook his head as three of his Parallel Selves appeared to reinforce him!

<Even then, it would not be enough. Something for you to ponder...why is it that Constantine is not in attendance in this Dimensional Conclave? Why is the Quantum Emperor absent in such a crucial meeting?>
The Quantum Dimension held many mysteries and powerful existences as even CHARLEMAGNE did not take the seat as the strongest!
There was the Quantum Emperor that had been absent from the Dimensional Conclave as what was the reason for his absence?
The triangular pupils of CHARLEMAGNE shone with somber brilliance as he spoke out with majesty.

<He has been waiting at the Pylon of Ascension with the other two Mikados this whole time. The Pylon began to illuminate as it indicated a descent would soon be happening if it hasn't already. Authority exceeding anything in the Barren Lands might have already arrived. The rest of us...can only follow.>
HOONG!
Terrifying words emanated out as the verdant ancient tree that was Albus shook with never before seen anger!
Anger that things truly proceeded in this direction. Anger that it seemed the Ancestors were truly set on their aim if they worked this fast!

<I mean, what did you expect them to do when the Desolate Mausoleum began to lose its restrictions as one of the Anchors disappeared? Albus...join us. There is life to protect in these Barren Lands, yes...but there is life even more crucial to protect outside of it. And the Barren Lands stand in the way of that! You cannot win this...it would merely be suicide.>
BOOOM!
The fabric of Reality was torn as Albus stood his ground even against CHARLEMAGNE and multiple of his Parallel Selves.

The reason for this was nothing other than the fact that CHARLEMAGNE, Lilith, and many others had just lost access to 3 Sources of Nature and now came under the effect of the Primitivus Nullity Originator- while those who didn't target Noah did not face this heavy blow in their power!
Even though it was arduous, Albus held on as he hinged a possibility in the new being behind him that he did not fully know or understand.
He took a leap of faith in the existence that threatened the Hegemony of all other Emperors of this Age just by his sheer distinction alone.
If the True Emperor of the Last Age of the Olden Era was capable of doing what he did, would the True Emperor of the First Age of the Kainos Era be capable of something just as grand?
BZZZT!
Amidst these thoughts, the domain within the Quantum Rings became even more unstable as even these bright rings of light themselves became torn and broken.

NULLITY spread to the surroundings as the beautiful endless Seas of multicolored essence outside also began to get affected, the Primitivus Nullity Originator in The Empress's hands continuing to release its obscene authority!

Apart from the single opening created by the attacks of the Enders of Nature, countless rifts began to occur as some Rulers looked at this with their eyes released a light of brilliance- seeing another path opening up for them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2128 The Pylon Of Ascension Illuminates! II
paragraphs: In the midst of this all, multiple parties formed with their own ideals as all of them sought destiny and Providence to see what path they could forge in this chaos.

They went to Providence for answers as even while the three Tribunal Rulers clashed with the QUINTESSENTIAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR, their minds constantly exploded with possibilities as they relied on Providence to battle.

The Eminent Mastermind pulled his Spear from the clash as his hands turned into phantoms that threw out countless shadows of the NULLITY Spear, and yet his enemy seemed to only be getting more powerful as his stellar Xyston countered all the attacks while knocking away arrows from Althea and an innumerable number of NULLITY suns from the Flail of the Invigilator, Ezekiel!

It was a surreal scene as a single man sat on the Throne and weaved across the Fractured fabric of Reality to gloriously match three Tribunal Rulers, the Empowered NULLITY Beasts also joining the fray soon after as his Xyston covered by glorious blue flames began smashing into them and causing blooming singularities to occur that were snuffed out by the heavy waves of NULLITY soon after.
Seated on his Throne, his gaze was one of utmost power and glory as in this battlefield, nobody shone brighter than him!
<Your very eyes and soul are seeking the path forward.>
HUUM!
His voice began to emanate out in this gray Reality as everyone's guards rose up to elevated levels.
<Let me show you the only path waiting for you all.>
His words brought great alarm to his enemies as before they even ended, they felt a warning from a concept for the last time.
It would be the last time as either they perished thereafter, or they survived as they had to release it!
It was an attack of dazzling blue flames that descended from the Line of Integration of Providence that was most closely bound to their souls.
<OOOOOOH!>
From afar, Lilith bellowed out with immense sorrow and rage as she was among the first to break off the Integration with Providence.

They had all felt the surging flames that singed their souls as the quickest had their lessons after Manadynamics, putting their feelings aside as they did what they had to do in order to escape death!
But it was still Providence.
A truly crucial and fundamental law that was like a Beacon of light to see overwhelming darkness!
It had still taken a fraction of a Nanosecond for some to completely be free of it as in multiple areas where enemy Rulers from Apollyon, Fantasia, Niflheim, Mirror...points of singularities bloomed.

Near Noah's own Throne, the Eminent Mastermind and the Invigilator spat out blue flames with solemn expressions as the visage of Althea...half of it was currently burning with blue flames as she had received a heavy injury!
An injury that was also a chance as the Dimensional Reality Xyston of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor weaved out like a snake towards her wrathful and solemn visage.
Whether the Xyston could actually reach her and cause the fall of another Tribunal Ruler...was unknown!
Providence!

As Noah cut off access to it from multiple Rulers, he himself was delving across its endless river that seemed to intricately wrap around the Parallel Paths, and he had learned to delve and gaze upon what he wanted with this unique boon of Providence as he gazed into multiple Parallel Paths.
He wanted to confirm the words of Reality as the more he looked, the graver his expression became!
When focusing on the major events of a Path, nothing about Noah Osmont came up.
Unless he focused on himself and gazed at a mere reflection, he truly did not play a role in the unfolding of Reality in Parallel Paths!
So...what about the Parallel Paths that sprouted from the Main Reality due to the Irreversible Nexus Events that he caused?

The moment he thought of such a question, his vision was drawn away from the current path he viewed as in an abstruse corner where a myriad of golden lines depicted Parallel Paths, he came to see Obsidian lines running alongside them.
And when his consciousness was pulled into them...he saw the Barren Lands.
He saw them in tatters as in this path, the Dream Dimension did not exist while the other 8 Dimensions and the Desolate Mausoleum were accelerating towards destruction.

He didn't stay on this path long as soon after, he was dragged away to observe another path as here, both the Avalon and Dream Dimensions were gone as the very fabric of Reality was constantly undergoing Cataclysm as countless Realities were dying along with the remaining Dimensions!
And one after another, Noah began to be drawn to countless paths that showed such scenes of destruction and despondency as their information soon rose in his mind.
<Apocalyptic Parallel Paths...>
WAA!
Since he did not exist across the myriad Paths, his actions had no way of being rectified by Reality from the Main Path.

The Irreversible Nexus Events that he caused allowed for the birth of Parallel Paths, but since there was no way for his influence or self to cause these events, they violated Reality itself as the actions could not be quantified.
The Parallel Paths that sprouted did not have a true basis in Reality.
So what was birthed instead were unquantifiable probabilities that bore nothing but destruction!
Apocalyptic Parallel Paths.
And it did not stop there.

Noah's consciousness was drawn out again as while he gazed at the massive golden line of the Main Path and the river of Providence coiling around everything, he saw tendrils of Manadynamics, Entropy, Relativity...and the tendrils of something he had not yet come across.

Something that enveloped all of the Fundamental Natural Laws that showed among the many smaller golden lines of Parallel Paths...some had begun to be tainted Obsidian due to the actions of a certain being!
The myriad of Parallel Paths, the myriad of probabilities of Reality...were going towards destruction and Apocalypse.
The Obsidian color was beginning to spread from the Apocalyptic Parallel Paths he sprouted and spread far as eventually, all lines would crumble!
All other probabilities would crumble to join the Main Path as the results of what this confluence would bring...were unimaginable!

chapters.title: Chapter 2129 The Pylon Of Ascension Illuminates! III
paragraphs: This was the scene that the River of Providence showed him.
Branching versions of Reality becoming apocalyptic ever so slowly as this time...it was actually through his hands.
Through his own actions!
SHIING!

He was drawn back into his body moments after this realization as his consciousness came back to full attention even though this whole time...he was still technically in a slumber as Infinite Dream remained active.
He was in a slumber, but his robust will could move and think freely as he felt the changes brought about by his constant advancements.
His body was wrapped around by countless tendrils of light as between his very fingers, pristine waves of the very fundamental laws of nature flowed.
Waves that his body had constantly been devouring this whole time as prompts also continued to flow!
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Natural Law of Strong Nuclear Force.>
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Natural Law of Weak Nuclear Force.>
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Relativity...>
Glorious prompts like these continued to come, but they seemed to be occurring in passing as the Will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was gazing out into blankness while thinking of what he saw!

The pillars of Providence that had been the conduit to bring his consciousness to the unique concept of Parallel Paths began to fade as Eowyn came to once more, her figure stern as she looked around carefully before coming to float beside Noah's floating slumbering body.
Even though she didn't fully know what had just occurred, she wanted to be able to protect him in case something else happened.
So a man and a woman floated in the center of an expanding and elevating Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature as each had their own thoughts!

Noah's eyelids were closed in his slumber, but the Tri-Pupiled eyes beneath seemed to be staring out across the tendrils of Natural Laws and into the expanse of constantly assimilating Realities above his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his gaze constantly reflecting the scene of Apocalyptic Parallel Paths and what his actions were causing until they finally came face to face with the visage of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix outside the boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
This Ender of Nature intricately linked to three Fundamental Natural Laws had its stared eyes gaze coldly at Noah as its voice rang out in his mind.

<<Did you see it? Has Providence shown you a semblance of truth regarding your actions? That as you hypocritically preach about preventing Cataclysm and Apocalypse, your actions directly bore fruit to Apocalyptic Parallel Paths that are spreading their destruction to the countless probable Realities out there?>>
The voice was cold and filled with the same apathy as Noah's gaze was cold and simmering with brilliance when gazing at the Ender of Nature who continued!

<<Your standing as an anomaly nonexistent in Parallel Paths is causing this. If you hand control of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to me and I am the one to continue causing Nexus Events capable of causing branching Paths, there would be no branching Apocalyptic Parallel Paths. Reality exists on the Main Path and Parallel Paths as even the absence of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality would be rectified. You can achieve what you preach as your goals right now and stop Apocalypse across the Myriad Parallel Paths...if you just grant me control of this Construct.>>
HUUUM!
The voice of Reality was cold and ruthless!
Noah's slumbering visage listened silently, but at the same time- his Will was bubbling with an unknown force of Tyranny.
The path he followed.
The goals he wanted to achieve!
Would he truly leave all of them behind because of the appearance of Apocalyptic Parallel Paths?!
His Will formed into waves of Haki as he bellowed out at this juncture, his Heart ever so clear as resplendent Absolute Authority coursed through his very vessels!

<It is merely the birth of probable Realities that could have occurred through my own actions. But that is all they are- mere probabilities! As for their path towards apocalypse...I've come to learn that Apocalypse and assimilation are not too different. Let the Parallel Paths be no more. I shall return all possible versions of Realities onto a singular path...onto the Main Path!>
His Will rose ever higher in stature.
Reality had to remain silent after his boisterous words as Noah had truly come to learn of the thin line between Apocalypse and Assimilation!
After all, hundreds of thousands of Realities were currently undergoing Apocalypse and being assimilated into his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality at this very moment.
So he would not be swayed.
This was his path.
And he would see it to the end!
WAA!
<There are greater things for me to worry about than this...>
Yes.
Among the many boons of Providence, there came individualized boosts like all Laws and Decreta.
In terms of Providence...
<The Protagonist Trait has experienced Quintessential Elevation.>
<The feature of [I Am the Main Character] has been infused with a large amount of Absolute Providence Authority.>
<The possibilities of your path become even so clear in your eyes.>
Everyone relied on Providence to see possible paths that could play out and how to prepare for the future.

He was able to see many things after he bound the Source of Providence. The vision of the Parallel Paths was just one as now, he could also with even greater accuracy the most crucial Paths right before him...as well as any dangers that could stand in his way!
And even though his True Sanguine Clone was matching Tribunal Rulers at this moment and had reached a stellar level of power in the Barren Lands, it was not enough.
Because the Barren Lands would not remain with its current experts any longer.
CHARLEMAGNE had said it.
And now, Noah had seen it!
The most pertinent vision he was currently seeing after the Parallel Paths was of a massive configuration of light in the shape of an hourglass.

From it, it would illuminate as multiple points of darkness that swallowed everything in their path arose as these points of darkness...would make their way towards the location of the battle soon enough as...
<A True Sanguine Clone has stepped on the Point of Death and Rebirth.>

sentences.text: This was the scene that the River of Providence showed him.
Branching versions of Reality becoming apocalyptic ever so slowly as this time...it was actually through his hands.
Through his own actions!
SHIING!

He was drawn back into his body moments after this realization as his consciousness came back to full attention even though this whole time...he was still technically in a slumber as Infinite Dream remained active.
He was in a slumber, but his robust will could move and think freely as he felt the changes brought about by his constant advancements.
His body was wrapped around by countless tendrils of light as between his very fingers, pristine waves of the very fundamental laws of nature flowed.
Waves that his body had constantly been devouring this whole time as prompts also continued to flow!
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Natural Law of Strong Nuclear Force.>
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Natural Law of Weak Nuclear Force.>
<You have gained an initial Understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Relativity...>
Glorious prompts like these continued to come, but they seemed to be occurring in passing as the Will of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor was gazing out into blankness while thinking of what he saw!

The pillars of Providence that had been the conduit to bring his consciousness to the unique concept of Parallel Paths began to fade as Eowyn came to once more, her figure stern as she looked around carefully before coming to float beside Noah's floating slumbering body.
Even though she didn't fully know what had just occurred, she wanted to be able to protect him in case something else happened.
So a man and a woman floated in the center of an expanding and elevating Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature as each had their own thoughts!

Noah's eyelids were closed in his slumber, but the Tri-Pupiled eyes beneath seemed to be staring out across the tendrils of Natural Laws and into the expanse of constantly assimilating Realities above his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his gaze constantly reflecting the scene of Apocalyptic Parallel Paths and what his actions were causing until they finally came face to face with the visage of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix outside the boundary of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
This Ender of Nature intricately linked to three Fundamental Natural Laws had its stared eyes gaze coldly at Noah as its voice rang out in his mind.
<<Did you see it?
Has Providence shown you a semblance of truth regarding your actions?

That as you hypocritically preach about preventing Cataclysm and Apocalypse, your actions directly bore fruit to Apocalyptic Parallel Paths that are spreading their destruction to the countless probable Realities out there?>>
The voice was cold and filled with the same apathy as Noah's gaze was cold and simmering with brilliance when gazing at the Ender of Nature who continued!
<<Your standing as an anomaly nonexistent in Parallel Paths is causing this.

If you hand control of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to me and I am the one to continue causing Nexus Events capable of causing branching Paths, there would be no branching Apocalyptic Parallel Paths.
Reality exists on the Main Path and Parallel Paths as even the absence of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality would be rectified.
You can achieve what you preach as your goals right now and stop Apocalypse across the Myriad Parallel Paths...if you just grant me control of this Construct.>>
HUUUM!
The voice of Reality was cold and ruthless!
Noah's slumbering visage listened silently, but at the same time- his Will was bubbling with an unknown force of Tyranny.
The path he followed.
The goals he wanted to achieve!
Would he truly leave all of them behind because of the appearance of Apocalyptic Parallel Paths?!
His Will formed into waves of Haki as he bellowed out at this juncture, his Heart ever so clear as resplendent Absolute Authority coursed through his very vessels!
<It is merely the birth of probable Realities that could have occurred through my own actions.
But that is all they are- mere probabilities!
As for their path towards apocalypse...I've come to learn that Apocalypse and assimilation are not too different.
Let the Parallel Paths be no more.
I shall return all possible versions of Realities onto a singular path...onto the Main Path!>
His Will rose ever higher in stature.
Reality had to remain silent after his boisterous words as Noah had truly come to learn of the thin line between Apocalypse and Assimilation!
After all, hundreds of thousands of Realities were currently undergoing Apocalypse and being assimilated into his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality at this very moment.
So he would not be swayed.
This was his path.
And he would see it to the end!
WAA!
